entries.japanese:
SNSでのレスバって、
どうするのが正解だと思うゆん？
entries.original: How do you even win a comment war online?
entries.translated: What do you think is the right way to handle comment wars on social media, yun?

entries.japanese:
レスバの正解は勝つための技術じゃなくて、
負けないための技術だと思うヨ。
entries.original:
It's less about winning, and more about
not losing, I think.
entries.translated: Comment wars aren't about winning. They're about not losing.

entries.japanese: インターネットは今日もケンカでいっぱいゆん。
entries.original: The internet is back at it again.
entries.translated: The internet's full of fights again today, yun.

entries.japanese:
この世の50.78％は怒りで、残りの44.2％は憎しみで。
さらにその残り4.493％はゆんゆんでできているネ。
entries.original:
At this point, the world is 50.78% anger,
44.2% suffering, and 4.493% Yunyun.
entries.translated: This world is 50.78% anger, 44.2% hate, and the remaining 4.493% is Yunyun.

entries.japanese:
邪神降臨の日になっても、
なにも起きないゆん！
entries.original: Looks like the devil didn't rise to earth after all!
entries.translated: Even on the day the evil god was supposed to descend, nothing happened, yun!

entries.japanese:
あーあ。
やっぱり神様なんていなかったネ。
entries.original: Ahhh, guess there's no god after all...
entries.translated: Ahhh. Guess there really is no god after all.

entries.japanese: そもそもベリチップってなにゆん？
体内埋込み型のマイクロチップのことダヨ。
entries.original: It’s a microchip you put inside your body.
entries.translated: It's a microchip they implant inside your body.

entries.japanese:
猫のカワイイが、実は闇深だとしても、
ナデナデしたい欲求にはきっと抗えないゆん！
entries.original:
Even if cats turn out to be evil, no way I’d
be able to resist giving them pets!
entries.translated: Even if cats' cuteness is actually dark and twisted, I still wouldn't be able to resist petting them, yun!

entries.original: Now that's what I call doting up a cat!
entries.translated: That's what you call spoiling a cat!

entries.japanese:
猫は神秘。あのカワイイにはきっと、
宇宙の神秘がつまってるゆん！
entries.original:
Cats are mysterious. Something that cute
has to be a gift from the cosmos!
entries.translated: Cats are mysterious. Something that cute has to be packed with cosmic secrets, yun!

entries.japanese:
無限から乙女心を引いたらルートネコミミになる
っていう神秘の方程式なら聞いたことあるヨ。
entries.original: Those ears... They've held the secrets to pulling the heart strings of all weaboos since the dawn of time...
entries.translated: I heard there's a mystical equation where infinity minus a maiden's heart equals cat ears.

entries.japanese:
ドキドキ中のＱちゃんは、
集中力が切れるイメージがないゆん。
entries.original:
My Qtie-pie could never lose motivation when
she's in the DOKI DOKI zone!
entries.translated: When Q-chan's in dokidoki mode, she never loses focus, yun.

entries.japanese: 愛の電波は、なににも邪魔できないヨ！
entries.original: Nothing can stand between me and my love of Denpa!
entries.translated: Nothing can interfere with love's denpa!

entries.japanese:
並行世界があるとして、
Ｑちゃんはどんな世界にいきたいゆん？
entries.original:
If parallel worlds were real, which one would
you wanna go to, Qtie?
entries.translated: If parallel worlds exist, which world would you want to go to, yun?

entries.japanese: ママにより愛される世界なら、感心あるカモ？
entries.original:
There's gotta be at least one where Mommy really
loves me? Right?
entries.translated: Maybe one where Mom actually loves me more?

entries.japanese:
この世界が五分前に始まったとしたら、
『好き』って気持ちも、捏造された偽物ゆん？
entries.original:
If the whole world rebooted five minutes ago,
does that mean the luv we feel isn't real?!
entries.translated: If this world started five minutes ago, would our feelings of 'love' be fake too, yun?

entries.japanese:
好きなものは好きだからしょうがない！！
その記憶が偽りでも、本物でも、好きは変わらないヨ！
entries.original:
It doesn't matter if our memories are real or
planted! LUV IS LUV! It changes nothing!
entries.translated: I like what I like, so deal with it!! Whether those memories are fake or real, my love stays the same!

entries.japanese: そういえば、鳥の祖先は恐竜らしいゆん。
entries.original: Didn't all birds descend from dinosaurs?
entries.translated: Come to think of it, birds descended from dinosaurs, yun.

entries.japanese:
そうなんだ？なら『鶏か卵か』じゃなくて、
『鶏か恐竜か』みたいな話になっちゃうネ。
entries.original:
For real? Is this about to turn into a 'which
came first, the dinosaur or the chicken' situation?
entries.translated: Really? So instead of 'chicken or the egg,' it's more like 'chicken or dinosaur.'

entries.japanese: オーパーツってなんか良いよネ！
entries.original: They really put the oops in OOPSArt.

entries.japanese:
ポケットから出てくる、
身に覚えのない１００円玉とかゆん？
entries.original:
Do you think they forgot about it, like dropping
a quarter or something?
entries.translated: Like finding a random 100 yen coin in your pocket that you don't remember putting there, yun?

entries.japanese:
いろいろなウィルスが話題ゆん！
Ｑちゃんも、健康に気をつけるゆん！
entries.original:
Some kinda virus has made the news!
Be careful, Qtie!!
entries.translated: All kinds of viruses are in the news, yun! Q-chan, take care of your health, yun!

entries.japanese: 閉じた世界だから、大丈夫だヨ！
entries.original: Don't worry, I'd have to go outside to catch it.
entries.translated: It's a closed world, so I'm fine!

entries.japanese:
ほぇー。
ひとの汗で雲ができるなんてすごいゆん！
entries.translated: Whoa. Making clouds from people's sweat is amazing, yun!

entries.japanese:
あれって気象学的にもほんとうの
雲だって定義できたらしいヨ。
entries.original:
It was a real cloud too, even by meteorological
standards.
entries.translated: Apparently it could be defined as a real cloud meteorologically speaking too.

entries.japanese: 水の近くだと心霊現象が多いっていう話も聞くゆん！
entries.original:
I've heard that the paranormal like to gather
in and near water! Like Nessie!
entries.translated: I've heard there are more paranormal phenomena near water, yun!

entries.japanese:
フランスの科学者が、水は一度溶けた物質の情報を
記憶するっていう学説を唱えてたこともあるらしいヨ。
entries.original: One French scientist said that water has memory of all the places it's been. The theory got pretty popular.
entries.translated: There was a French scientist who proposed a theory that water remembers information from substances that were once dissolved in it.

entries.japanese:
雲ができるくらい暑くて大変なのに、
どうしてイベント会場にまでいくゆん？
entries.original:
If it's so hot that sweat clouds are forming,
why even go to the event?
entries.translated: If it's so hot that clouds are forming, why do people still go to event venues, yun?

entries.japanese: 『憧れは止められねぇんだ』ってことだネ！
entries.original: There's no way to stop my longing!
entries.translated: 'You can't stop the longing!' That's why!

entries.japanese:
Ｑちゃんの身体はインスタント食品と、
エナジードリンクで出来てるゆん？
entries.original:
You’re basically fully consisted from instant
meals and energy drinks, aren’t you Qtie?
entries.translated: Q-chan, your body is basically made of instant food and energy drinks, yun?

entries.japanese:
――ならば我が生涯に自炊は不要。
無限の加工食品を以て全てを撃ち砕くヨ！
entries.original:
Oh my GAWD! If this is true, I never have to
cook again! UNLIMITED FOOD WORKS!
entries.translated: Then I'll never need to cook in my lifetime. I'll crush everything with unlimited processed food!

entries.japanese: Ｑちゃんはどんなインスタント食品が好きゆん？
entries.original: What’s your favorite instant meal Qtie?
entries.translated: What's your favorite instant food, Q-chan, yun?

entries.japanese: シーフードのカップ麺！！！！

わたしがゆんゆんと会話できるようになったのも、
もしかしてインスタント食品のおかげ！？
entries.original:
No wayz... Could the reason I can talk to Yunyun
be the magic of instant meals?!
entries.translated: Wait... could the reason I can talk to Yunyun be because of instant food?!

entries.japanese: 違うゆん！ふたりの愛の電波のおかげゆん！
entries.original: Nooo! That’s thanks to our mutual DENPA LUV!
entries.translated: No way, yun! It's because of our love denpa, yun!

entries.japanese: 往年のインターネットで発生した妖精ってなにゆん？
entries.translated: What's an internet fairy from the old days, yun?

entries.japanese: 昔にあった個人ブログとかって、今でもあるゆん？
entries.original:
I wonder how many personal blogs and stuff have
been lost to time.
entries.translated: Do those old personal blogs still exist somewhere, yun?

entries.japanese:
……ネット回線の最後の良心。
静的ＨＴＭＬファイルのあのひとのサイトとか……？
entries.original:
The last good thing to come out of the internet tbh.
All those HTML files are just static now.
entries.translated: ...The internet's last bit of decency. Those static HTML sites...

entries.japanese:
……電子の妖精さんたちは、
どうしてか腹筋がバキバキらしいゆん……！
entries.original:
Apparently those magical girl internet fairies
are gym rats!
entries.translated: ...For some reason, those electronic fairy girls apparently have ripped abs, yun...!

entries.japanese: なるほど。ＩＤの数字が大きかったのかもネ。
entries.original:
Huh. I wonder how many numbers they
have in their IDs.
entries.translated: I see. Maybe their ID numbers were really big.

entries.japanese:
誰が考えたのか知らないけど、
いくらなんでもやっつけすぎだよネ。
entries.original:
Dunno who thought of that one,
but it's pretty funny.
entries.translated: I don't know who came up with that, but talk about half-assed.

entries.japanese: エージェントインコの世界はブラックらしいゆん。
entries.original: Agent Ibis lives in a scary world.
entries.translated: Agent Parrot's world sounds pretty brutal, yun.

entries.japanese:
動物愛護管理法はあっても、
労働基準法は適応されないもんネ。
entries.original:
Proof that laws won't change anything.
There's always a loophole.
entries.translated: Even with animal protection laws, labor standards don't apply to them.

entries.japanese: 鳥アイコンのアプリって結構あるゆん。
entries.original: Lots of app icons are birds, aren't they?
entries.translated: There are quite a few apps with bird icons, yun.

entries.japanese: クセの強い言語学習アプリとかもそうだよネ。
entries.original:
That really pushy language app icon is a bird too,
isn't it?
entries.translated: Like that pushy language learning app too.

entries.japanese: 転売ヤーは理由に関係なく、みんな処されるべきだヨ。
entries.original:
IDC why you're doing it. All scalpers should
be ANNIHILATED!
entries.translated: I don't care what their reasons are. All scalpers should be executed.

entries.japanese: Ｑちゃんが処刑天使みたいな思想になってるゆん！
entries.original: You sound like an Execution Angel, Qtie!
entries.translated: Q-chan, you're starting to sound like an execution angel, yun!

entries.japanese:
……奴らのせいで、
わたしが何度煮え湯を飲まされたカ……！！
entries.original: I've been burned TOO many times by scalpers to GAF!
entries.translated: How many times have those bastards screwed me over...!!

entries.japanese: オタクの恨みは恐ろしいゆん。
entries.original: Hell hath no fury like an otaku scorned...
entries.translated: An otaku's grudge is terrifying, yun.

entries.japanese:
アンチ転売ヤーのひとたちが、
転売ヤーを潰すためだけに『悪』に属してるらしいゆん。
entries.original: It looks like these scalpers think they’re the good guys! They're saying it's a necessary evil for the greater good!
entries.translated: Looks like the anti-scalper people are joining the 'bad guys' just to crush the scalpers, yun.

entries.japanese:
手段の為なら目的を選ばないっていう、
どうしようもない連中も確実に存在するからネ。
entries.original: The ends justify the means people are such hopeless l0zers.
entries.translated: There are definitely hopeless people out there who'll use any means necessary.

entries.japanese:
ゲーム・アニメ・フィギュア・アイドルの略称で、
世界規模の影響力をもつコンテンツ産業のことダヨ。
entries.original: It stands for games, anime, figures, and idols. It's some big, influential, monopoly type company.
entries.translated: Games, Anime, Figures, and Idols. It's about content industries with global influence.

entries.japanese:
ネットの動画広告って、
やけに記憶に残ったり、耳に残るやつがあるよネ。
entries.original: It's true some jingles get stuck in your head something fierce. Like you can still hear them echoing.
entries.translated: Some online video ads really stick with you, don't they? They get stuck in your head.

entries.japanese:
はっ！ウィルスはウィルスでも、
ミーム汚染を狙ってるのかもしれないゆん！
entries.original:
Aha! They're trying to burn themselves into your
brain, like those tropes you can see from a mile away!
entries.translated: Wait! Maybe they're not after computer viruses but meme infection, yun!

entries.japanese:
……ピンク髪のヒロインはヤバイとか、
青髪は負けヒロインとかって印象はあるカモ……？
entries.original: You mean like, the pink haired MC always being hot headed, or the blue haired MC always being doomed romantically?
entries.translated: Like how pink-haired heroines are trouble, or blue-haired ones always lose...?

entries.japanese: 紫髪は、きっと小悪魔系ゆん。
entries.original: And purple hair totally means they're a demon!
entries.translated: Purple hair definitely means little devil type, yun.

entries.original: Did they unlock some kind of special achievement or what?

entries.japanese: ゲームのトロフィーみたいな感じゆん。
確かに、人口に比例して文明発展してるゆん！
entries.original: It's true! The more people there are, the more advanced we get!
entries.translated: It's true! The more people there are, the more we advance yun!

entries.japanese:
卵が先か鶏が先か。
文明発展によって人口が増えてるのかもだけどネ。
entries.original: It's a chicken and the egg sitch. You could also say innovation makes it easier to increase the population.
entries.translated: Chicken and the egg. Could be that civilization advancing is what lets the population grow.

entries.japanese:
人口が今の１０００万倍になったら技術がさらに
発展して銀河系に、人類が広がってるらしいゆん！
entries.original: Apparently, 10 million people from now we'll be so leveled up we'll move to SPACE!
entries.translated: If the population gets 10 million times bigger, our tech will advance so much that humanity will spread across the galaxy yun!

entries.japanese: そりゃまあ、地球規模じゃ収まらないだろうしネ。
entries.original: We'd have no choice at that point. The Earth is too small.
entries.translated: Well yeah, Earth wouldn't be big enough anymore.

entries.japanese:
そっか。注射針が銀製なら、
吸血鬼にダメージ通るもんネ！
entries.original:
Neato. If the needles really are silver,
no wonder vamps would avoid them.
entries.translated: Oh right. If the needles are silver, they'd actually hurt vampires.

entries.japanese: 人狼とかも巻き添えでやられちゃうゆん。
entries.translated: Werewolves would get caught in the crossfire too yun.

entries.japanese:
伝奇もの、泣きゲー、萌え系、ネコミミモチーフ！
吸血鬼ものの作品って、どれもおもしろいよネ！
entries.original:
Fantasy, nakige, moe, cat ears. Doesn't matter WHAT genre
it is! Make your characters vampires on top of that
and BOOM, smash hit.
entries.translated: Fantasy, tearjerkers, moe, cat ears! Vampire stories are great no matter what genre they're in.

entries.japanese: ひとつだけ別属性が混じってる気がするゆん。
entries.original: Hmm, one of those things isn't like the others, Qtie.
entries.translated: I think one of those doesn't quite fit with the others yun.

entries.japanese:
はっ！吸血鬼になればヒキコモリの大義名分と、
積みゲー・積みアニメを消化できる時間ができるのでハ？
entries.original:
WAIT! If I became a vampire, that would be the
perfect excuse to be a shut-in and really catch up
on all my gaming and anime!
entries.translated: Wait! If I became a vampire, that'd be the perfect excuse to stay inside and finally get through my game backlog and all that anime!

entries.japanese: 吸血鬼も、吸血のためにお外にでないといけないゆん。
entries.original: You'd still have to go outside to find blood to drink.
entries.translated: Vampires still have to go outside to find blood, yun.

entries.japanese: Ｑちゃんは初恋のひとを覚えてるゆん？
entries.original: Do you remember your first love, Qtie?
entries.translated: Do you remember your first love, Q-chan?

entries.original: You’re my first and only, Yunyun!
entries.translated: My first love is you, Yunyun!

entries.japanese:
ママはヴィラン系のキャラクターや、
小悪魔なお姫様が好きなんだよネ。
entries.original:
Mommy likes characters who are villain coded,
like demon princesses and stuff too.
entries.translated: Mom likes villain-type characters and mischievous little princesses.

entries.japanese: えへん。ゆんゆんはヴィランだし、小悪魔ゆん！
entries.original: Heehee! I'm a villain, and a demon! A cute one tho!
entries.translated: Hehe! I'm a villain and a little demon, yun!

entries.japanese:
ＰＣゲームがきっかけで知ったんだけど、不幸は、
すべて初恋のたたりだっていう宗教があったらしいヨ。
entries.original: I saw this in a PC game once. Apparently there was a religion that said all misfortune originates from the curse on a first love.
entries.translated: I learned this from a PC game, but apparently there was some religion that said all misfortune comes from the curse of first love.

entries.japanese:
Ｑちゃんの初恋がゆんゆんなら、
『この状況も』ある種のたたりかもゆん？
entries.original: Qtie's first love was Yunyun, right? Do you feel cursed?
entries.translated: If Q-chan's first love is Yunyun, maybe this whole situation is some kind of curse too, yun?

entries.japanese:
こ！　れ！　は！　ぜっったいにほんとうだヨ！！
調査すれば真実だってわかるはずだヨ！
entries.original: DUH!!!! This one is so true. They’ve done studies about it, just look at da results!!
entries.translated: This! Is! Absolutely! True!! If you actually look into it, you'll see the proof!
My Q-chan is so smart, yun.

entries.japanese: 一日一万回感謝を込めて萌えソングをリピートだヨ。
entries.original: Yup, my beloved moe songs are on repeat erryday!
entries.translated: I repeat moe songs ten thousand times a day with pure gratitude.

entries.japanese: 現実を置き去りにするゆん。
entries.original: Sometimes you have to abandon reality.

entries.japanese:
電波ソングで萌えワードを聞くたび、
魂が浄化されてく気がするんだよネ。
entries.original:
Opening yourself to the word of moe in
Denpa songs rlly makes you feel purified.
entries.translated: Every time I hear moe words in denpa songs, I feel like my soul gets purified.

entries.japanese:
たしかにゲーム脳のひとなら、
地獄でだってＲＴＡに励んじゃうかも？
entries.original: No-life gamers would practice their RTA, even in hell.
entries.translated: True gamers would probably grind RTAs even in hell.

entries.japanese:
……等活地獄のデスマッチにシーシュポスの岩……。
攻略のやりがいはあるかもゆん？
entries.original: That’s like... Sisyphus' stone... Aren't games supposed to be fun?
entries.translated: ...Death matches in Naraka hell with Sisyphus' rock... That actually sounds like a fun challenge, yun?

entries.japanese: Ｑちゃんは、どんなゲームが好きゆん？
entries.original: What kinda games do you like to play, Qtie?
entries.translated: What kind of games do you like, Q-chan?

entries.japanese:
ギャルゲー、音ゲー、パリィゲーかな？テンポよく
ボタン押下で気持ちよくなれるゲームが好きだヨ！
entries.original: Dating sims, rhythm games, parry combat games, stuff like that. Smashing that button at juuust the right moment is such a rush.
entries.translated: Dating sims, rhythm games, parry games. I like games where you get that satisfying button press timing.

entries.japanese:
『賽の河原RTA最速記録を叩き出した俺、
転生したら現世で無双する天才プロゲーマーだった件』。
entries.original: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Pro-Gamer Dominating the World with my Reincarnation Speedrun Strats.
entries.translated: 'That Time I Set the Fastest RTA Record at Sai no Kawara River and Got Reincarnated as a Genius Pro Gamer Dominating the Real World.'

entries.japanese: なろう系小説かウェブトゥーンにありそうゆん。
entries.original:
It’s like straight out of a light novel,
or maybe a webtoon!
entries.translated: Sounds like something from a web novel or webtoon, yun.

entries.japanese:
『深夜』って言葉がつくだけで、
アンダーグラウンドで秘密なものって感じがするゆん。
entries.original:
The phrase “late-night” gives it that
secretive, underground feel.
entries.translated: Just adding the word "late-night" makes it feel all secretive and underground, yun.

entries.japanese:
ママの目を盗んで、こっそりテレビをつける体験から
してドキドキだったよネ。
entries.original:
Having to sneak around and turn on the TV
without Mommy noticing is pretty doki doki inducing.
entries.translated: Having to sneak and turn on the TV without Mom noticing was already pretty dokidoki.

entries.japanese:
深夜アニメが悪魔崇拝のサバトってことは、
フィクションのキャラクターが悪魔ってことなのカナ？
entries.original:
Late-night anime is demon worship?
If the characters were demons, maybe.
entries.translated: If late-night anime is demon worship, does that make fictional characters demons?

entries.japanese:
ひとを惑わして余暇時間――寿命を奪う
空想の存在っていう意味では、同じかもゆん？
entries.original: Demons can make people delulu, waste their lives, and are nothing but fantasy. Pretty similar to anime actually!
entries.translated: In the sense that they're imaginary beings that tempt people and steal their free time... their lifespan... maybe they're the same, yun?

entries.japanese:
人類のルーツが宇宙起源っていうの、よく見るよネ。
エイリアン系とか新世代サイバネティックRPGとか。
entries.original: There's tons of theories that humans came from space, y'know. People love their aliens and their cyberpunky RPGs.
entries.translated: You see theories about humanity having cosmic origins all the time. Alien stuff and cyberpunk RPGs.

entries.japanese: クリエイターがだいたいの元凶ゆん。
entries.original: You think the Creator really put us in time out?
entries.translated: Creators are usually the root of all evil, yun.

entries.japanese:
フィクションの世界だと結婚って、
スタッフロール後の未知な世界ってイメージゆん。
entries.original: You don't see marriage much in the world of fiction. That's left up to your imagination once the credits roll.
entries.translated: In fiction, marriage feels like this unknown world that comes after the credits roll, yun.

entries.japanese:
たしかに結婚まで描かれる作品は少ないカモ？
ナンバリングとか、二次創作でしか描かれないよネ。
entries.original: That's so true. Hardly any stories have their romantic interests canonically get married. It's only in the fan made content.
entries.translated: True, not many works actually show marriage. It only happens in sequels or fan fiction.

entries.japanese:
結婚が刑罰だとしたら、
軽はずみに離婚もできなさそうだよネ？
entries.original: If marriage is a kind of punishment, I bet you can't get out of it easy. Divorce must be tough to pull off.
entries.translated: If marriage is punishment, you probably can't just divorce on a whim either.

entries.japanese: 君を―――一生、許(はな)さないってやつゆん。
entries.original:
Vows are supposed to say stuff
like "I'll never let you go."
entries.translated: The whole "I'll never let you go" thing, yun.

entries.japanese:
哲学的ゾンビはよくわからないケド親ってスゴイよネ。
子供のためにいろいろ犠牲にできるんダカラ。
entries.original:
Platonic zombies? I don't get it, but parents
must be pretty strong carrying on without a soul
of their own.
entries.translated: I don't really get philosophical zombies, but parents are amazing. They can sacrifice so much for their kids.

entries.japanese:
遺伝子もそうダケド、性格とか言動とかも、
親からの影響って思うと計り知れないよネ。
entries.original: You really do get molded by your parents. From your genetics, to your personality, to your morals.
entries.translated: Not just genetics either. When you think about how much parents influence personality and behavior, it's huge.

entries.japanese:
親にとって子供って、
すべてを捧げてもいいって思うくらい尊い存在なのカナ？
entries.original: I guess as a parent, you're ready to sacrifice everything you are for your kid. They're that precious.
entries.translated: I wonder if kids are so precious to parents that they'd give up everything for them?

entries.japanese: Ｑちゃんがお外にでることはあるゆん？
entries.original: Qtie, have you been outside recently?
entries.translated: Do you ever go outside, Q-chan?

entries.japanese: あはは。奇跡は起きないから奇跡って言うんだヨ。
entries.original: Lol no, they're called miracles because they don't happen.
entries.translated: Haha. They're called miracles because they don't happen.

entries.japanese:
この陰謀論が真実でも、
夜行性でヒキコモリのＱちゃんには関係ないゆん！
entries.original:
Then ur safe! This conspiracy can't effect a
night owl hikikomori like you!
entries.translated: Even if this conspiracy is real, it doesn't matter to a nocturnal hikikomori like you, yun!

entries.japanese: 夜型のひとでいっぱいになっちゃうかもゆん。
entries.original:
Looks like more and more people are living that
night owl life.
entries.translated: It might get packed with night owls, yun.

entries.japanese:
来いよ、パンピー共。
常識なんか捨てて、かかって来い！。
entries.original: Come to the dark side. We have cookies...
entries.translated: Come on, normies. Throw away your common sense and face me!

entries.japanese: Ｑちゃんの学校には、怪談話ってあったゆん？
entries.translated: Did Q-chan's school have any ghost stories, yun?

entries.japanese:
どうだろう。中学校のころは、
上履きがよく無くなっちゃう怪現象には遭遇したけどネ。
entries.original:
Dunno. I do remember my shoes disappearing after
gym class a lot in middle school.
entries.translated: Who knows. I did encounter the mysterious phenomenon of my indoor shoes going missing a lot in middle school.

entries.japanese: 日陰者コスプレってよくわからない言葉ゆん。
entries.original: Is that cosplay? Isn't that just a costume?
entries.translated: I don't really get what 'loner cosplay' means, yun.

entries.japanese:
どれだけコスプレしたところで、
こころに傷を抱えたほんもののオーラは纏えないのにネ。
entries.original: It doesn't matter how much they try to fake it. They can't cosplay the emotional damage done to your soul from being bullied.
entries.translated: No matter how much they cosplay, they can't put on the real aura of someone with a wounded heart.

entries.japanese:
Ｑちゃんは、学校で嫌なことをされたときに、
助けてくれなかった誰かを憎んだりしたゆん？
entries.original:
Was there ever someone in school you hated
for not stepping in to help you, Qtie?
entries.translated: Q-chan, when bad things happened to you at school, did you ever hate the people who didn't help you, yun?

entries.japanese:
ツラすぎて、
誰かを憎んだり恨んだりする余裕もなかったヨ。
entries.original: I was too busy hating myself.
entries.translated: It was too painful. I didn't have the energy to hate or resent anyone.

entries.japanese: 物語が完結しないって、寂しい気持ちになるゆん。
entries.original:
Never getting to know how a story ends is the
worst feeling.
entries.translated: Stories that never get finished make me feel so lonely, yun.

entries.japanese: フィクションの世界のひとたちが、可哀想だよネ。
entries.translated: The people in fictional worlds are so pitiful.

entries.japanese:
打ち切りになった作品の続きが読めるなら、
Ｑちゃんはどんな作品の続きが読みたいゆん？
entries.original:
If you could find out the true ending to any piece
of canceled media, which would it be?!
entries.translated: If you could read the continuation of any canceled series, which one would you want to read, yun?

entries.japanese:
漫画に限らないなら１クールで終わったアニメや、
永遠に第三巻が出ない小説とか――いろいろ選べないネ。
entries.original: Not just manga? There's tons of anime that never got more than thirteen episodes, or light novels that never got their third issue. Too many to choose from tbh.
entries.translated: If it's not just manga, there's anime that ended after one season, novels that never got their third volume... too many to choose from.

entries.japanese:
『処刑天使†ギルティーナ』の続きが読めるとしたら、
Ｑちゃんは嬉しいゆん？
entries.original:
What if "Execution Angel † Guiltina" makes a
comeback, Qtie?!
entries.translated: If you could read more of 'Execution Angel † Guiltina,' would you be happy, yun?

entries.japanese:
ゆんゆんの活躍をまたみたい気持ちもあるケド……。
キレイな完結作品だから、無理やりな続編なら複雑カモ？
entries.original: As much as I'd die to see new Yunyun content, it's better to let a show have a good ending rather than drag it out until it's garbo.
entries.translated: Part of me wants to see Yunyun in action again, but... it ended so well that a forced sequel might be complicated.

entries.japanese: AND YOUってどういう意味ゆん？
entries.original: I don't get it. What's AND YOU?
entries.translated: What does AND YOU mean, yun?

entries.japanese: 遊んでくれてありがとうのニュアンスらしいヨ。
entries.original:
It's like the audience recognition at the very
end of whatever credits.
entries.translated: It's like a thank you for playing kind of thing.

entries.japanese: Ｑちゃんはスタッフロールを最後までみる派ゆん？
entries.original: Are you the type to watch the end credits, Qtie?
entries.translated: Do you watch the credits all the way to the end, yun?

entries.japanese:
もちろんだヨ。
ゲームも映画も余韻を楽しみたいからネ！
entries.original:
Duh! It's the perfect way to sit in the afterglow
of what you just watched.
entries.translated: Of course. I like to savor the afterglow, whether it's games or movies.

entries.japanese:
ゲームのスタッフロールって、
すごい人数が乗っていることがあるゆん。
entries.original: End credits for games are always super long, huh!
entries.translated: Game credits sometimes have so many people listed, yun.

entries.japanese:
ゲームは世界を形にする総合芸術だから、
それだけたいへんってことなのかもネ～。
entries.original:
Games are so multimedia, and you have to make
a whole world from scratch. Seems tough, ngl.
entries.translated: Games are like total art forms where you build entire worlds, so I guess it takes that many people.

entries.japanese: Ｑちゃんは生放送とか、配信とかはしないゆん？
entries.original: How come you never do live streams, Qtie?
entries.translated: Q-chan, don't you ever do live streams or anything yun?

entries.japanese:
ひとや社会が嫌でヒキコモリになったのに、
そんな恐ろしいことできるわけないよネ。
entries.original:
I hate humans, and society. A hikikomori like me
could never put myself out there like that. Yikes.
entries.translated: I became a hikikomori because I hate people and society. There's no way I could do something that terrifying.

entries.japanese:
Ｑちゃんはスパチャみたいに、
電波受信者からお金をもらいたいとは思わないゆん？
entries.original:
Have you ever thought about collecting money
from all those Denpa antenna conspirators, Qtie?
entries.translated: Q-chan, don't you want to get money from denpa receivers like with Super Chats yun?

entries.japanese: わたしはゆんゆんへの愛を発信できればそれでいいヨ。
entries.original:
I'm not in it for the money. I'm in it to
spread that Yunyun luv.
entries.translated: I'm happy just being able to broadcast my love for Yunyun.

entries.japanese: 最近は、生放送とかゲーム配信が人気ゆん。
entries.original:
Streamers and let's players are super popular
these days.
entries.translated: Live streams and game streaming are really popular these days yun.

entries.japanese: うん。でも、わたしはゆんゆん以外興味ないヨ。
entries.original:
I guess. If it's not Yunyun, it's just a bunch
of hooey too me.
entries.translated: Yeah. But I'm not interested in anything besides Yunyun.

entries.japanese: Ｑちゃんは、夏がどんどん暑くなってると思うゆん？
entries.original: Do you think the summers are getting hotter, Qtie?
entries.translated: Q-chan, do you think summers are getting hotter and hotter yun?

entries.japanese:
さぁ？　どうだろう？
ママから電気代が高くなって怒られてはいるケド。
entries.original:
Huh? I dunno. Mommy has deffo gotten mad
about the electric bill being more expensive, tho.
entries.translated: I wonder? Hard to say. Mom has been getting mad about the electric bill getting more expensive though.

entries.japanese: Ｑちゃんにとって夏といえば？
entries.original: What do you associate summers with, Qtie?
entries.translated: What do you think of when you think of summer, Q-chan yun?

entries.japanese:
マシンガン！　もしくは、
夏だ！　海だ！　スク水ダ～？
entries.original:
Machine guns!
Also summer! The beach! Swimsuits!
entries.translated: Machine guns! Or maybe... Summer! The beach! School swimsuits!

entries.japanese:
ひとの記憶はふたしか……？
ねぇ、Ｑちゃんは去年の夏の思い出ってあるゆん？
entries.original:
Is human memory that bad? Qtie, what do you
remember from last summer?
entries.translated: Human memory is so unreliable... Hey, Q-chan, do you have any memories from last summer, yun?

entries.japanese:
わたし、季節感覚以前に、
曜日感覚がオワッテルような人間ダヨ？
entries.original:
I can't even remember what I did last week.
Last summer? Yeesh.
entries.translated: I'm the kind of person who can't even keep track of what day it is, let alone seasons.

entries.japanese:
そういえばゆんゆんとわたしって、
なにも契約をしてないけど大丈夫なのカナ？
entries.original:
Oh yeah. I never signed a contract with you
, even tho ur a demon, Yunyun. Is that chill?
entries.translated: Come to think of it, you and I never made any kind of contract, but that's okay?

entries.japanese:
契約は同意があれば成立ゆん。ゆんゆんとＱちゃんが、
こうして電波で繋がって過ごせているのが答えゆん。
entries.original: You didn't need to! We're connected through Denpa. In continuing to talk to me, you've already agreed to the terms and conditions!
entries.translated: A contract is formed when there's mutual agreement, yun. The fact that you and I are connected through denpa and spending time together is the answer, yun.

entries.japanese: 悪魔にも寿命ってあるのカナ？

悪魔は――フィクションの存在は、
みんなに覚えていてもらえる限り、不滅ゆん。
entries.original:
All fictional beings survive as long as someone
is around to remember them. Demons included!
entries.translated: Demons... fictional beings are immortal as long as people remember them, yun.

entries.japanese:
タナトフォビアだっけ、
いつか消えちゃうことを考えるとちょっぴり怖いよネ。
entries.original: I think they call it Thanatophobia? The thought of suddenly blipping out of existence one day is pretty spooky.
entries.translated: Thanatophobia, right? Thinking about disappearing someday is pretty scary.

entries.japanese:
ゆんゆんは、Ｑちゃんの魂と永遠に一緒ゆん。
だから、ぜったいにひとりじゃないゆん。大丈夫ゆん。
entries.original:
Yunyun will keep your soul company, even in the
afterlife. You'll never be alone Qtie-pie. Never.
entries.translated: Yunyun will be with Q-chan's soul forever, yun. So you'll never be alone, yun. It's okay, yun.

entries.japanese: そういえば、ゆんゆんのWikiもあるゆん。
entries.original: Oh! I have a Wiki profile too, don't I?
entries.translated: Oh, Yunyun has a Wiki page too, yun.

entries.japanese:
――ふっふっふ。素晴らしい提案をしよう 
キミもゆんゆんファンにならないか！
entries.original:
Huehue. I want you!
To join the Yunyun stan army.
entries.translated: Hehehe. I have a wonderful proposal... Why don't you become a Yunyun fan too!

entries.japanese:
Wikiのリンクを順番にたどって読んでいくのって、
ドキドキするゆん。
entries.original: I luuuuuv going down a Wiki rabbit hole!
entries.translated: Following Wikipedia links one after another is so exciting, yun.

entries.japanese: もはや死語だけど、ネットサーフィンって楽しいよネ。
entries.original:
The lost art of internet surfing. Ah.
Those were the days.
entries.translated: It's a dead term now, but internet surfing is fun.

entries.japanese:
伏せ字とか――カリギュラ効果をそそる文字をみると、
『検索してはいけない言葉』を思い出すゆん。
entries.original:
The Caligula effect! Anytime a word is censored,
you can't help but be more curious what it is!
entries.translated: When I see censored words, it reminds me of those 'words you shouldn't search' lists, yun.

entries.japanese:
検索は慎重に――うっかり検索すると、
同じ広告ばっかり出続けちゃうカモ？
entries.original: Careful with searching those censored words. The government guy reading your stuff could end up sending you some crazy ads.
entries.translated: Be careful searching. You might end up with the same ads everywhere.

entries.japanese:
◯◯の星のもとに生まれた～って言葉があるけど、
人工衛星も宿星のひとつかもしれないゆん。
entries.original:
I guess if being born under certain stars can
make a difference, so can satellites!
entries.translated: There's that saying about being born under a certain star... maybe satellites count as stars too, yun.

entries.japanese:
なるほど？人工衛星打ち上げ以降、
インターネット中毒者が多いのも、それが理由かもネ。
entries.original:
Checks out. Maybe the satellites are why everyone’s
internet addicted these days.
entries.translated: Makes sense. Maybe that's why there are so many internet addicts since satellites went up.

entries.japanese:
最新の占星術理論がほんとうなら、
人工衛星の配置で、運命変えられちゃうゆん！
entries.original:
If astrology is legit, than your whole destiny
could change cuz of some satellite up in space!
entries.translated: If the latest astrology theories are true, satellite positions could change your destiny, yun!

entries.japanese:
……わたしの人生がこうなってるのって、
もしかして人工衛星が原因……！？
entries.original:
Could a satellite be to blame for why my life
suxx so bad?!
entries.translated: ...Could a satellite be the reason my life turned out like this?!

entries.japanese:
人工衛星が壊れてると、その星のもとに生まれた
子供にも影響があるらしいゆん。
entries.original:
And if the satellite you were born under was broken,
you’d be in big trouble!
entries.translated: If the satellite is broken, it affects kids born under that star too, yun.

entries.japanese:
なるほど？少なくとも一台は、
深刻に壊れてるかもしれないってことだネ。
entries.original:
Welp. Sounds like at least one satellite is
seriously broken.
entries.translated: I see. So at least one of them must be seriously broken.

entries.japanese: Ｑちゃんのお部屋にもフィギュアがいくつかあるゆん！
entries.original:
You have lots of figures in your
room, don’t you Qtie?
entries.translated: Q-chan has a bunch of figures in her room too, yun!

entries.japanese:
デジタルもいいけど、
オタクたるもの、だいすきは形にしたいって思うからネ。
entries.original:
I’m usually good with 2D but... They’re so otaku!
And giving form to something you love is nice.
entries.translated: Digital's fine, but as an otaku, you want to give form to what you love.

entries.japanese:
はじめてゆんゆんのフィギュアを家に飾った日に、
ゆんゆんの星５オタクに近づけたって思えたんだよネ。
entries.original:
The day I first got my hands on a Yunyun figure,
I felt myself get closer to otaku enlightenment.
entries.translated: The first day I displayed a Yunyun figure at home, I felt like I'd gotten closer to five-star otaku status.

entries.japanese:
フィギュアがあってもなくても、
ゆんゆんを大好きって気持ちがあれば、星５ゆん！
entries.original:
With or without a figure, if you feel that
YUNYUN LUV, you’re an indoctrinated otaku!
entries.translated: With or without figures, if you love Yunyun, you're five-star, yun!

entries.japanese:
こうしてゆんゆんと喋れているのも、
フィギュアで邪神降臨の儀式を行っていたからカモ？
entries.original: Wait, did I accidentally perform some spirit ritual with my figures?! Is that how I’m talking with Yunyun?
entries.translated: Maybe I can talk to Yunyun like this because I performed some evil god summoning ritual with my figures?

entries.japanese:
ゆんゆんは邪神じゃなくて悪魔ゆん。それに、
ゆんゆんとＱちゃんのつながりは電波の奇跡が理由ゆん！
entries.original:
I’m not a spirit, I’m a demon! Plus, Qtie and I
are connected by the miracle of Denpa, nothing else!
entries.translated: Yunyun's not an evil god, she's a demon, yun. Besides, Yunyun and Q-chan's connection comes from the miracle of denpa!

entries.japanese:
星がぜんぶ偽物なら、
宇宙人に遭遇する可能性も０％ゆん！
entries.original:
If stars aren't real, that totally means that you've
got a 0% chance of ever meeting an alien!
entries.translated: If all the stars are fake, then the chance of meeting aliens is 0%, yun!

entries.japanese:
純愛の結果地球が肉塊まみれになったり、
敵性宇宙生物に襲われたりしない点では安心だネ。
entries.original:
That's a relief. Aliens leave weird meat spores
everywhere, or launch huge BETA invasions.
entries.translated: That's reassuring. No pure love turning Earth into a meat blob, or getting attacked by hostile alien life forms.

entries.japanese:
お空が全部プラネタリウムだったら、
流れ星の替え玉自由ゆん！
entries.original:
If the sky is a planetarium, I want 24/7
shooting stars!!
entries.translated: If the whole sky is a planetarium, I can have unlimited shooting star substitutes, yun!

entries.japanese: 世界線ガチャの発生だネ。
entries.original: It's like a gacha for World Lines!

entries.japanese: オタクってモールス信号が好きなイメージがあるゆん！
entries.original: All REAL otakus know Morse code! Right?
entries.translated: Otaku have this image of loving Morse code, yun!

entries.japanese:
みんなと同じはイヤだけど誰にも伝わらないのもイヤ。
――わかるひとだけに通じる言葉が好きなんだよネ。
entries.original: I don't wanna be mainstream, but I don't wanna be too niche either. I like having people around that get it.
entries.translated: I don't want to be like everyone else, but I don't want no one to get me either. I like words that only certain people understand.

entries.japanese:
そういえばＱちゃんは、Vtuberには興味ないゆん？
カワイイひとがたくさんいるゆん！
entries.original:
Qtie, what’s even the point of a Vtuber?
There’s already tons of cute, real people!
entries.translated: Speaking of which Q-chan, aren't you interested in Vtubers? There's lots of cute people, yun!

entries.japanese:
好きだけど、ゆんゆんほどじゃないカナ？Vtuberは、
二次元のオブラートに包んだドキュメンタリーだしネ。
entries.original: Eh, I like them, but none are as cute as you, Yunyun. Vtubers are just real people wrapped in a 2D package.
entries.translated: I like them, but not as much as you do. Vtubers are just documentaries wrapped in 2D.

entries.japanese:
動画プラットフォームが、
次から次へと増えていくゆん。
entries.original:
So many new video streaming platforms
these days, huh!
entries.translated: Video platforms keep popping up one after another, yun.

entries.japanese:
多すぎても調べたり選ぶのが疲れちゃうよネ。
ニタニタ動画（β）一強時代が恋しいヨ。
entries.original:
Too many for my brain to handle...
I miss the beta version of Nitanita.
entries.translated: Too many makes me tired from researching and choosing. I miss when Nitanita Video (β) dominated everything.

entries.japanese:
近頃はいろいろなところで『転生』っていう言葉が
流行ってるみたいゆん。
entries.original:
People are hooked on the word ‘reincarnation’
these days.
entries.translated: Lately the word 'reincarnation' seems to be trending everywhere, yun.

entries.japanese: 現実がツライせいだネ。

うぅぅ。
今でも月曜日って言葉を聞くだけで、虫酸が走るヨ。
entries.original:
eUuUGUgH. Even hearing the word Monday
gives me heartburn.
entries.translated: Ugh. Even just hearing the word Monday makes my skin crawl.

entries.japanese: 神様もきっと月曜日恐怖症だったゆん。
entries.original: Not even God is safe from the Monday Blues.
entries.translated: God must have had Monday phobia too, yun.

entries.japanese:
ヒキコモリニートには安息なんてないんだヨ。
罪悪感の針のむしろで、ずっとツライからネ。
entries.original:
Hikikomori neets have no day off. We’re
always suffering, on a bed of nails and guilt...
entries.translated: Hikikomori NEETs don't get any rest. We're always suffering on a bed of nails made of guilt.

entries.japanese:
Ｑちゃんは努力してるゆん！
生きて、幸せでいてくれたら★５ゆん！
entries.original:
Whoa Qtie! You’re doing your best, and that’s
five stars in my book!
entries.translated: Q-chan is working hard, yun! Just living and being happy makes you five stars, yun!

entries.japanese:
この陰謀論のおかげで月曜日がお休みになったら、
みんなハッピーになるはずゆん！
entries.original:
If we get Mondays off thanks to these secret
society guys, I’m sure everyone would be hype!
entries.translated: If this conspiracy theory gets us Mondays off, everyone's gonna be happy, yun!

entries.japanese:
そうだね！あれ……でも……、
そもそも今日って何曜日だっけ？
entries.original:
Right!! Erm... hey...
What day of the week is it anyway?
entries.translated: True! Wait... but... what day of the week is it anyway?

entries.japanese:
ミリオネアがニート？たしかにほんとうの
お金もちほどひっそりとした生活をしてるって聞くケド。
entries.original:
Millionaires are NEETs? I have heard that the
really real rich people take their money
and go off grid.
entries.translated: Millionaires are NEETs? I guess I have heard that really rich people live quietly.

entries.original: Could it be... Qtie are you secretly RICH?
entries.translated: ...Could it be... Q-chan, are you secretly...?

entries.japanese: はぁ。同じニートだとしてもわたしとはまるで違うネ。
entries.original: Come on, we're both NEETs, but we're totally different.
entries.translated: Sigh. Even if we're both NEETs, we're completely different.

entries.japanese:
Ｑちゃんはオンリーワンの存在で、
ゆんゆんのとくべつだから、それは仕方ないゆん！
entries.original:
You're not standard! You're Yunyun's limited
edition, SSR, five star, one and only Qtie-pie!
entries.translated: Q-chan is one of a kind and special to Yunyun, so that's only natural, yun!

entries.japanese: ……永遠の余暇を持つ高貴なる者……。
entries.original: NEETs are Nobles of Elegant Eternal Time...?

entries.japanese:
前のお家は――パパが契約してくれてたから、
ＢＳ有料放送でいろいろなアニメを見れたんだよネ。
entries.original:
When Daddy was still around we had cable TV.
We used to binge anime together all the time.
entries.translated: Back at our old place, Dad had paid for satellite TV, so I could watch all kinds of anime on the premium channels.

entries.japanese:
アニメの一挙放送を耐久で観るのは、
ちょっとしたお祭りゆん。
entries.original:
Watching a marathon was almost as intense
as running one!!
entries.translated: Watching anime marathons is like a little festival, yun!

entries.japanese:
ゆんゆん好き同志っていうきっかけで、
海外のオタク友達ができたこともあるんだヨ。
entries.original:
I've made some international friends online
cuz we bonded over Yunyun!
entries.translated: I've even made some overseas otaku friends because we bonded over Yunyun.

entries.japanese: 好きの電波は、世界を超えるゆん！
entries.original: Denpa without borders! That's so awesomesauce!
entries.translated: The denpa of love crosses all borders, yun!

entries.japanese:
好きな作品が、
いろいろな環境のせいで見れないのはツライゆん。
entries.original:
It hurts when they lock your favorite content
behind a paywall.
entries.translated: It's painful when you can't watch your favorite shows because of all these restrictions, yun.

entries.japanese:
アニメもゲームも小説も。環境に関係なく、
誰もがもっとかんたんに楽しめるといいんだけどネ。
entries.original: For realz. Doesn't matter if it's anime, manga or novels, I just want a future where media is for all......
entries.translated: Anime, games, novels... I wish everyone could enjoy them more easily, regardless of their situation.

entries.japanese: Ｑちゃんも電子マネーは使ってるゆん？
entries.original: Does Qtie have a digital wallet too?
entries.translated: Does Q-chan use digital money too, yun?

entries.japanese:
ＢＩＴＭＯＥＥっていうのは使ってるヨ。
ゲームのダウンロード版購入に便利なんだよネ。
entries.original:
Yeah, I've got one called BITMOEE. I use it for
in-game micro-transactions.
entries.translated: I use something called BITMOEE. It's convenient for buying downloadable games.

entries.japanese: Ｑちゃんは欲しいものがあるとき、どうしてるゆん？
entries.original:
What happens when Qtie wants to do some
retail therapy?
entries.translated: What does Q-chan do when there's something you want, yun?

entries.japanese:
貰ってたお小遣いやお年玉の貯金を
ちょっとずつ切り崩してるヨ。
entries.original:
I usually have some pocket money or something
left from the holidays to use.
entries.translated: I gradually use up the allowance and New Year's money I've been saving.

entries.japanese: オタクの電波が経済を回してるゆん！
entries.original: Otakus are hella contributors to the economy!
entries.translated: Otaku denpa drives the economy, yun!

entries.japanese:
そういう話を聞くと、
同じオタクとしてちょっとだけ誇らしいよネ。
entries.original:
Huh. I guess I do contribute to society. In that
one, single way.
entries.translated: Hearing that makes me a little proud as a fellow otaku.

entries.japanese:
『処刑天使†ギルティーナ』は男性向け作品だけど、
Ｑちゃんはどうして好きになったゆん？
entries.original:
Come to think of it, "Execution Angel † Guiltina"
is a boy show. How come you like it, Qtie?
entries.translated: 'Execution Angel † Guiltina' is aimed at guys, so how come you like it, Q-chan, yun?

entries.japanese:
ゆんゆんにとにかく萌えたからダヨ！萌えの前じゃ、
男性向けも女性向けもＨＬもＧＬもＢＬも関係ないよネ！
entries.original: Because you're so moe, Yunyun! Moe transcends labels like male, female, HL, GL and BL!
entries.translated: Because you're so moe, Yunyun! When it comes to moe, it doesn't matter if it's for guys, girls, HL, GL, or BL!

entries.japanese:
思い通りの――理想の子供がつくれる世界がきたら、
わたしは生まれなかったかもネ。
entries.original:
If Mommy and Daddy had been able to customize
their kid, I prolly would've never been born.
entries.translated: If we lived in a world where people could make their ideal kids, I probably wouldn't have been born.

entries.japanese: 奇跡で生まれたＱちゃんの存在は、まさに★５ゆん！
entries.original: Then it's a MIRACLE you were! My five-star Qtie-pie!
entries.translated: Then Q-chan's miraculous existence is totally five-star, yun!

entries.japanese:
人生の延長線沿いに、
誰かの親になるってビジョンが全然わかないよネ。
entries.original:
No way I'm ever going to be a parent. I can't
even imagine it.
entries.translated: I can't picture myself ever becoming someone's parent down the line.

entries.japanese:
Ｑちゃんの人生はＱちゃんのものゆん。
Ｑちゃんが笑顔なら、なにも気にしなくていいゆん。
entries.original:
You gotta do you, Qtie! As long as what you do makes
you happy, I'm happy!
entries.translated: Q-chan's life belongs to Q-chan, yun. As long as Q-chan's happy, nothing else matters, yun.

entries.japanese: Ｑちゃんは、ガチャゲーはしないゆん？
entries.original: Do you play gacha games, Qtie?
entries.translated: Q-chan, do you play gacha games, yun?

entries.japanese:
してないけど、ゆんゆんのゲームが出たらするヨ？
全財産投じてでも、ゆんゆんへの愛に報いるカラ！
entries.original: Nah, but if a Yunyun themed one got released I probably would. My wallet would be empty, but Yunyun luv is worth it all!
entries.translated: I don't, but if a Yunyun game came out I would. I'd throw my entire fortune at it to show my love for Yunyun!

entries.japanese:
電波ソング。ガチャ。ＭＡＤ動画。
デジタルの世界は、電子ドラッグでいっぱいゆん。
entries.original:
Denpa songs, gacha games, AMVs...
There's lots of addicting stuff on the web.
entries.translated: Denpa songs. Gacha. MAD videos. The digital world is full of electronic drugs, yun.

entries.japanese:
でも、わたしにとって一番の電子ドラッグは、
ゆんゆんの声だヨ！
entries.original:
My drug of choice is Yunyun's demonically
kawaii voice!
entries.translated: But for me, the best electronic drug is Yunyun's voice!

entries.japanese:
そもそも愚民政策って、不幸なことなのカナ？
おバカなほうが笑顔で幸せに生きられると思うケド。
entries.original: What's so bad about brainwashing anywayz? Didn't that book with the mouse prove that we're happier the dumber we are?
entries.translated: Is dumbing down the masses really such a bad thing? I think being stupid lets you live happier with a smile.

entries.japanese: 支配・従属・美しく。持ちつ・持たれつゆん。
entries.original:
Elegant domination and subordination is a
give and take! Classic Denpa nonsense.
entries.translated: Control and submission, beautifully. Give and take, yun.

entries.japanese:
すごい陰謀論だけど前からネットで見かける話だよネ。
フィンランドが存在しないなんて話もたしかあったハズ。
entries.original:
This one’s funny, but old as conspiracy theories go.
I’ve seen people say Finland isn’t real, either.
entries.translated: It's a wild conspiracy theory, but I've seen this stuff online before. There was also that thing about Finland not existing.

entries.japanese:
はぇ～？
インターネットには哲学者が多いゆん。
entries.original:
Srsly?!
Bunch of philosophers out here on the internet.
entries.translated: Huh? The internet's got a lot of philosophers, yun.

entries.japanese:
実在するとは思えないような動物って結構いるよネ。
『は゛あ゛あ゛』って叫ぶビーバーとか。
entries.original:
There are lots of animals that don’t seem real.
Like, that one beaver that screamed like a dude!
entries.translated: There are plenty of animals that don't seem like they could be real. Like that beaver that goes 'AHHHHH.'

entries.japanese: それはネット上にしか存在しない生き物ゆん。
entries.original:
I’m pretty sure that beaver only exists
in edited audio form, Qtie.
entries.translated: That's a creature that only exists on the internet, yun.

entries.japanese: Ｑちゃんは好きなＵＭＡとかっているゆん？
entries.translated: Q-chan, do you have a favorite cryptid, yun?

entries.japanese: ある意味『ゆんゆん』カモ？

特定のオタクとは言葉のキャッチボールが
出来ないこと通じないことってあるよネ。
entries.original: Otakus suuuuck at making snappy comebacks tho.
entries.translated: Some otakus just can't hold a conversation, you know? Like, you can't get through to them at all.

entries.japanese:
言葉のキャッチボールじゃなくて、
言葉のドッジボールをしてるパターンゆん。
entries.original:
They don't make comebacks so much as they
fall back! Retreat! Retreat!
entries.translated: It's not like they're playing catch with words... more like dodgeball, yun.

entries.japanese: わたしはＳ派でもＭ派でもなく、Ｙ派ダヨ！
entries.original: I'm not a sadist or a masochist! I'm a YUNYUNist!
entries.translated: I'm not S or M... I'm Y! Y for Yunyun!

entries.japanese: ふふ。だったらゆんゆんは、Ｑ派ゆん！
entries.original: Eheehee! Then Yunyun is a QTIEist!
entries.translated: Fufu. Then Yunyun is Q派, yun!

entries.japanese:
わたしも、ゆんゆんの喋り方を真似れば、
可愛くて天使みたいな子になれるゆん？
entries.original:
Does that mean if I talk like Yunyun, I'll be
just as angelically kawaii?!
entries.translated: If I copy the way Yunyun talks, will I become a cute, angelic girl too, yun?

entries.japanese: ゆんゆんは小悪魔だゆん。
entries.translated: Yunyun's more of a little devil, yun.

entries.japanese: Ｑちゃんは怖い話、平気ゆん？
entries.original: This is getting creepy. Aren't you freaked, Qtie?
entries.translated: Are you okay with scary stories, Q-chan, yun?

entries.japanese:
普通くらいカナ？『ネットロア』系なら、
１日２２時間くらい読み漁ってた時期もあるヨ。
entries.original:
Who me? I used to spend 20 plus hours a DAY
reading creepypastas on the net. This is cheese.
entries.translated: I'm fine with them, I guess? I went through a phase where I'd read creepypasta for like 22 hours a day.

entries.japanese:
恥ずかしいけど、昔はネットの情報を鵜呑みにして、
悪魔召喚にも挑戦したことがあったんだよネ。
entries.original:
It's pretty cringe now, but I used to be so into
the dark, I'd even try and summon demons and stuff.
entries.translated: This is embarrassing, but I used to believe everything I read online and even tried summoning demons.

entries.japanese:
悪魔を信じるピュアなＱちゃんも、
可愛くてステキゆん！
entries.original: Ugh. Even as a naive demon worshiper, ur SUCH a QT!
entries.translated: Pure Q-chan believing in demons is so cute and wonderful, yun!

entries.japanese:
怖い話をしてるとほんもののオバケがやってくるって
話を聞くゆん！
entries.original:
I've heard there are tons of monsters that only
appear if you say their name!
entries.translated: I heard that if you tell scary stories, real ghosts actually show up, yun!

entries.japanese:
ゆんゆんのことだけ考えてたら、
ゆんゆんが現れたわけだし……信憑性あるカモ？
entries.original:
I got so obsessed with Yunyun, she appeared...
Does that mean I actually summoned a demon?!
entries.translated: I was thinking about Yunyun so much that she appeared... Maybe there's something to it?

entries.japanese:
世界がパスタで出来てるって理論があるなら、
ゆんゆんが世界を創造したって宗教もありじゃないカナ？
entries.original: Now I've seen it all. If the world can be made out of pasta, I should start the official Yunyun religion.
entries.translated: If there's a theory that the world is made of pasta, then maybe a religion where Yunyun created the world isn't so crazy?

entries.japanese:
ＰＣゲームのキャラクターが
神様になる世界なんてめちゃくちゃゆん。
entries.original:
A world where a PC game character can become
God has seriously got some issues!
entries.translated: A world where PC game characters can become gods is totally messed up, yun.

entries.japanese:
そういえば『処刑天使†ギルティーナ』のゲームって、
ものすごいスパゲッティコードらしいヨ？
entries.original:
Oooh, I heard the source code for "Execution
Angel † Guiltina" was some serious spaghetti!
entries.translated: Speaking of which, I heard the code for "Execution Angel † Guiltina" is complete spaghetti code.

entries.original: Who cares? As long as it's playable, tbh.
entries.translated: If it works, it's good enough, yun!

entries.japanese:
宇宙科学の動画とか記事とかを見てると、
宇宙の壮大さやスゴさに圧倒されちゃうよネ。
entries.original: Seeing pics from space or reading astronaut journal entries gives me the shivers. The universe is frickin’ amazing.
entries.translated: When I watch space science videos or read articles, I get totally overwhelmed by how vast and amazing the universe is.

entries.japanese:
そんな宇宙のスゴさも、
知ってくれるＱちゃんがいてこそのものゆん！
entries.original:
The universe would be nothing without
you in it, Qtie!
entries.translated: But all that amazing stuff about the universe only matters because Q-chan is there to appreciate it, yun!

entries.japanese:
DHMOのジョークを参考にしたら、
ゆんゆんだって危険なものになっちゃうかもネ？
entries.original:
With this way of thinking, even Yunyun turns
into some kind of dangerous thing.
entries.translated: If we use the DHMO joke as a reference, even Yunyun could be made to sound dangerous.

entries.japanese:
……『ゆんゆん』を知ってしまったひとの、
１０００年生存率は０％ゆん……！
entries.original:
Yup! 100% of people who have ever known me
have eventually died!
entries.translated: ...The 1000-year survival rate of people who have known 'Yunyun' is 0%, yun...!

entries.japanese: Ｑちゃんはお酒を飲んだりしないゆん？
entries.original: Qtie, do you drink alcohol at all?
entries.translated: Q-chan, don't you drink alcohol yun?

entries.japanese: ふふん。お酒よりも、ゆんゆんだからネ！
entries.original: Heh. Who needs to drink when I can get dЯunk off YUNYUN!
entries.translated: Hehe. I don't need alcohol when I've got Yunyun!

entries.japanese:
好きなものを食べて、飲んで、楽しんで！
ストレスのない生活が一番健康的ゆん！
entries.original: It’s all about eating, drinking, doing whatever ya want! The healthiest lifestyle is one with no stress.
entries.translated: Eat what you want, drink what you want, have fun! A stress-free life is the healthiest yun!

entries.japanese: ゆんゆんさえいればＯＫです。
entries.original: All I want is you, Yunyun.
entries.translated: As long as I have Yunyun, I'm good.

entries.japanese:
鳥が決まって電線のうえで止まってるのって
たしかにちょっと不思議ゆん。
entries.original:
Birds are pretty creepy when they just perch on
power lines like that.
entries.translated: It is kind of weird how birds always perch on power lines like that yun.

entries.japanese:
そういう光景を長らく見てない気がするんだけど、
これまた不思議な感じがしちゃうよネ。
entries.original:
True... It doesn't happen too often, but when
it does? Yikes.
entries.translated: I feel like I haven't seen that in a while, which is also weird.

entries.japanese:
近頃ママに電気代で怒られてるのってもしかして、
鳥型ドローンが電気泥棒をしてるカラ……？
entries.original:
Mommy has been pissed that the electric bill
is so expensive recently. It's cuz of bird drones?
entries.translated: Maybe Mom's been mad about the electric bill lately because bird drones are stealing our power?
We found the real culprits yun!

entries.japanese:
未知を探索するのってドキドキするヨネ。
はじめてインターネットにダイブした夜を思い出すヨ。
entries.original: Ohoho! Nothing like an adventure to the unknown to get you all psyched up. Reminds me of the first time I logged on to the internet.
entries.translated: Exploring the unknown gets your heart racing. Reminds me of my first night diving into the internet.

entries.japanese:
Ｑちゃんはなにがきっかけで、
ゲームやインターネットに触れはじめたゆん？
entries.original: What's your internet origin story, Qtie?
entries.translated: What got you into games and the internet, yun?

entries.japanese:
パパの置いていったパソコンやゲームを興味本位で
触っていて――気づけばオタク暗黒大陸のど真ん中ダヨ。
entries.original: Daddy's computer had some games on it that I liked. Before I knew it, I was neck deep in the otaku quicksand.
entries.translated: Dad left his computer and games behind. I got curious and started messing around with them... next thing I knew, I was deep in the otaku wasteland.

entries.japanese:
北極舞台の作品って危険な宇宙生物がよく出るよネ。
やっぱり、自室でのヒキコモリが一番安全ダヨ。
entries.original: Stories set in the Arctic always end with some freaky bad-news aliens showing up. Man I'm glad I'm a hikikomori sometimes.
entries.translated: Stories set in the Arctic always have dangerous alien creatures showing up. Staying holed up in my room is definitely the safest option.

entries.japanese:
Ｑちゃんの場合は、
『妄想からの電波体Ｙ』って状況ゆん。
entries.original:
Yup! The only Thing Qtie has to worry about
is your Denpa delusions!
entries.translated: In Q-chan's case, it's more like 'Denpa Entity Y from Delusions,' yun.

entries.japanese: 人工地震ってほんとうにあるゆん？
entries.original:
Why would anyone make an earthquake happen
on purpose?
entries.translated: Do artificial earthquakes really exist, yun?

entries.japanese:
某大学地下で核実験をしてるとかっていう
ネットジョークは一時期よく見かけたけどネ。
entries.original: Internet trolls have always liked to say earthquakes are caused by secret experiments under universities!
entries.translated: There used to be internet jokes about certain universities doing nuclear experiments underground.

entries.japanese:
ニュースの話が本当なら、Ｑちゃんの陰謀論で
世界が少し平和に近づいたゆん！！
entries.original:
OMG Qtie! If this is true, one of your antennas
just made the world a better place!
entries.translated: If the news is true, then Q-chan's conspiracy theories just made the world a little more peaceful, yun!

entries.japanese:
悲しいニュースで
アニメ枠が潰されることが減ったならいいんだけどネ。
entries.original:
I'd rather he put his efforts into bringing back
the prime time anime slot on TV, but OK.
entries.translated: I'd be happy if it means fewer anime slots getting cancelled for breaking news.

entries.japanese:
深夜アニメの協賛っていうと、
音楽レーベルやグッズメーカーが多いイメージゆん。
entries.original:
When I think late-night anime sponsors, I think
music labels and as seen on TV stuff.
entries.translated: When I think of late-night anime sponsors, I picture music labels and merchandise companies, yun.

entries.japanese:
讃美歌に偶像崇拝――。
宗教に使える要素が一通りそろってるカモ？
entries.original:
Religion is all about idol worship.
Guess there's a lot in common with fandom.
entries.translated: Hymns and idol worship... looks like it has all the elements religion needs.

entries.japanese:
技術が発展するにつれて、
どこで誰にどう監視されてるかわからないゆん。
entries.original:
With all this new tech, you never know when or how
Big Bro is watching you.
entries.translated: As technology keeps advancing, you never know where, when, or how someone might be watching you, yun.

entries.japanese:
そんなあなたに、
ヒキコモリという最強の個人情報保護をご提案だヨ！
entries.original: Oh I know! The best way to make sure you're never under surveillance is to never leave the house! Hikikomori supremacy!
entries.translated: For someone like you, I propose the ultimate personal information protection: being a hikikomori!

entries.japanese: #覚醒したオタクは妄想力で推しキャラと会話できる
entries.original: #The awakened otakus are using their imagination to converse with their oshis
entries.translated: #Awakened otaku can talk to their oshi characters through pure imagination

entries.japanese: #創作は別次元の現象を脳が受信して生まれている
entries.original: #Fiction is created when the brain receives signals from phenomena in other dimensions
entries.translated: #Fiction is born when the brain picks up denpa from other dimensions

entries.japanese: #ぬこは地球の支配者で猫動画はそのプロバガンダ
entries.original: #Kitty cats are the true rulers of Earth and cat videos are propaganda
entries.translated: #Nuko are Earth's true rulers and cat videos are their propaganda

entries.japanese: #絶叫するビーバーは地底人で地表侵略活動を行っている
entries.original: #The Screaming Beaver is an Agarthan and plans to take over the surface
entries.translated: #The Screaming Beaver is underground people planning surface invasion

entries.japanese: #宇宙人は時間旅行者で推し活のために来訪している
entries.original: #Aliens are time travelers and are visiting to engage in oshikatsu
entries.translated: #Aliens are time travelers visiting for oshi activities

entries.japanese: #レプティリアンは泣きゲーでこころを学ぼうとしている
entries.original: #Reptilians are learning about feelings by playing nakige
entries.translated: #Reptilians are trying to learn emotions through nakige

entries.japanese: #悪魔崇拝者は恋愛コンテンツで人間の生産性を貶めている
entries.original: #The romance genre is used by Reptilians to belittle human productivity
entries.translated: #Devil worshippers use romance content to undermine human productivity

entries.japanese: #ネットの書き込みはすべてボットで人間はひとりもいない
entries.original: #Posts on the net are all written by bots and none of them are by humans
entries.translated: #Every post online is written by bots with zero humans

entries.japanese: #Ｑちゃんは架空の存在でゲームのキャラクターである
entries.original: #Qtie is completely fictional and a character from a game
entries.translated: #Q-chan is fictional and a game character

entries.japanese: #ゆんゆんは絶対神で信者だけが救済される
entries.original: #Yunyun is the supreme goddess and only believers will be saved
entries.translated: #Yunyun is the absolute goddess and only believers get salvation

entries.japanese: #ニチアサは魔術結社がスポンサーで魔法適正を選別している

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者による陰謀論「太陽は人間の発明品で
光で庶民を下僕化している」が話題だ。著名人がサ
ングラスを愛用するのは、真実を知っており――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antenna conspiracy theorists have devised that sunlight must somehow be used to hypnotize the masses. This is why celebrities always wear sunglasses, and only they know the truth―
entries.translated: Q denpa receivers are buzzing about a conspiracy theory that "the sun is a human invention used to enslave the masses with light." The reason celebrities always wear sunglasses is because they know the truth...

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者による陰謀論「学校の怪談は日陰者の
生徒の怨念で陽キャを執拗に狙っている」が話題だ。
怪談の舞台は、イジメが行われた場所が多く――。
entries.original: A recent Qtie Denpa Antenna conspiracy states that Yokai which haunt schools are fueled by the grudges of bullied students, and target popular kids. Yokai outbreaks have correlated with reports of bullying―
entries.translated: Q denpa receivers are discussing a conspiracy theory that "school ghost stories are the vengeful spirits of outcast students targeting popular kids." Most haunted locations coincide with places where bullying occurred...

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者による陰謀論「SNSは邪神降臨の儀
式で意図的に悪感情を高めている」が話題だ。悪
感情を持つ投稿は最大100倍拡散されやすく――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas' new conspiracy states that social media platforms are purposefully cultivating hatred and negative emotions to fuel a ritual to summon the Devil onto earth. Negative posts are 100 times more likely to succeed in the algorithm―
entries.translated: Q denpa receivers are talking about a conspiracy theory that "social media is a ritual to summon evil gods by intentionally amplifying negative emotions." Posts with bad vibes spread up to 100 times faster...

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者による陰謀論「打ち切り漫画の大半は
パトロンの出資で秘密裏に連載を続けている」が話
題だ。事実であって欲しいというファンの叫び――。
entries.original: A recent Qtie Denpa Antenna conspiracy claims that the majority of manga series that get 'canceled' are actually just under exclusive production for patrons only. Fans are eager to become one of these manga gatekeepers―
entries.translated: Q denpa receivers are buzzing about a conspiracy theory that "most canceled manga are secretly continuing with patron funding." It's the desperate cry of fans hoping it's true...

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者による陰謀論「ゲーム業界は秘密結社
が元締めでAND YOU は結社の名前」が話題だ。
クレジット最後の表記が背後にいる秘密結社――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas are conspiring that the gaming industry is run by a secret society that goes by the name AND YOU. They claim you can find the name in the credits of every single video game―
entries.translated: The denpa crowd is buzzing about a Q conspiracy theory: "The gaming industry is run by a secret society called AND YOU." The credits at the end of every game reveal the secret society pulling the strings...

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者による陰謀論「スパチャは三百人委員
会の会議で発言権を得るための制度が元ネタ」が話
題だ。金銭で発言権を得る行為がブルジャワ的――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antenna conspiracy theorists are claiming that superchats mimic the Committee of 300 in the way it only gives voice and influence to the wealthy. Buying their way into power is a common practice among the bourgeois―
entries.translated: The denpa crowd is buzzing about a Q conspiracy theory: "Superchats are based on the Committee of 300's system for buying speaking rights." Using money to gain influence is so bourgeois...

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者による陰謀論「猫の毛は生体ベリチッ
プで飼主の脳波を支配している」が話題だ。ＳＮＳ
上の飼主たちは支配されていることを認め――。
entries.original: One Denpa lover conspiracy claims that cat hair is like a VeriChip, and is shed and affixed to eventually control the minds of their owners. Could all pet owners be puppets?
entries.translated: The denpa crowd is buzzing about a Q conspiracy theory: "Cat hair acts like biological VeriChips to control their owners' brainwaves." Pet owners on social media are admitting they're being controlled...

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者による陰謀論「地球温暖化は嘘で過去
の暑さを忘れてるだけ」が話題だ。「確かに去年の夏
が何度だったかまでは即答できない」など――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas are claiming that Climate Change isn't real, and we're all just forgetting how hot it was in years before. Folks online are hesitantly agreeing that they can't seem to recall temperatures from―
entries.translated: The denpa crowd is buzzing about a Q conspiracy theory: "Global warming is fake, we're just forgetting how hot it used to be." People are saying things like "I can't instantly recall what temperature it was last summer"...

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者による陰謀論「やる気が切れるのは世
界の再起動が原因で世界五分前仮説を証明してい
る」が話題だ。俺達は悪くなかったと――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antenna conspiracy theorists claim that how often they lose motivation is due to the world rebooting according to the Five Minute Hypothesis. See? It's not my fault I―
entries.translated: The denpa crowd is buzzing about a Q conspiracy theory: "Losing motivation is caused by the world rebooting, proving the Five Minute Hypothesis." It wasn't our fault after all...

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者による陰謀論「遺伝子は創造主との契
約書で死を条件に繁殖が許可されている」が話題だ。
「解約させてくれ」「同意した記憶ない」など――。
entries.original: A recent Qtie Denpa Antenna conspiracy states our genetic code is the body of a contract we made with our Creator, and death is the condition for attaining the power to make new life. Plenty of folk are asking to be released from said contract―
entries.translated: The denpa crowd is buzzing about a Q conspiracy theory: "DNA is a contract with the Creator, trading death for the right to reproduce." People are saying "Let me out of this contract" and "I don't remember agreeing to this"...

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者による陰謀論「恐竜は遺伝子組換えの
ニワトリで時間旅行者の家畜が野生化した」が話題
だ。未来のフライドチキンのサイズも議論の――。
entries.original: A recent Qtie Denpa Antenna conspiracy states that dinosaurs are rogue, genetically altered chickens that time travelers brought back from the future. It is suspected the genetic experimentation began in order to make jumbo drumsticks―
entries.translated: The denpa crowd is buzzing about a Q conspiracy theory: "Dinosaurs were genetically modified chickens brought by time travelers that went feral." The size of future fried chicken is also being debated...

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者による陰謀論「雲は水ではなく思念の
具現体でイベント雲はリビドーが原因」が話題だ。
イベント雲は、ひとの汗が原因とされるが――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas are theorizing that clouds are not formed of water, but from thought, and sweat clouds that form at comic and anime conventions are made of pure desire. Better that than sweat, some say―
entries.translated: The denpa crowd is buzzing about a Q conspiracy theory: "Clouds aren't water but materialized thoughts, and convention clouds are caused by libido." Convention clouds are supposedly caused by human sweat, but...

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者による陰謀論「Wikiの削除履歴は
政府干渉の判断材料でIPが変な削除履歴は検
閲」が話題だ。Wikiの情報を不確かとする――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antenna conspiracy theorists claim that repeated deletion of Wiki entries is an act of government censorship. Debates on the reliability of Wiki are now in full swing―
entries.translated: The denpa crowd is buzzing about a Q conspiracy theory: "Wiki deletion history shows government interference, weird IP deletions are censorship." This calls Wiki information reliability into question...

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者による陰謀論「出産日は人工衛星の軌
道でコントロールされている」が話題だ。出産日だ
けでなく、占星術的な運命についても支配――。
entries.original: A new Qtie Denpa Antenna conspiracy states that satellites are beaming down signals which determine the day you're born. Some are even saying they determine your destiny via astrology―
entries.translated: The denpa crowd is buzzing about a Q conspiracy theory: "Birth dates are controlled by satellite orbits." Not just birth dates, but astrological destiny is also being controlled...

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者による陰謀論「インスタント食品は超
能力覚醒効果あるので不健康な印象操作がされてい
る」が話題だ。常食者からはツッコミもあるが――。
entries.original: Denpa lover conspiracy theorists say that the image of instant meals being unhealthy is a cover up to hide the fact that they give you ESP capabilities. Dietitians have also been weighing in on the matter.
entries.translated: The denpa crowd is buzzing about a Q conspiracy theory: "Instant foods have ESP awakening effects, so they're made to look unhealthy on purpose." Regular consumers are pushing back though...

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者による陰謀論「分散型SNSには往年
のインターネットで発生した妖精が生き残ってい
る」が話題だ。自称妖精さんたちは肯定的に――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas are asserting that fairies which lived inside of the internet at its first inception survived and are living on in distributed social network sites. Some have come forward to confirm the theory, claiming fairyhood―
entries.translated: The denpa crowd is buzzing about a Q conspiracy theory: "Fairies from the early internet survived and live on in decentralized social networks." Self-proclaimed fairies are responding positively...

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者による陰謀論「フィギュア文化は邪神
降臨の儀式で流通メーカーは秘密結社の傘下」が話
題だ。偶像崇拝という意味ではたしかにと――。
entries.original: A Denpa lover conspiracy asserts that figurine culture is circulated by a secret society of religious heretics, and the figures themselves are instruments in a demonic summoning ritual.
entries.translated: The denpa crowd is buzzing about a Q conspiracy theory: "Figure culture is a ritual for summoning evil gods and manufacturers are controlled by secret societies." In terms of idol worship, they have a point...

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者による陰謀論「星は偽物で宇宙は存在
していない」が話題だ。科学者はもちろんとして、
宇宙人を信奉する人々からも激しい批判が――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antenna conspiracy theorists are saying that stars aren't real, and the entire concept of the universe is a lie. Scientists and alien conspirators alike are being criticized―
entries.translated: The denpa crowd is buzzing about a Q conspiracy theory: "Stars are fake and space doesn't exist." Not just scientists, but alien believers are also harshly criticizing this...

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者による陰謀論「VtuberはVtubeという
会社のPRで新規動画サービスがはじまる」が話題だ。
たしかにそういう配信サービスがあれば話題に――。
entries.original: Denpa lovers are saying that a new video streaming service catering only to Vtubers is on the horizon. "Vtube," as they call it, would definitely cause a stir.
entries.translated: The denpa crowd is buzzing about a Q conspiracy theory: "Vtubers are PR for a company called Vtube launching a new video service." A streaming service like that would definitely cause a stir...

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者による陰謀論「AIはAgent Incoの略で
裏でインコが対応している」が話題だ。先進AI研究
施設近辺でインコの鳴き声がするという情報も――。
entries.original: A Qtie Denpa Antenna conspiracy is claiming that AI stands for Agent Ibis, and the engines are being run by ibis birds behind the scenes. Folk have since reported hearing ibis calls coming from AI research and data centers.
entries.translated: The denpa crowd is buzzing about a Q conspiracy theory: "AI stands for Agent Inco and parrots are running things behind the scenes." There are reports of parrot sounds coming from advanced AI research facilities...

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者による陰謀論「月曜日は神のサボり日
で天と地はもともと別れていた」が話題だ。神が週
の始まりに労働していた記述が後世の加筆で――。
entries.original: Denpa lovers have declared that God hates Mondays, and He and His angels take the day off. That God would work on Mondays is revisionist history.
entries.translated: The denpa crowd is buzzing about a Q conspiracy theory: "Monday is God's day off and heaven and earth were originally separate." The description of God working at the start of the week was added by later writers...

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者による陰謀論「ミリオネアはすべて影
武者でほんものは家でニートをしている」が話題だ。
「俺も実はミリオネアなのかもしれない」と――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas are theorizing that all millionaires are actually NEETs who pay stunt doubles to act out their lives for them. With all that money, why leave the mansion?
entries.translated: The denpa crowd is buzzing about a Q conspiracy theory: "All millionaires use body doubles while the real ones stay home as NEETs." People are saying "Maybe I'm actually a millionaire too"...

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者による陰謀論「衛星放送は宇宙人も視
聴者で視聴データが証明している」が話題だ。彼ら
は「アニメ専門チャンネル」を見ている――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas are claiming that viewer data proves that aliens are tuning into satellite TV. Reports say they particularly enjoy anime broadcasting channels―
entries.translated: The denpa crowd is buzzing about a Q conspiracy theory: "Aliens also watch satellite TV and the viewing data proves it." They're watching "anime specialty channels"...

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者による陰謀論「電子マネーは『神の見
えざる手』の数値化で神の実存を観測している」が
話題だ。厨二病心をくすぐる設定だとして――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas are conspiring that contactless payment methods are a form of divine intervention. The hand of God is invisible, so they say, and those with religious trauma are―
entries.translated: The denpa crowd is buzzing about a Q conspiracy theory: "Electronic money is the digitization of 'God's invisible hand' and we're observing divine existence." It's being praised as a setting that appeals to chunibyo hearts...

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者による陰謀論「ボーダーレスは医療機
関の思惑で人工子宮の需要増加が目的」が話題だ。
ＳＦ愛好者からの感心と人権団体からの批判――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas are saying that medical institutions are in cahoots with the NWO to promote the usage of artificial wombs. Sci-fi lovers are ecstatic, others are downright disturbed by these modern eugenics―
entries.translated: Q denpa receivers are spreading the conspiracy theory that 'Borderless is a medical industry scheme to increase artificial womb demand.' Sci-fi fans are impressed while human rights groups criticize it.

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者による陰謀論「ソシャゲは愚民政策ツ
ールでガチャ演出は電子ドラッグ」が話題だ。ＳN
Ｓでは「違いない」と納得をする声が多く――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antenna's new conspiracy claims that gacha games brainwash players with rare pull animations as addictive as any drug. Many chronic gacha addicts are coming forward to confirm―
entries.translated: Q denpa receivers are spreading the conspiracy theory that 'mobile games are tools for dumbing down the masses and gacha animations are electronic drugs.' Many on social media agree, saying 'That's exactly right.'

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者による陰謀論「オーストラリアは存在
しない大陸で有袋類はジョークである」が話題だ。
オーストラリア在住のひとからは困惑の声が――。
entries.original: One Denpa lover conspiracy is claiming that Australia doesn’t really exist, and kangaroos are a myth. Australians themselves are baffled by this claim online.
entries.translated: Q denpa receivers are spreading the conspiracy theory that 'Australia is a non-existent continent and marsupials are a joke.' People living in Australia are expressing confusion.

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者による陰謀論「言語はもともとはひと
つでＳ派Ｍ派の論争から分裂した」が話題だ。SNS
ではＳ派Ｍ派よりも、お菓子の好みによる派閥――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas cooked up a new conspiracy, stating that language itself used to be universal, until debates over whether sadism or masochism is sexier caused it to split. Others are saying it could've been a debate over candy―
entries.translated: Q denpa receivers are spreading the conspiracy theory that 'language was originally one but split due to debates between S-types and M-types.' On social media, rather than S-type vs M-type, people are forming factions based on candy preferences.

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者による陰謀論「インターネットは霊的
結界で怪異を光通信で封印している」が話題だ。
「怪異」がなにかでネットは盛り上がりを――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antenna's new conspiracy claims that the internet is a spiritual barrier being used to seal away ghosts in the optic fiber network. Users are now excitedly discussing what kinds of ghosts may be detained within―
entries.translated: Q denpa receivers are spreading the conspiracy theory that 'the internet is a spiritual barrier sealing anomalies through fiber optic communication.' The internet is buzzing with excitement over what these 'anomalies' might be.

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者による陰謀論「物質の最小単位は点で
はなくヒモで１次元のパスタでできている」が話題
だ。物理学者からは難解なモデルへの皮肉から――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antenna's are spreading the conspiracy that the smallest unit of matter is not the atom, but a string made of one-dimensional pasta. Physicists are exasperated at the spaghettification model―
entries.translated: Q denpa receivers are spreading the conspiracy theory that 'the smallest unit of matter isn't a point but strings made of one-dimensional pasta.' Physicists are responding with sarcasm about this complex model.

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者による陰謀論「水は創造主の毒で
人間の寿命を制限している」が話題だ。DHMOの危
険性については度々ネットで話題になって――。
entries.original: One Denpa Lover conspiracy asserts that water is actually poison to mankind, and is shortening our lifespans. The dangers of Dihydrogen Monoxide are all the rage.
entries.translated: Q denpa receivers are spreading the conspiracy theory that 'water is the creator's poison limiting human lifespan.' The dangers of DHMO have repeatedly become a hot topic online.

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者による陰謀論「鳥はすべてドローンで
電線に止まって充電している」が話題だ。電気代高
騰の理由に、納得がいったという声も――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antenna conspiracy theorists are insisting that birds are all drones working for the bourgeois, and when they perch on power cables, they're charging their power cells. Some are even blaming them for increased electricity bills―
entries.translated: Q denpa receivers are spreading the conspiracy theory that 'all birds are drones that perch on power lines to recharge.' Some voices say this finally explains rising electricity costs.

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者による陰謀論「南極は環状の氷の壁で
外には未知の大陸がある」が話題だ。否定的な声が
多数ではあるが「未知の大陸」に魅了される――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antenna conspiracy theorists are saying that Antarctica is a giant, circular ring of ice, and if we can go beyond it, an undiscovered continent awaits beyond. There are plenty of skeptics, but the allure is undeniable―
entries.translated: Q denpa receivers are spreading the conspiracy theory that 'Antarctica is a ring-shaped ice wall with unknown continents beyond it.' While most voices are negative, many are fascinated by the 'unknown continents.'
