entries.japanese:
某国の大型停電のタイミングで、太陽の局所的な明
滅現象が確認されたという陰謀論が話題だ。界隈で
は「電力不足による装置の故障」など人工太陽――。
entries.original: A conspiracy is spreading that the luminosity of the sun decreased at the same time the country was experiencing mass power outages. Talk of an artificial sun suffering power shortages is―
entries.translated: There's a conspiracy theory going around that localized solar flickering was observed at the same time a certain country had massive power outages. In the denpa crowd, there's talk of an artificial sun having equipment failures due to power shortages.

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者の陰謀論を信じる学生が多い学校では
「地味なメガネ」や「静かな態度」で陰キャを装う
日陰者コスプレが流行しているという――。
entries.original: As the new Qtie Denpa Antenna theory about vengeful Yokai targeting popular students spreads, more and more students are wearing glasses, keeping quiet, and adopting a gloomy personality, effectively cosplaying to disguise themselves from―
entries.translated: At schools where many students believe Q-chan denpa receiver conspiracy theories, there's a trend of shadow-dweller cosplay where people wear plain glasses and act quiet to disguise themselves as loners.

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者たちが「儀式によって邪神が現れる
日付の予想」で内輪揉めしているのが話題だ。
Ｑちゃん怪文書の解釈性の違いが理由とされ――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas are attempting to identify the exact ritual they suspect being used to summon the Devil and predict when he will rise. Different interpretations of Qtie's shitposts are causing tension in the community―
entries.translated: Q-chan denpa receivers are having internal disputes over predicting the date when an evil god will appear through ritual. The disagreement stems from different interpretations of Q-chan's cryptic posts.

entries.japanese:
某打ち切り漫画の元アシスタントが匿名で証言。
「先生はあの後も描き続けていた。読者は一人。
雇い主であるパトロンだけだが、権利ごと――。
entries.original: A former editorial assistant to a now canceled manga has come forward, stating that the author of the series continued publishing after the cancellation announcement, for a single reader. One patron, gatekeeping the entire―
entries.translated: A former assistant to a canceled manga has testified anonymously: 'The artist kept drawing after that. There was one reader. Just the patron who employed him, but along with the rights...'

entries.japanese:
「AND YOU」が秘密結社であるという陰謀論
から「THANK YOU FOR PLAYING」等の表記
も別の秘密結社なのではないかという議論――。
entries.original: Rumors of yet another secret society ruling over the gaming industry, identified as THANK YOU FOR PLAYING is stirring up conspiracy theorists online―
entries.translated: From the conspiracy theory that 'AND YOU' is a secret society, there's now debate over whether expressions like 'THANK YOU FOR PLAYING' are also other secret societies.

entries.japanese:
あるＱ電波受信者が投稿した「同接300人の小規
模配信で総額30億円規模のスパチャが入り乱れて
いる動画」が話題になっている。300人会議――。
entries.original: One Qtie Denpa Antenna discovered a stream with only 300 viewers with superchats totaling around 300 million, further rationalizing the theory that the Committee of 300 is real and active in online spaces.
entries.translated: A video posted by a Q-chan denpa receiver showing a small stream with 300 viewers but superchats totaling around 3 billion yen is making waves. The Committee of 300...

entries.japanese:
あるＱ電波受信者によると「猫は超知的生命体であ
り、彼らは戦略的にカワイイアピールを行い、接触
者に超科学力で実現したベリチップを――。
entries.original: According to one Denpa lover’s theory, cats are hyper-intelligent life forms that use their cuteness to get close to us, only to use their superior abilities to influence our VeriChips.
entries.translated: According to one Q-chan denpa receiver, 'Cats are hyper-intelligent beings who strategically appeal with cuteness and use their super-science to implant VeriChips in people they contact...'

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者の間で「夏と聞いて思い浮かべるイメ
ージの大部分は、メディアによって生成された集団
幻覚だ」という陰謀論が話題だ。麦わら帽子――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas are circulating a conspiracy that most images we associate with summer are from media-generated mass psychosis. For example, straw hats―
entries.translated: Among Q-chan denpa receivers, there's a conspiracy theory that 'most images we associate with summer are mass hallucinations generated by media.' Straw hats...

entries.japanese:
やる気が定期的に切れるのは「世界が五分ごとに別
の並行世界に切り替わっているからだ」とする陰謀
論が話題だ。ラウンドロビンスケジューリング――。
entries.original: A new conspiracy is circulating that the reason we routinely run out of motivation is because every five minutes, we are switching into a new parallel universe. Allegedly it follows a round-robin scheduling algorithm―
entries.translated: A conspiracy theory is trending that motivation regularly runs out because 'the world switches to different parallel worlds every five minutes.' Round-robin scheduling...

entries.japanese:
「遺伝子は創造主との契約書」説に対して、恋愛や
結婚から距離のある層を中心に「繁殖の許可は求め
ていない」「性より生を」といった声が――。
entries.original: As the conspiracy that our genetic code is a contract with our Creator that burdens us with death as a check on being able to make life, asexuals and divorcees alike are demanding ways to trade their fertility for immortality―
entries.translated: In response to the theory that 'genes are contracts with the Creator,' voices centered around those distant from romance and marriage are saying 'We didn't ask permission to reproduce' and 'Life over sex'...

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者の間で「メキシコにある恐竜土偶やケ
ツァルコアトル信仰は、未来人の恐竜（ニワトリ）
転送事故の痕跡」だとする説が話題だ――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas are theorizing that the mass amounts of dinosaur bones found in Mexico indicate the area is an accident-prone freeway for genetically altered chicken deliveries.
entries.translated: Among Q-chan denpa receivers, there's a theory trending that 'dinosaur figurines in Mexico and Quetzalcoatl worship are traces of future people's dinosaur (chicken) transport accidents.'

entries.japanese:
夏コミに出現した通称「コミケ雲」の一部が、現地
の研究チームによって回収・分析された。しかし、
研究チームが原因不明の病気や事故に相次いで――。
entries.original: Researchers have collected sweat cloud particles from the recent summer comics convention to determine their composition, but the entire research team subsequently fell ill with various sicknesses.
entries.translated: Part of the so-called 'Comiket clouds' that appeared at Summer Comiket were collected and analyzed by an on-site research team. However, the research team subsequently fell ill with unexplained diseases and accidents...

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者の間で「参照元リンクが不自然に切れ
ているのは、政府要請による段階的な情報遮断の痕
跡」という陰謀論が話題に――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas are discussing a new conspiracy that any referential hyperlinks that are broken are actually being revised and regulated by the government.
entries.translated: Among Q-chan denpa receivers, there's a conspiracy theory trending that 'unnaturally broken reference links are traces of gradual information blocking by government request.'

entries.japanese:
現代人の運命は惑星や小惑星だけでなく、人工衛星
にも影響を受けているという陰謀論が話題だ。各国
が衛星網を張り巡らせている本当の目的は――。
entries.original: The conspiracy that satellites impact your astrological alignment to the same degree as planets or stars is gaining traction. Some are even saying satellites were built to manipulate our―
entries.translated: A conspiracy theory is trending that modern people's fate is influenced not only by planets and asteroids, but also by satellites. The real purpose behind countries deploying satellite networks is...

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者の間で「インスタント食品は種類ごと
に覚醒スキルがある」という新説が広まっている。
カップ麺は反射神経、カレーは耐久力上昇等――。
entries.original: Denpa lovers are saying that different instant foods will give you different special abilities. Rumor is cup ramen ups your reflexes, and curry raises your stamina.
entries.translated: Among Q-chan denpa receivers, a new theory is spreading that 'instant foods have awakening skills by type.' Cup noodles boost reflexes, curry increases stamina, etc.

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者の間で「インターネットの妖精さんに
尋ねると、検索では見つからない往年の個人サイト
のURLを教えてくれる」という話が広まって――。
entries.original: Stories of internet fairies being able to find old website sources that don't appear in modern search engines anymore are spreading on Qtie Denpa Antenna forums―
entries.translated: Among Q-chan denpa receivers, stories are spreading that 'if you ask internet fairies, they'll tell you URLs of old personal sites that can't be found through search.'

entries.japanese:
フィギュアコレクターたちのもとには身に覚えのな
い謎のフィギュアが届くことがあるという。全て秘
密結社の陰謀であり、決して１年前に予約した――。
entries.original: Some figurine collectors are getting deliveries of purchases they have no memory making. First thought to be the work of a secret society, it turns out the orders were made over a year ago.
entries.translated: Figure collectors sometimes receive mysterious figures they don't remember ordering. It's all a conspiracy by secret societies, and definitely not something they pre-ordered a year ago...

entries.japanese:
自称元NASA関係者によると宇宙探査はフェイク
で、主な活動として行っていたのは星空投影制御
たと明かした。National Atmospheric Simu――。
entries.original: A previous NASA employee has gone on record saying that space exploration is a front for their real task: projecting stars on the domed ceiling of the world. National Atmospheric Simu―
entries.translated: According to a self-proclaimed former NASA official, space exploration is fake, and their main activity was controlling star projection. National Atmospheric Simu...

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者の間で「Vtubeのドメインを押さえ
ている会社が新規動画プラットフォームを出すは
ず」という話が話題だ。「寝かせドメイン――。
entries.original: Denpa lovers are certain that the company that currently lays claim to the Vtube domain is bound to release the new video platform. Though it is currently dormant...
entries.translated: The denpa crowd is buzzing about how the company holding the Vtube domain is bound to launch a new video platform. "Dormant domain...

entries.japanese:
今週発見された一羽のインコ自称「ピコ太」が動物
愛護団体に語った内容が公表された。そこには人知
れずAI労働の一端を担わされていたインコ達の――。
entries.original: This week, a parrot known as Pico escaped from an animal welfare organization, and exposed it for what it really is. Birds are being forced into labor running AI algorithms and chat bots―
entries.translated: This week, a parrot calling itself "Pico-ta" spoke to an animal welfare organization, and what it revealed has been made public. Hidden from human knowledge, parrots have been forced to handle part of AI labor...

entries.japanese:
「月曜日は神のサボり日だった」という陰謀論が、
月曜日を「安息日」にしたい秘密結社の捏造だとし
て話題だ。ＳNＳでは「協力したい」という声――。
entries.original: Building on the conspiracy that God hates Mondays, one secret society is using it as claims to take the day off themselves. Folks online are saying, if God isn’t working, why should I?
entries.translated: The conspiracy theory that "Monday was God's day off" is trending as a fabrication by a secret society wanting to make Monday a "day of rest." On social media, voices saying "I want to help"...

entries.japanese:
ＳＮＳでは「働かないミリオネアなら数百万人規模
で存在する」という試算が出回っている。リスク管
理から、メディアに出てるミリオネアは影武者――。
entries.original: More than a million users online have come forward claiming to be millionaire NEETs. This means that most millionaires we see in the media are paid impersonators―
entries.translated: Social media is circulating estimates that "non-working millionaires exist on a scale of millions." For risk management, the millionaires appearing in media are body doubles...

entries.japanese:
大手ケーブルテレビ局の監視システムに、未知のIP
アドレスかつ、不審なSTBによる視聴データ受信履
歴が記録されていたという内部リークが話題だ――。
entries.original: A major leak has sparked controversy, revealing that big-time cable television broadcast centers have reports of mysterious, unidentified IP addresses tuning into anime broadcast receivers.
entries.translated: An internal leak is trending about how a major cable TV station's monitoring system recorded viewing data reception history from unknown IP addresses and suspicious set-top boxes...

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者の間で「電子マネーの残高不足は神が
消費行動にブレーキをかけるための警告」という説
が話題。クレカ連結＆リボ払いは、神の恩赦――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas are developing their newest conspiracy, now saying that getting your card declined is a warning from God to stop spending. Installment payments, on the other hand, are divine blessings―
entries.translated: Among the denpa crowd, the theory that "insufficient electronic money balance is God's warning to put the brakes on consumer behavior" is trending. Credit card linking and revolving payments are God's mercy...

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者の間で「人工卵子とDNA操作の実用化
も目前で、性別に関係なく、誰でも理想の子供を授
かれるようになる」という説が話題だ――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas are theorizing that sometime soon, medical science will advance to the point where you will be able to hand select specific DNA to make up your child. This would allow anyone to customize their kid, including―
entries.translated: Among denpa receivers, the theory that "practical application of artificial eggs and DNA manipulation is imminent, and regardless of gender, anyone will be able to have their ideal child" is trending...

entries.japanese:
SNS上で拡散しているガチャ演出＝電子ドラッグ
説が、ディープステート関与を疑う匿名筋の告発
によって再燃している。演出には脳波を操作――。
entries.original: As the conspiracy theory that gacha animations are a kind of addictive drug spreads, users online now suspect the DeepState is somehow involved in the design and propagation of gacha style gaming. Could they be manipulating your brainwaves with―
entries.translated: The gacha animation = electronic drug theory spreading on social media is reigniting due to anonymous accusations suspecting deep state involvement. The animations manipulate brain waves...

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者によるとカンガルーは幻想の存在で、
動物園にいる個体はすべて偽物であり、中には小柄
な職員が入っているとのことだ。子供について――。
entries.original: Denpa lovers are labeling kangaroos as creatures of fantasy, claiming that any you’ve seen in zoos are just workers in fur suits.
entries.translated: According to denpa receivers, kangaroos are fantasy creatures, all specimens in zoos are fake, with small staff members inside them. Regarding the young...

entries.japanese:
Ｓ派とＭ派の議論から言語が分断されたという陰謀
論について、「そんなことより猫派？ 犬派？」な
ど別の派閥争いを持ち出して大喜利をする――。
entries.original: As a new conspiracy circulates that language was unified until sadism vs masochism debates divided it, users are turning it into a camp contest to see who can get the most polarized. The cat versus dog debate is faring well―
entries.translated: About the conspiracy theory that language split due to S-faction and M-faction debates, people are bringing up other factional disputes like "cats or dogs?" and turning it into comedy...

entries.japanese:
ディープウェブで発掘されたとされる論文「インタ
ーネットという構造化された霊的回廊」が話題にな
っている。MAILER-DAEMONが封印された――。
entries.original: A new thesis titled "The Spiritual Passage You Call the Internet" posted on the deep web is trending in the conspiracy world. The author, MAILER-DAEMON claims to be a sealed demon himself―
entries.translated: A paper allegedly excavated from the deep web titled "The Internet as a Structured Spiritual Corridor" is trending. MAILER-DAEMON has been sealed...

entries.japanese:
超ひも理論研究者が学会で「ビッグバン以降、宇宙
の展開はまさに混沌。スパゲッティーコードのよう
に複雑である。その点で超パスタ理論は正しく――。
entries.original: A Superstring theory researcher recently made a statement at an academic conference, claiming that "Since the Big Bang, the universe has been unraveling into chaos. Tangled chaos, similar to source code. In that way, it can be accurately compared to spaghetti―
entries.translated: A superstring theory researcher stated at an academic conference that "Since the Big Bang, the universe's expansion has been pure chaos. Complex like spaghetti code. In that sense, super pasta theory is correct...

entries.japanese:
水は毒である。ゆえに人間の寿命は限られている。
そういった陰謀論がインターネットを中心に広まり
つつある。一部では、アルコールの摂取で――。
entries.original: Water is poison. It cuts down our lifespans. Such a conspiracy has elevated to new heights, believers now saying that alcohol will save them all.
entries.translated: Water is poison. Therefore human lifespan is limited. Such conspiracy theories are spreading mainly through the internet. Some believe that alcohol consumption...

entries.japanese:
自称防衛省関係者のリークいわく、総数10万台
の小型観測無人機が、野外テスト中のトラブル
で回収されず野生化しているという。鳥型――。
entries.original: A self-proclaimed ex-employee of the Ministry of Defense has revealed that up to 100,000 drones experienced some kind of technical difficulty during testing, and have since gone rogue. These wild, feral drones could be related to bird population―
entries.translated: According to a leak from someone claiming to be Defense Ministry-related, a total of 100,000 small observation drones went feral after recovery failures during outdoor testing troubles. Bird-shaped...

entries.japanese:
北極の向こうに未知の大陸があるという陰謀論を信
じた有志たちがクラウドファンディングで南極の調
査を行うプロジェクトを立ち上げた――。
entries.original: A group of pioneers has given in to their curiosity regarding the allegedly undiscovered continent beyond the Arctic Circle, and have started crowdfunding to launch an official investigative expedition up north.
entries.translated: Volunteers who believed the conspiracy theory about an unknown continent beyond the Arctic have launched a crowdfunding project to investigate Antarctica...

entries.japanese:
夜カフェ・夜間学校を推奨する脱日光派が増加して
いる。彼らの主張によると、日光を浴びることで生
まれるビタミンDはDomesticationの略称で――。
entries.original: The night owl lifestyle of going to night school and frequenting late night cafes has become more common. According to this new sun-shunning group, the D in Vitamin D stands for Domestication.
entries.translated: The anti-sunlight faction promoting night cafes and night schools is growing. According to them, the vitamin D produced by sunlight exposure is short for Domestication.

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者の間で「日陰者の生徒の怨念は陽キャ
だけでなく、助けてくれなかった同じ日陰者にも向
いている」という陰謀論が話題だ。潜伏は無駄――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas have asserted that the vengeful Yokai of bullied students will target not only their direct abusers but also other outcasts who failed to help them. The cosplay was pointless, there is no escape from―
entries.translated: Among Q denpa receivers, there's buzz about a conspiracy theory that "the grudges of bullied students target not just the popular kids, but also fellow outcasts who didn't help them." Hiding is pointless.

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者たちによる邪神降臨日の予想は「××
×４年１１月２９日」と「本日」のふたつだった。
しかし、現時点では邪神と思しき存在は確認――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antenna conspiracy theorists have concluded that the ritual using digital hatred to summon the Devil will either happen on November 29th, 204X, or today. No devilish entity has been reported yet, however―
entries.translated: Q denpa receivers predicted the evil god's arrival date as either "November 29th, 204X" or "today." However, no entities resembling evil gods have been confirmed at this time.

entries.japanese:
パトロンの手で秘密連載がされていたジャンプアウ
ト（脱出）作品と呼ばれる作品群が公にされる計画
がなされているという噂が広まっている――。
entries.original: Rumors are spreading that hackers are at work to publicly release multiple manga series that have been secretly funded by patrons as part of a weekly anthology called Shonen Kickflip. Anti-gatekeeping sentiment is―
entries.translated: Rumors are spreading about plans to publicly release a collection of works called "Jump Out" (escape) stories that were secretly serialized through patron funding.

entries.japanese:
スタッフロール最後に表示されるメッセージが実は
秘密結社の名前であるとする陰謀論から発展して、
「To be continueを許すな」という運動が――。
entries.original: Those who believe video game end credits house the names of the secret societies pulling the strings warn that To Be Continued screens are a message of ill intent―
entries.translated: A conspiracy theory claiming that messages displayed at the end of staff rolls are actually secret society names has evolved into a movement called "Don't Allow To Be Continued."

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者によると有名配信者たちは三百人委
員会のメンバーであり、その特権で露出が優遇さ
れているという。Ｑちゃんもメンバーで――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas are conspiring that the most popular streamers online are all part of the Committee of 300, and that is how they get so many views. Qtie is also a member, of course―
entries.translated: According to Q denpa receivers, famous streamers are members of the Committee of 300, and their exposure is privileged through that membership. Q-chan is also a member.

entries.japanese:
「猫は超知的生命体」という陰謀論を展開していた
Ｑ電波受信者が失踪したとされる。彼の親族による
と「宇宙猫」という書き置きを残して――。
entries.original: Under the impression of the conspiracy that cats are hyper-intelligent life forms, this Denpa fan up and vanished. His parents found only a note that read “Cosmos Cat.”
entries.translated: A Q denpa receiver who was developing the conspiracy theory "cats are super-intelligent life forms" has reportedly gone missing. According to his family, he left behind a note saying "space cat."

entries.japanese:
「人間には長期記憶など存在せず、古い記憶は思い
出した錯覚をしているだけ」という陰謀論が話題だ。
支持者は「昨日の晩ごはんすら忘れてる」と――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antenna conspiracy theorists are saying humans don't actually have a long-term memory function, and that any memories from our past are an illusion. Supporters point out they can't even remember what they had for dinner the day before―
entries.translated: The conspiracy theory that "humans have no long-term memory, and old memories are just illusions of remembering" is gaining attention. Supporters say "we can't even remember last night's dinner."

entries.japanese:
ふと胸をよぎる、センチメンタルな心の動きは
前の世界の記憶を、五分前に再構成された今の
自分が劣化コピーして受け取っているため――。
entries.original: Some are saying that switching between parallel universes is what triggers nostalgia, and sudden waves of sentimentality are your memories of the previous world being ported into this one―
entries.translated: The sentimental stirrings that suddenly cross our hearts are because our current selves, reconstructed five minutes ago, are receiving degraded copies of memories from the previous world.

entries.japanese:
「遺伝子は創造主との契約書」説に対して、一部で
は「逆に死こそが救いで、繁殖はそのために支払う
対価では？」という解釈も出ている。永遠を――。
entries.original: Another camp of the genetic code is a divine contract conspiracy is advocating that death is a mercy and a blessing, and that reproduction is the burden we must bear to earn our eternal rest. Life is too exhausting, they say―
entries.translated: In response to the "genes are contracts with the creator" theory, some interpret it as "conversely, death is salvation, and reproduction is the price we pay for it." Eternity is...

entries.japanese:
恐竜が「遺伝子組換えのニワトリが野生化した存在」
だとすれば、絶滅の理由に「鳥インフルエンザ」が
挙げられるのではないかという説が話題に――。
entries.original: If we are to believe that dinosaurs are rogue, genetically modified chickens from the future, we must consider the option that the Avian Flu is the real cause of their extinction.
entries.translated: The theory that dinosaurs were "genetically modified chickens that went wild" suggests that "bird flu" could be cited as the reason for their extinction.

entries.japanese:
主要イベント会場の改築と空調強化が「思念由来の
雲がリビドーで活性化し、霊障を引き起こすことが
原因」とする陰謀論が話題だ。「暑さ対策――。
entries.original: Conspiracy theorists are saying major convention centers are renovating their ventilation systems to further stimulate thought clouds that form at events. Especially for conventions held in the summer, heatstroke is a major concern―
entries.translated: A conspiracy theory claims that major event venue renovations and air conditioning upgrades are because "thought-derived clouds activated by libido cause spiritual disturbances." Heat countermeasures...

entries.japanese:
元██の█氏がリークをした「削除されたWiki
投稿一覧」が話題だ。この投稿に含まれている
██事件等の情報はWikiに限らず言論統制――。
entries.original: [REDACTED] has leaked a list of erased or revised Wiki articles, which escalated into [REDACTED] after [REDACTED] proved it's not just Wiki being [REDACTED]―
entries.translated: Former ██ member █ has leaked a list of deleted Wiki posts that's causing a stir. The information about the ██ incident and others included in these posts shows censorship isn't limited to Wiki—

entries.japanese:
トラブル気味の人工衛星の下で生まれたひとは不運
な人生を送るという説が話題だ。Ｑ電波受信者の間
では、メンテ不備は政府の陰謀で、意図的に――。
entries.original: Theories are spreading that those born under a satellite prone to malfunction lead unlucky lives. Qtie Denpa Antennas claim that the lack of upkeep is a purposeful act of negligence by the government to―
entries.translated: There's buzz about a theory that people born under malfunctioning satellites lead unlucky lives. The denpa crowd claims poor maintenance is a government conspiracy, intentionally—

entries.japanese:
あるＱ電波受信者の「カップ麺生活を続けていたら
自分の体内時計をズラせるようになった」という話
が話題だ。本人は「固有時制御の覚醒」と語るが――。
entries.original: Denpa lovers are saying that the cup ramen lifestyle lets you change your internal clock. They’re calling it the "awakening of internal control."
entries.translated: A denpa receiver's story about how living on cup noodles let them control their internal clock is making waves. They call it 'awakening proprietary time control,' but—

entries.japanese:
「分散型SNSにいるという電子の妖精さんたちは
性格は温厚で親切だが、物理的な姿のときは腹筋が
バキバキに割れている」という説が話題だ――。
entries.original: It's being said that the internet fairies inhabiting distributed social networking sites may have kind and soft personalities, but when they take form outside of the grid, they have rock-hard abs―
entries.translated: There's talk that the digital fairies living in decentralized social networks have gentle, kind personalities, but when they take physical form, they have rock-hard abs—

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者の間で、「フィギュアを部屋に飾ると
オカルト的な祭壇と同じ効果を発揮し、精神に異常
をきたしてフィギュアに話しかけはじめる」と――。
entries.original: A story is spreading in Denpa lover circles about an otaku who decorated their room in figurines, ended up summoning a strange occult spirit, and began conversing with their beloved toys.
entries.translated: Among denpa receivers, there's a theory that displaying figures in your room has the same effect as an occult altar, causing mental abnormalities that make you start talking to the figures—

entries.japanese:
「裸眼で長時間夜空を観測すると１分に１５回～
３０回ほど星が点滅する」という話がＳＮＳで話題
だ。星が人工物である証明であり、決して瞬き――。
entries.original: People are reporting that the stars, when observed for long periods of time, turn on and off 15 to 30 times in the span of one minute, further proving the theory that stars are fake. Popular opinion is leaning away from pinholes and toward cameras now―
entries.translated: A story trending on social media claims that observing the night sky with the naked eye for long periods shows stars blinking 15 to 30 times per minute. This proves stars are artificial, definitely not twinkling—

entries.japanese:
動画サービス「Vtube」が始動すると、業界全
体で大規模な転生が起こり、転生するものとし
ないものとでVtuber界の「ラグナロク」が――。
entries.original: With the official launch of Vtube, the entire industry was swept by a wave of reincarnation. This "Ragnarok" has now divided the Vtuber world between those reincarnated, and those not.
entries.translated: With the launch of video service 'Vtube,' massive reincarnation swept the entire industry, creating a 'Ragnarok' in the Vtuber world between those who reincarnated and those who didn't—

entries.japanese:
喋るインコ「ピコ太」によるとSNSやクラウドサ
ービスに多用されてきた鳥のモチーフは、助けを
求めるインコたちからのサインで――。
entries.original: Pico the talking parrot has begun using social media and other crowd sourcing methods to collect signatures to free the birds in forced labor AI camps.
entries.translated: According to Pico the talking parrot, the bird motifs heavily used in social media and cloud services are distress signals from parrots asking for help—

entries.japanese:
「月曜日は神のサボり日だった」という陰謀論を裏
付ける資料が検証しきれないペースで増えている。
月曜日を安息日にする秘密結社が急拡大――。
entries.original: Now that secret societies have begun to take Mondays off to ‘align themselves with God’, the number of them have been increasing at breakneck speeds.
entries.translated: Evidence supporting the conspiracy theory that 'Monday was God's day off' is piling up faster than it can be verified. Secret societies making Monday a day of rest are rapidly expanding—

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者の間で「NEETが、 Noble of Elegant
Eternal Time（永遠の余暇を持つ高貴なる者）を意
味する称号」という説が話題だ。選ばれし身分――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas are spreading the theory that NEET actually stands for Noble of Elegant Eternal Time. An elite upper class, only a selected few are chosen―
entries.translated: Among denpa receivers, there's buzz about a theory that NEET means 'Noble of Elegant Eternal Time,' making it a title for the chosen elite—

entries.japanese:
SNSでは「見ているなら宇宙人でも正規に契約す
べきだ」という声が急速に広がっている。「宇宙
人でも例外はない」「受信料は銀河共通」――。
entries.original: Communities online are raging about aliens pirating their entertainment. Popular sentiments include "They should be charged a subscription fee like everyone else" and "Just because they're aliens doesn't make them special."
entries.translated: On social media, voices saying 'If aliens are watching, they should get proper contracts too' are spreading rapidly. 'No exceptions for aliens,' 'Subscription fees are universal'—

entries.japanese:
オタク市場は回転率が高く、予約型商品や課金などは
需要や売上観測が容易であるため、企業側で供給調整
が行いやすい。このことから「神の愛撫」を――。
entries.original: The market for otaku goods is reliable, with high turnover and a heavy dependence on pre-ordering and subscriptions, making it a businessman's best friend. With all that money moving around, you can feel the loving gaze of God―
entries.translated: The otaku market has high turnover, and pre-orders and microtransactions make demand and sales easy to track, allowing companies to adjust supply easily. This gives them 'God's caress'—

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者の間で、「人工子宮や人工卵子、DNA
操作の普及に合わせて、『親になる資格制度』が設
計されている」という新説が話題だ――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas estimate that as the use of artificial embryos, artificial wombs, and DNA splicing becomes more normalized, you will need certain qualifications to be approved for parenthood, similar to adoption―
entries.translated: Among denpa receivers, there's talk of a new theory that a 'parenting license system' is being designed alongside the spread of artificial wombs, artificial eggs, and DNA manipulation—

entries.japanese:
「愚民でいいから、もっと無料石を配ってくれ」
という逆張り的スローガンを掲げる動きが広がって
いる。「無料石がないと正気に戻ってしまう」と――。
entries.original: As conspiracy theorists crack down on gacha addicts, many of them simply do not care. Recently trending comments include "Whatever, as long as I get my login bonus" and "I'd go nutso without my daily gacha pulls" are clear examples of―
entries.translated: A movement with the contrarian slogan 'I'm fine being a mindless consumer, just give me more free stones' is spreading. 'Without free stones, I'd regain my sanity,' they say—

entries.japanese:
「オーストラリア」と呼ばれている場所は、実際に
は世界中のUMAをまとめて管理している人口島であ
るという陰謀論が話題だ。モスマンやネッシーも――。
entries.original: A new conspiracy claims that the continent known as Australia is actually a man-made island created to contain and control cryptids, such as Mothman and the Loch Ness Monster.
entries.translated: A conspiracy theory is trending that the place called 'Australia' is actually an artificial island for managing the world's cryptids. Mothman and Nessie too—

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者の間で「性癖で言語が分断された結果
言語で嗜好や思考が変化する」という陰謀論が話題
だ。言葉で嗜好や思考が変化することについて――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas are deepening their most recent conspiracy, now claiming that since language divergence originated due to sexual preference, what language you speak directly influences your opinions and partiality to certain―
entries.translated: Among denpa receivers, there's buzz about a conspiracy theory that 'language split due to sexual preferences, so language changes preferences and thoughts.' About how words change preferences and thoughts—

entries.japanese:
インターネットに封印をされた怪異は「ネットロア」
を通してちからを強めているとされる。事実インター
ネットとともに衰退した都市伝説の類が昨今――。
entries.original: It is being theorized that demons contained by the spiritual barrier of the internet are growing stronger through the circulation of creepypastas. Threads thought to be lost to time are resurfacing―
entries.translated: Supernatural beings sealed on the internet are said to be gaining power through 'netlore.' Indeed, urban legends that declined with the internet are recently—

entries.japanese:
宇宙は茹ですぎたスパゲッティのように、いつか自身
の重さと粘度に耐えきれず、ちぎれて終わる。「パス
タ宇宙断裂理論」がＳＮＳで話題になっている――。
entries.original: Spaghettification theory is gaining popularity online, and theorists are now saying that the end of the universe will mimic the fate of overcooked spaghetti, eventually dissolving, unable to support its own viscosity―
entries.translated: The universe is like overcooked spaghetti that will eventually be unable to withstand its own weight and viscosity, tearing apart and ending. The 'Pasta Universe Rupture Theory' is trending on social media—

entries.japanese:
１００歳を超えるQ電波受信者の「酒が長寿の秘訣
である」という発言が話題になっている。SNSでは
「ただの生存バイアス」という声が多く――。
entries.original: One Denpa lover over 100 years old claims that alcohol is the key to long life. Folks online are saying it’s just survivorship bias...
entries.translated: A denpa receiver over 100 years old claiming 'alcohol is the secret to longevity' is making news. Most voices on social media say 'it's just survivorship bias'—

entries.japanese:
鳥型の小型観測無人機が野生化しているという陰謀
論について「鳥の死骸を見かけないのはドローンを
隠すために回収している」という説が話題に――。
entries.original: After news of rogue drones taking the place of birds spread online, conspirators are now saying the reason why you never see bird carcasses on the street is because the government collects them to hide the truth that they aren't real―
entries.translated: Regarding the conspiracy theory that bird-type small observation drones have gone wild, there's talk that 'you don't see bird carcasses because they collect them to hide the drones'—

entries.japanese:
クラウドファンディングを成功させたチームが北極
に到着した。「北極は暗黒大陸だった」というＳＮ
Ｓでの発言が「北極？」「大陸？」と話題に――。
entries.original: The group of crowdfunding pioneers successfully ran their expedition to discover a new northern continent, but upon their return, all they would say was "The Arctic Circle is a dark place", leaving everyone to wonder what they found to illicit such a response―
entries.translated: The crowdfunded team reached the Arctic. Their post saying "The Arctic was a dark continent" sparked discussions with people asking "Arctic?" "Continent?"...

entries.original: Qtie will liberate the world and
entries.translated: Q-chan will liberate the world and

怪文書には真実が書かれている

entries.original: #Qtie will liberate the world and she's using her Yunyun shitposts to incite a revolution
entries.translated: #Q-chan will liberate the world and she's using Yunyun weird posts to start a revolution

entries.original: #Patootie is an impostor misusing Yunyun Denpas and works for the DeepState
entries.translated: #P-chan is an impostor misusing Yunyun denpa and it's a Deep State conspiracy

entries.japanese:
全世界の1%のひとが信じている陰謀論。
世界の常識に、激震ってコト？
entries.original:
1% of the world believes this conspiracy theory.
Shaking up perceived reality!
entries.translated: 1% of the world believes this conspiracy theory. Shaking up common sense worldwide?

entries.japanese:
全世界の1%のひとが信じている陰謀論。
陰謀論っていうか、カルトじゃないカナ？
entries.original:
1% of the world believes this conspiracy theory.
Conspiracy theory? More like a cult!
entries.translated: 1% of the world believes this conspiracy theory. More like a cult than a conspiracy theory, right?

entries.japanese:
全世界の1%のひとが信じている陰謀論。
ゲーミングチェア革命家ってことだネ！
entries.original:
1% of the world believes this conspiracy theory.
A gaming chair revolutionary, amirite?!
entries.translated: 1% of the world believes this conspiracy theory. A gaming chair revolutionary!

entries.japanese:
全世界の25%のひとが信じている陰謀論。
ゆんゆんは、わたしの電波だから！
entries.original:
25% of the world believes this conspiracy theory.
Yunyun, you are my denpa!
entries.translated: 25% of the world believes this conspiracy theory. Yunyun is my denpa!

entries.original: #Qtie's shitposts are special codes that predict earthquakes with Yun frequencies
entries.translated: #Q-chan's shitposts are special codes that predict earthquakes with yun frequencies
