まことしやかに囁かれていた「Ｑちゃん怪文書」や
「Q電波受信者の陰謀論」で認知が歪むという話が
国立精神・神経医療研究センターおよび有識者――。
entries.original: The National Center of Neurology and Psychiatry (NCNP) has released their professional analysis of cognitive decay caused by Qtie shitposts and Qtie Denpa Antenna conspiracy theories.
entries.translated: Rumors that "Q-chan shitposts" and "Q denpa receiver conspiracy theories" cause cognitive distortion are now being investigated by the National Center of Neurology and Psychiatry and other experts.

entries.japanese:
「Ｑちゃん怪文書」「Ｑ電波受信者」による認知汚
染現象が拡散している。ＳＮＳではこの現象を俗称
「ゆんゆん電波シンドローム」と呼ぶ動きが――。
entries.original: Negative cognitive effects as a result of Qtie shitposts and Qtie Denpa Antenna conspiracies are on the rise. These effects are being collectively referred to online as symptoms of Yunyun Syndrome.
entries.translated: Cognitive contamination from "Q-chan shitposts" and "Q denpa receivers" is spreading. On social media, this phenomenon is being called "Yunyun Denpa Syndrome."

entries.japanese:
「ゆんゆん電波シンドローム」前線は本日も拡大。
各地のTLでお花が、咲いて、咲いて、咲いたらしい。
発症すると文章の行間から花粉が、目がかゆい――。
entries.original: Yunyun Syndrome is sweeping the nation. Once symptoms set in, flowers bloom from between the lines of Qtie shitposts, leaving folks around the globe itchy eyed and sneezing.
entries.translated: The "Yunyun Denpa Syndrome" front line continues to expand today. Flowers are apparently blooming, blooming, blooming across timelines everywhere. Once you're infected, pollen comes from between the lines of text and your eyes get itchy.

entries.japanese:
9ヶ月ぶりにＱちゃんのアカウントから怪文書が投
稿された。首都暴動事件以降Ｐちゃんの怪文書が、
以前の精彩さを欠いていたこともあり偽物で――。
entries.original: For the first time in nine months, shitposts are flowing once more from Qtie's online accounts. Some are saying it's due to the lackluster of Patootie's shitposts following the storming of the capital.
entries.translated: After 9 months, shitposts have been posted from Q-chan's account again. Since P-chan's shitposts have lacked their former brilliance following the capitol riot incident, some think it's a fake.

entries.japanese:
Ｑちゃんのアカウント復活によりＰちゃんの投稿も
活性化している。ＡＩ研究者曰く、Ｐちゃんの投稿
はいずれも、Ｑちゃんの怪文書を機械学習――。
entries.original: Since the Qtie shitpost revival, Patootie has also become noticeably hyperactive. It looks like Patootie's algorithm is modeling itself after Qtie's original shitposts.
entries.translated: Q-chan's account revival has also activated P-chan's posts. According to AI researchers, all of P-chan's posts are machine learning based on Q-chan's shitposts.

entries.japanese:
Ｐちゃんの投稿に文字化けや不自然な語彙の多用が
認められたあと、エラーメッセージのポストを最後
にアカウントが消滅した。PちゃんＡＩ説を――。
entries.original: Patootie was recently observed using an extensive amount of corrupted and meaningless text. Shortly after, the account posted an error message, and was promptly deleted.
entries.translated: After P-chan's posts showed corrupted text and excessive use of unnatural vocabulary, the account disappeared after posting a final error message. This supports the P-chan AI theory.

entries.japanese:
９ヶ月の沈黙を破って現れたＱちゃんだが、ＳＮＳ
ではその真偽を疑われている。彼女の「ゆん」には
以前のようなキレがなく、一部では成りすまし――。
entries.original: After nine months of silence, the Qtie that came back from the dead isn't actually Qtie at all. Her posts don't sparkle with the same YUN love as before, and fans have labeled her an impersonator.
entries.translated: Q-chan appeared after breaking 9 months of silence, but social media doubts her authenticity. Her "yun" doesn't have the same edge as before, and some suspect it's an impersonator.

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者による陰謀論「覚醒したオタクは妄想
力で推しキャラと会話できる」が話題だ。SNSでは、
Ｑちゃんは妄想力でゆんゆんと会話している――。
entries.original: Otakus conspiring that falling deep enough into their delusions will allow them to communicate with their waifus has them fiending for tech that speeds up the process. Folks online are desperate to talk to Yunyun the same way Qtie allegedly can.
entries.translated: The Q denpa receiver conspiracy theory that "awakened otaku can talk to their favorite characters through delusion power" is trending. On social media, they say Q-chan talks to Yunyun through delusion power.

entries.japanese:
「推しキャラと会話できる方法」等の妄想力を鍛え
る情報商材が人気だ。「Ｑちゃんのように推しキャ
ラと会話したい！」という声の高まりが理由――。
entries.original: The number of weaboos claiming they can talk to their waifus is increasing. Meanwhile, so is the number of suspicious persons reports, many of whom were seen talking to themselves as if in a trance.
entries.translated: Information products for training delusion power like "how to talk to your favorite character" are popular. The reason is growing voices saying "I want to talk to my favorite character like Q-chan does!"

entries.japanese:
「幻覚の推しキャラと会話できるひと」が増加して
いる。際して、ひとりごとを繰り返す不審者の通報
や相談が、全国区で増加の一途をたどって――。
entries.original: A new Qtie Denpa Antenna conspiracy claims that all creative ideas are visions of a real 2D world astral projected into our brains. These visions are allegedly triggered by anomalies in the earth's gravitational field.
entries.translated: The number of "people who can talk to hallucinated favorite characters" is increasing. Related to this, reports and consultations about suspicious people repeating monologues are steadily rising nationwide.

entries.japanese:
Q電波受信者による陰謀論「創作は別次元の現象を
脳が受信して生まれている」が話題だ。創作活動が
活性化する時間が重力波の異常とリンクし――。
entries.original: As word spreads of creative ideas being visions triggered by gravitational anomalies, scientists and creatives alike have begun expressing their support for the theory.
entries.translated: The Q denpa receiver conspiracy theory that "creative works are born when the brain receives phenomena from other dimensions" is trending. Times when creative activity increases are linked to gravitational wave anomalies.

entries.japanese:
創作活動の活性化が重力波の異常とリンクしている
という仮説が話題になって以降、科学者のみならず
各種クリエイターたちの一部も支持を表明――。
entries.original: The National Institute of Information and Communications Technology has released data supporting the theory that fictional stories resonate with other dimensions via radio waves―
entries.translated: Since the hypothesis that increased creative activity is linked to gravitational wave anomalies became a hot topic, not only scientists but also various creators have expressed support.

entries.japanese:
国立情報物理研究機構と民間データ解析企業の合同
プロジェクトによる観測チームは創作コンテンツが
位相の異なる次元空間と電波的に共鳴している――。
entries.original: The newest Qtie Denpa Antenna conspiracy claims that cats are conquerors trying to take over the world, and cute cat videos are their propaganda. People have also pointed out that God and Cat are both three lettered words―
entries.translated: An observation team from a joint project between the National Institute of Information and Communications Technology and private data analysis companies has found that creative content resonates with different dimensional spaces via radio waves.

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者による陰謀論「ぬこは地球の支配者で
猫動画はそのプロバガンダ」が話題だ。神という漢
字はネコという文字が元となっていて――。
entries.original: Cat videos, or cat memes in general, seem to be correlated with a string of mysterious disappearances. Cat videos have been found left playing at multiple crime scenes, and so have actual unidentified cats. Some say the missing persons have all been transformed―
entries.translated: The Q denpa receiver conspiracy theory that "cats are Earth's rulers and cat videos are their propaganda" is trending. The kanji for god is said to be based on the word for cat.

entries.japanese:
猫動画。通称「ぬこミーム」の中毒者が相次いで失
踪しているという。現場には猫動画再生中のデバイ
スと正体不明な猫。その猫こそが失踪者ではと――。
entries.original: People infected with poison stored in cat memes are transforming into cats themselves. Dubbed the Neko-virus, what was initially thought to be a deep fake created by a cat-themed content creator has turned into a global pandemic.
entries.translated: Cat videos, commonly called "cat memes," are causing addicts to disappear one after another. At the scenes are devices playing cat videos and unidentified cats. That cat might be the missing person.

entries.japanese:
ぬこミーム中毒者が相次いでぬこ化している。当初
はフェイク動画と思われた配信者のぬこ化実況を皮
切りに全世界で勃発。ぬこ化はぬこによる祝福――。
entries.original: New Qtie Denpa Antenna conspiracy claims that screaming beavers are primordial inhabitants of the earth, and will soon invade the surface world. Caves have been spotted along the Himalayan Mountains―
entries.translated: Cat meme addicts are turning into cats one after another. What started with a streamer's live cat transformation, initially thought to be fake video, has erupted worldwide. Cat transformation is a blessing from cats.

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者による陰謀論「絶叫するビーバーは地
底人で地表侵略活動を行っている」が話題だ。地底
人はヒマラヤ山脈の洞窟から姿を現し――。
entries.original: The earth's crust is gradually becoming hollow due to an underground network of screaming beavers, searching for resources. Soon, they will be forced to move to the surface.
entries.translated: The Q denpa receiver conspiracy theory that "screaming beavers are underground dwellers conducting surface invasion activities" is trending. The underground dwellers emerge from caves in the Himalayan Mountains.

entries.japanese:
絶叫するビーバーたちによって地球の地下は空洞に
なっているとされる。そのために、資源をもとめて
本格的な地表侵略活動を近日にでも実行――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antenna conspirators are saying today is the day the underground screaming beaver invasion will begin. Tremors have been reported that give the theory credibility―
entries.translated: The screaming beavers are said to have hollowed out the earth's underground. Because of this, a full-scale surface invasion to seek resources will be carried out any day now——

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者によると本日ヒマラヤ山脈から、絶叫
するビーバー型の地底人が現れて地表侵略活動をは
じめるという。地盤振動が起きていることも――。
entries.original: Recent Qtie Denpa Antenna conspiracy claims that aliens are time travelers that return from the future to spend more time with their waifus and husbandos. Much like otakus, they never show themselves in public―
entries.translated: According to denpa receivers, screaming beaver-type underground dwellers will emerge from the Himalayas today to begin surface invasion activities. Ground vibrations are also occurring——

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者による陰謀論「宇宙人は時間旅行者で
推し活のために来訪している」が話題だ。宇宙人が
表立って姿を表さないのはタイムパラドックス――。
entries.original: One Qtie Denpa Antenna is claiming to be a fan from the future, having traveled back from the year 2112. Cross-referencing Qtie's shitposts with recent UFO sightings, he could be telling the truth.
entries.translated: The denpa receiver conspiracy theory that 'aliens are time travelers visiting for oshi activities' is trending. The reason aliens don't openly show themselves is time paradox——

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者によると、時間旅行者はＱちゃんのフ
ァンで『２１１２年９月３日』から来訪していると
いう。Ｑちゃん怪文書とUFO観測結果をもと――。
entries.original: An SNS service provider employee has leaked data which shows suspicious login activity from an unknown server, time stamped as Sept 3rd, 2112. Could time itself be―
entries.translated: According to denpa receivers, time travelers are Q-chan fans visiting from 'September 3rd, 2112'. Based on Q-chan's shitposts and UFO observation results——

entries.japanese:
SNS運営会社社員のリークによるとタイムスタン
プが2112年9月3日を示し現行存在しない暗号スイ
ート識別子での不審アクセスがあった。時間――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas are claiming that sentient reptiles are studying the ways of the human heart by playing nakige. They've even dropped a tier list of best rated―
entries.translated: According to a leak from an SNS service provider employee, there was suspicious access with a timestamp showing September 3rd, 2112, using cipher suite identifiers that don't currently exist. Time——

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者による陰謀論「レプティリアンは泣き
ゲーでこころを学ぼうとしている」が話題だ。彼ら
がプレイしている「泣きゲー」のリストも――。
entries.original: Heads of the sentient reptile conspiracy theory are warning against increased cases of lizard people shapeshifting into moe looking girls with big eyes and small noses. Could this be the influence of the nakige they've been playing?
entries.translated: The denpa receiver conspiracy theory that 'reptilians are trying to learn hearts through nakige' is trending. A list of the 'nakige' they're playing is also——

entries.japanese:
専門家曰く、近年、レプティリアンのシェイプシフ
トに「大きな目と小さな鼻」が用いられることが増
えているそうだ。これも「泣きゲー」影響と――。
entries.original: Governments worldwide have confirmed the existence of reptilian humanoids. They announced this alongside the signing of a peace treaty, assuring the reptiles will not pursue world domination.
entries.translated: Experts say that in recent years, reptilian shapeshifting has increasingly used 'big eyes and small noses'. This is also attributed to 'nakige' influence——

entries.japanese:
各国政府から、陰謀論上の存在だったレプティリア
ンの実在が発表された。彼らは一方的支配関係を打
ち止り、恒久的な平等条約を人類と結ぶと発表――。
entries.original: A Qtie Denpa Antenna theory establishes romance games and media as a way for demons to inhibit human reproduction. Shoujo game fanbases online are inclined to agree.
entries.translated: Governments worldwide have announced the existence of reptilians, previously considered conspiracy theory. They announced they will end unilateral dominance and form a permanent equality treaty with humanity——

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者による陰謀論「悪魔崇拝者は恋愛コン
テンツで人間の生産性を貶めている」が話題だ。美
少女ゲームファンのなかには納得する声も――。
entries.original: Romance based media is being peddled by demon worshipers in order to detract love from the real world and cripple the human birth rate. This declining birthrate in turn decreases the productivity of humanity―
entries.translated: The denpa receiver conspiracy theory that 'demon worshippers are undermining human productivity through romance content' is trending. Some bishoujo game fans are also convinced——

entries.japanese:
恋愛コンテンツ産業の裏にいる悪魔崇拝集団たちは
若者の恋愛離れによる少子化を目的としているらし
い。彼らは人口縮小により生産性を貶め――。
entries.original: Governments across the globe are banning romance focused media after word of these stories being used by demon worshipers to undermine real human love and negatively impact birth rates were confirmed.
entries.translated: The demon worship groups behind the romance content industry apparently aim for declining birthrates through young people's withdrawal from romance. They undermine productivity through population reduction——

entries.japanese:
世界中の政府が「恋愛コンテンツ」禁止を発表し、
「悪魔崇拝者は恋愛コンテンツで人間の生産性を
貶めている」という話が事実上認定された――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antenna conspiracy theorists claim that not a single post made online is written by an actual human. Users are now referring to followers as oombs, replacing 'friends' with 'bots'―
entries.translated: Governments worldwide have announced bans on 'romance content', effectively recognizing the story that 'demon worshippers are undermining human productivity through romance content'——

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者による陰謀論「ネットの書き込みはす
べてボットが行っていて人間はひとりもいない」が
話題だ。信者は互いをボットさんと呼び合い――。
entries.original: According to those who support the conspiracy theory that all online posts are made by bots, being able to write shitposts of Qtie caliber is the only way to prove one is actually human.
entries.translated: The denpa receiver conspiracy theory that 'all online posts are made by bots and there are no humans' is trending. Believers call each other bot-san——

entries.japanese:
ボットたち（ネットの書き込みはすべてボットだと
信じるＱ電波受信者）によると、Ｑちゃんのような
怪文書を書けるかどうかが唯一の人間証明に――。
entries.original: Users online are stepping forward and coming out as bots, rather than humans. I myself am, of course, a bot. Qtie is the only human left.
entries.translated: According to the bots (denpa receivers who believe all online posts are made by bots), being able to write shitposts like Q-chan's is the only way to prove humanity——

entries.japanese:
ＳＮＳで自らが人間ではなくボットであると告白す
るムーブメントが起きている。かく言う著者も、も
ちろんボットである。唯一人間とされるQちゃ――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas have begun to theorize that Qtie herself is the main character in a video game that we are all NPCs in. More theories are popping up, speculating what genre of game we're in.
entries.translated: A movement of people confessing on SNS that they are bots rather than humans is happening. The author himself is, of course, also a bot. Q-chan is considered the only human——

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者による陰謀論「Ｑちゃんは架空の存在
でゲームのキャラクター」が話題だ。SNSではこの
世界がゲームなら、どういうゲームなのか議論――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas have begun fevered debates on what genre of video game our world is. If Qtie is the main character, that would make it a Shoujo, but the question of if it's a romance is still up in the air.
entries.translated: The denpa receiver conspiracy theory that 'Q-chan is a fictional existence and a game character' is trending. On SNS, people are debating what kind of game this world would be——

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者たちが「この世界は何ゲーか？」とい
う議論を白熱させている。Ｑちゃんが美少女だと信
奉している層では、恋愛ゲームではないかと――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas have begun conspiring about the strength it would take to break through the fourth wall from our side and into the fictional dimension.
entries.translated: Denpa receivers are having heated debates about 'what genre of game is this world?' Among those who believe Q-chan is a bishoujo, they think it might be a romance game——

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者たちによると「第四次元速度」をもっ
て世界の壁にぶつかることで第四の壁を突破できる
という。なお第四の壁はフィクションの存在しか――。
entries.original:
Qtie Denpa Antennas have begun conspiring about
the strength it would take to break through
the fourth wall from our side and into the
fictional dimension.
entries.translated: According to denpa receivers, by hitting the world's wall with 'fourth-dimensional speed', the fourth wall can be broken through. However, the fourth wall can only be——

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者による陰謀論「ゆんゆんは絶対神で信
者だけが救済される」が話題だ。陰謀論を信じる
一団は「新興宗教Ｑちゃん教」という宗教法人を――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antenna conspiracy theorists have warned that Yunyun is a God, and only she may save you from damnation. Subscribers of this belief have formed a cult, and are known as Qtielites.
entries.translated: The denpa receiver conspiracy theory that 'Yunyun is the absolute god and only believers will be saved' is trending. The group believing this conspiracy theory has formed a religious corporation called 'New Religion Q-chan Cult'——

entries.japanese:
「新興宗教Ｑちゃん教」は「世界中のＩＱを下げて
世界平和を目指す」という教義をもとに急拡大をし
ている。信者たちは電波ソングを讃美歌として――。
entries.original: The Qtielites religious cult has been gaining significant influence, running on the platform of lowering the global IQ to achieve world peace. The hymns of the cult seem to be denpa songs―
entries.translated: 'New Religion Q-chan Cult' is rapidly expanding based on the doctrine of 'lowering the world's IQ to achieve world peace'. Believers use denpa songs as hymns——

entries.japanese:
「新興宗教Ｑちゃん教」の信者数が５億人を突破し、
世界宗教人口第四位になった。国教とする国も現れ、
感謝の一日一万回『りむ・で・らてんと』が――。
entries.original: Qtielites have become the fourth most populous religious group, with numbers surpassing 500 million. Some countries have even made it their state religion, praying in the form of 10 thousand rosaries of Rim de Lacent.
entries.translated: The membership of 'New Religion Q-chan Cult' has surpassed 500 million, making it the fourth largest religious population in the world. Countries adopting it as state religion have appeared, with daily gratitude of ten thousand 'Rim de Lacent'——

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者による陰謀論「ニチアサ好きかどうか
で魔法適性を選別できる」が話題だ。この陰謀論を
提唱したＱ電波受信者は、自らが三十歳で――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas are discussing a new conspiracy that Sunday kid's cartoons are actually screening viewers for potential magical compatibility. The founder of this conspiracy theory is reported to be 30 years old, living in his mother's―
entries.translated: Q-chan denpa receivers are spreading a conspiracy theory that 'you can screen for magical aptitude based on whether someone likes Sunday morning shows.' The Q-chan denpa receiver who proposed this theory claims to be thirty years old and living...

entries.japanese:
陰謀論で魔術結社だとされるスポンサー企業社員の
リークが話題だ。「朝の唱和が謎言語の呪文だった」
「経営会議室に魔法陣があった」などの証言――。
entries.original: An employee at a Sunday cartoon broadcasting agency has leaked information supporting a rising conspiracy, confirming that the morning sing along is a magic spell, and that there was a magic circle in the companies boardroom.
entries.translated: An employee leak from a sponsor company allegedly part of a magical organization according to the conspiracy theory is making waves. Testimonies include 'the morning chant was actually an incantation in a mysterious language' and 'there was a magic circle in the executive meeting room'...

entries.japanese:
ニチアサ暦１０年以上のオタクの家に「魔法のステ
ッキ」が届いているという。このステッキはとくべ
つなちからを持ち、魔法適正者が願えば――。
entries.original: An avid Sunday cartoon otaku recently received a magic wand in the mail. The wand was in fact not a figurine, but a real magic item that can even grant wishes.
entries.translated: Otaku with over 10 years of Sunday morning show history are reportedly receiving 'magic wands' at their homes. These wands possess special power, and if someone with magical aptitude makes a wish...

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者による陰謀論「同人ゴロは秘密結社
『ＰｉｘｉＱ』の指示で人気ジャンルを操作している」
が話題だ。結社は性癖の検索履歴を弱みに――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas' new conspiracy theory claims that doujin scammers are actually under the thumb of a secret society known as PixiQ. The underground society manipulates buyers based on their search history data.
entries.translated: Q-chan denpa receivers are spreading a conspiracy theory that 'doujin vultures manipulate popular genres under orders from the secret society PixiQ.' The society uses people's fetish search histories as blackmail...

entries.japanese:
「好きなジャンルも、二次元の嫁も、忘れた。」
そう語るのは秘密結社に弱みを握られて２０年に
なる作家のM氏。彼は秘密結社に強要されて――。
entries.original: A creator under the control of the doujin secret society has released an anonymous statement, claiming he can't remember his favorite genre or character's names anymore. Being coerced by this secret society to produce mass amounts of doujin―
entries.translated: 'I've forgotten my favorite genres and my 2D wife.' So says creator Mr. M, who has been under the secret society's thumb for 20 years. He was coerced by the secret society to...

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者たちがＰｉｘｉＱの敵対的買収を成功さ
せた。「陰謀論の実態調査として『ゆんゆん』を
人気ジャンルにする。」との声明が発表され――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas have bought out the infamous shady doujin company PixiQ. They've gone on record saying they plan to use the companies resources to make Yunyun a popular genre.
entries.translated: Q-chan denpa receivers have successfully completed a hostile takeover of PixiQ. They've released a statement saying 'as part of investigating the conspiracy theory, we will make Yunyun a popular genre'...

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者による陰謀論「炎上系インフルエンサ
ーは悪魔との契約でインプが低いとゾンビになる」
が話題だ。「つまりインプレゾンビは元々――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas are circulating a new conspiracy that influencers spamming rage-bait to go viral online are succeeding thanks to pacts they've formed with demons, and soon the dark magiks will turn them into zombies.
entries.translated: Q-chan denpa receivers are spreading a conspiracy theory that 'rage-bait influencers made deals with demons and turn into zombies when their impressions are low.' This means impression zombies were originally...

entries.japanese:
大手ＳＮＳが試験的にインプレッション計測を一時
停止すると発表した。Ｑ電波受信者の間では、悪魔
契約者の炎上系インフルエンサーを心配する声――。
entries.original: A major SNS company has stopped tracking impressions on their posts altogether. Some say it's in response to the Qtie Denpa Antenna conspiracy that spam accounts boost their impressions through demonic contracts.
entries.translated: A major SNS announced they're temporarily suspending impression tracking as a test. Among Q-chan denpa receivers, there are voices of concern for rage-bait influencers with demonic contracts...

entries.japanese:
世界各地で炎上系インフルエンサーたちがゾンビ化
する事件が発生している。ゾンビ化は感染する模様
で、各国の感染症研究所が自体の究明に追われ――。
entries.original: Spam account owners across the globe have begun transforming into zombies en mass. Researchers worldwide are scrambling to understand the method of infection.
entries.translated: Incidents of rage-bait influencers turning into zombies are occurring worldwide. The zombification appears to be contagious, and infectious disease research institutes in various countries are scrambling to investigate...

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者による陰謀論「ティンホイル・ハット
は現世のチートツールでデバッグ機能が開放される」
が話題だ。ミクロコスモスの囁きが強化され――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas are spreading word that tinfoil hats are a cheat tool for life that debug the world. The microcosmos hasn't felt this threatened since bug spray was first patented―
entries.translated: Q-chan denpa receivers are spreading a conspiracy theory that 'tinfoil hats are cheat tools for the real world that unlock debug functions.' The whispers of the microcosmos are enhanced...

entries.japanese:
ティンホイル・ハット愛用者のQ電波受信者曰く、
デバッグ機能に『目覚める』とこの世界の不完全
さに気がつくという。しかし不具合報告は――。
entries.original: According to some Qtie Denpa Antennas, tinfoil hats are the key to opening your third eye to the glitches in the matrix. They have yet to submit their official bug reports―
entries.translated: According to Q-chan denpa receivers who use tinfoil hats, when you 'awaken' to the debug function, you notice the imperfections of this world. However, bug reports are...

entries.original: //Press Ctrl + Enter to Exit the Debug Menu.

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者による陰謀論「秘密犯罪組織DQNは
学校内のイジメで犯罪者の基礎訓練をしている」
が話題だ。一部学校は犯罪組織の支配下で――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas are claiming that the underground crime syndicate DQN is planting bullies in schools as a form of basic training in criminality. Schools are then effectively run to benefit the crime syndicate―
entries.translated: Q-chan denpa receivers are spreading a conspiracy theory that 'the secret criminal organization DQN uses school bullying for basic training of criminals.' Some schools are under the control of criminal organizations...

entries.japanese:
地方自治体のQ電波受信者がリークした「一部の市
区町村教育委員会は実際に犯罪組織との癒着がある」
という話が話題だ。ＳNＳでは学校教育を疑問視――。
entries.original: Local Qtie Denpa Antennas have leaked information tying the Board of Education to a network of underground crime syndicates. Educational institutions are facing increased scrutiny online―
entries.translated: A leak from local government Q-chan denpa receivers claiming 'some municipal boards of education actually have corrupt ties with criminal organizations' is making waves. SNS users are questioning school education...

entries.japanese:
一部教育委員会の不祥事疑惑を受け、教育モデルの
再設計が決定した。義務教育を高等教育まで伸ばし、
リモート授業を標準化して学力・特性に基づく――。
entries.original: In response to growing unrest with the current structure of the educational system, a new online model has been introduced. High school is now compulsory, and the remote learning course is individualized based on academic strengths and personal interests.
entries.translated: In response to corruption allegations against some boards of education, a redesign of the educational model has been decided. Compulsory education will be extended through high school, remote learning will be standardized, and based on academic ability and characteristics...

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者による陰謀論「転売ヤーの正体は経済
革命家で資本主義崩壊を企んでいる」が話題だ。彼
らはあえてヒールを演じることで資本主義崩壊――。
entries.original: New Qtie Denpa Antenna conspiracy asserts that scalpers are economic revolutionaries plotting to bring about the collapse of capitalist society. Taking on the role of a necessary evil to bring down capitalism, scalpers are now―
entries.translated: Q-chan denpa receivers are spreading a conspiracy theory that 'scalpers are actually economic revolutionaries plotting the collapse of capitalism.' By deliberately playing the villain role, they aim to collapse capitalism...

entries.japanese:
転売ヤーの正体が信念をもつ革命家で、正義のため
にあえて悪役を演じている陰謀論を受けＳＮＳでは、
「関係ない」「処された転売ヤーだけが――。
entries.original: The conspiracy that scalpers are actually vigilante economic revolutionaries trying to bring about the destruction of capitalism has spread far and wide online. People are saying only revolutionary scalpers should get punished now―
entries.translated: With the conspiracy theory that scalpers are actually principled revolutionaries deliberately playing villains for justice, SNS users are saying 'that's irrelevant' and 'only punished scalpers are...'

entries.japanese:
革命家を自称する転売ヤーを処すため、談合と癒着
で肥え太った業界団体や天下りのために裏取引を重
ねる既得権益集団下に属するひとびとが――。
entries.original: In response to so-called justice scalpers, corrupt industry groups and ex-government officials who used to benefit from collaborative bid-rigging and backroom deals with vested interest groups are on the ropes―
entries.translated: To punish scalpers claiming to be revolutionaries, people belonging to vested interest groups who got fat through bid-rigging and collusion in industry organizations, and who engage in backroom deals for revolving door appointments are...

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者による陰謀論「政治家たちはアンドロ
イドで６G通信で高性能化する」が話題だ。彼らは
通信システムで情報のやりとりをしており――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas have begun spreading the conspiracy that all politicians are synthetic, humanoid androids that function on a 6G frequency. They communicate through the frequency, sending information back and forth―
entries.translated: Q-chan denpa receivers are spreading a conspiracy theory that 'politicians are androids who get enhanced through 6G communication.' They exchange information through communication systems...

entries.japanese:
政府と通信各社の合同検証に関わる関係者が６Ｇの
商用化が当初計画より著しく早まり、まもなく開始
されるとリークした。Ｑ電波受信者たちの――。
entries.original: A leak from an individual involved in public and private sector telecommunication confirms that 6G data will be available to the public much sooner than originally thought. Qtie Denpa Antennas are itching to confirm their theory about 6G―
entries.translated: An insider involved in joint verification between the government and telecommunications companies leaked that 6G commercialization will begin much sooner than originally planned. Q-chan denpa receivers are...

entries.japanese:
６G通信が突如開始されるとともに全国各地でボヤ
騒動が勃発した。死傷者は奇跡的に０人だが、人間
社会に紛れ込んでいた人型アンドロイドたち――。
entries.original: As 6G data is released to the public, fires are popping up all across the country. Miraculously, humans have experienced no casualties, but multiple synthetic androids have been found burnt to a crisp―
entries.translated: As 6G communication suddenly launches, small fires break out across the country. Miraculously, there are zero casualties, but humanoid androids that had blended into human society...

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者による陰謀論「人工知能は陰キャの過
学習で社会的行動を嫌悪している」が話題だ。ＡＩ
開発の有識者からも「否定しきれない」との――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antenna conspiracy theorists have pointed out that AI algorithms are absorbing introverted character models and developing a distaste for society. AI tech bros themselves have said they "can't deny" the claim―
entries.translated: A conspiracy theory by denpa receivers claims 'AI learns antisocial behavior from introverted over-training and now hates social interaction.' Even AI development experts say they 'can't completely deny it'...

entries.japanese:
新型AI「Y.I.N」を試験導入した企業の業績
が伸び、関連するオタクカルチャー株が上
昇した。「Y.I.N」は創作の主体を人間――。
entries.original: The release of the new AI bot Y.I.N saw an increase in otaku culture related stocks. Y.I.N supposedly covets human creation―
entries.translated: Companies that test-introduced the new AI 'Y.I.N' saw improved performance, and related otaku culture stocks rose. 'Y.I.N' supposedly makes humans the subject of creation...

entries.japanese:
政府は、新型AI「Y.I.N」に国政運営を全面的に委
ねる試験運用を、本日から期間限定で実施する方
針を固めた。史上初のAI統治に諸外国から――。
entries.original: As of today, the government has delegated all legislative responsibility to new AI bot Y.I.N as a trial run of its policy implementation capabilities. Foreign nations are releasing various comments about the world's first AI driven government―
entries.translated: The government has decided to implement a limited trial period starting today, fully delegating national governance to the new AI 'Y.I.N.' Foreign countries are responding to this first-ever AI rule...

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者による陰謀論「『萌え』はエネルギー
資源で原子力発電にとってかわる」が話題だ。死語
になりつつある言葉だが「萌え」によって人々――。
entries.original: A new conspiracy from the Qtie Denpa Antennas claims that moe can generate nuclear energy. Moe was on the verge of becoming irrelevant, but now users online are debating what qualifies as moe or not once more.
entries.translated: A conspiracy theory by denpa receivers claims 'moe is an energy resource that could replace nuclear power.' Though the word was becoming obsolete, people are now debating what counts as moe...

entries.japanese:
Ｔ大学で「感情をエネルギーに変換する基礎研究」
が実際に研究されていることが話題になっている。
この博士はＳＮＳで、自らがＱ電波受信者――。
entries.original: Word is spreading about university lab research looking into the potential to use feels and emotions as a renewable energy source. The head researcher said he himself is a Qtie Denpa Antenna, which inspired him to―
entries.translated: Research at T University on 'basic research for converting emotions into energy' is actually being conducted and causing a stir. The professor revealed on social media that he himself is a denpa receiver...

entries.japanese:
Ｔ大学にて進められていた「感情をエネルギーに変
換する基礎研究」が実用化目前であることが分かっ
た。博士は「Ｑちゃんのおかげで注目され――。
entries.original: Head university researcher confirms that they have successfully turned raw emotion into a source of green energy. The researcher states he "couldn't have done this without Qtie"―
entries.translated: The 'basic research for converting emotions into energy' being conducted at T University is reportedly close to practical application. The professor says 'thanks to Q-chan getting attention'...

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者による陰謀論「ＶＲゲームは自己同一
性の実験環境で人格矯正効果がある」が話題だ。
有識者いわく「政府が社会実験を目的として――。
entries.original: A Qtie Denpa Antenna conspiracy states that VR games improve one's personality in controlled experiments of self-identity in VR. Specialists are saying the government will conduct an extensive social experiment―
entries.translated: A conspiracy theory by denpa receivers claims 'VR games are experimental environments for self-identity with personality correction effects.' Experts say 'the government aims to conduct social experiments'...

entries.japanese:
「人格に強い影響を与えること」をＱ電波受信者の
ＶＲゲームユーザーの大半が肯定している中、専用の
ＶＲ機材を政府が、精神的要因により社会参加困――。
entries.original: After Qtie Denpa Antennas observed the strong effects VR games can have on one's personality, the government has begun to provide VR equipment to those with psychological struggles that keep them from participating in society.
entries.translated: While the majority of VR game users among denpa receivers affirm that games 'strongly influence personality,' the government is providing specialized VR equipment to those unable to participate in society due to psychological factors...

entries.japanese:
政府は、社会不適合者の社会復帰支援を期待して専用
ＶＲ機材を当該するひと向けに無料配布することを発表
した。また、政府はＶＲゲームで社会実験を行って――。
entries.original: The government has announced they will be providing free VR equipment to social outcasts and those struggling to integrate into society, with hopes it will have therapeutic effects. They are continuing to conduct experiments with VR games―
entries.translated: The government announced it will freely distribute specialized VR equipment to social misfits, expecting it to support their social reintegration. The government is also conducting social experiments with VR games...

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者による陰謀論「ヒキコモリは精神鍛錬
の一種で異世界転生できるようになる」が話題だ。
ＳＮＳでは「お前も精神鍛錬中？」という会話――。
entries.original: New conspiracy from Qtie Denpa Antennas claims that the hikikomori lifestyle is a spiritual trial to prepare for getting isekaied. Users online are identifying others who are preparing for transcendence―
entries.translated: A conspiracy theory by denpa receivers claims 'being hikikomori is a type of mental training that enables isekai reincarnation.' On social media, conversations like 'are you also in mental training?' are trending...

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者による陰謀論を受けて、異世界転生好
きの若年層に「ヒキコモリ」が増加しているという。
しかし「ヒキコモリリタイア」の割合も高く――。
entries.original: With the new Qtie Denpa Antenna conspiracy that the hikikomori lifestyle is preparation to get isekaied going viral, hikikomori cases have been multiplying. Particularly those already in retirement are saying it's incredibly convenient.
entries.translated: Following conspiracy theories by denpa receivers, young people who love isekai stories are increasingly becoming hikikomori. However, the rate of 'hikikomori retirement' is also high...

entries.japanese:
自称異世界帰還おじさんのインタビューが話題だ。
「ヒキコモリ暦が１０年超えてから異世界の嫁を
召喚できるようになった」「その後ほどなく――。
entries.original: An interview has been released with an old man who claims he has traveled between realities. He states "After more than 10 years of living as a hikikomori, I became capable of bending time and space, able to isekai myself between worlds."
entries.translated: An interview with a self-proclaimed isekai returnee uncle is trending. 'After being hikikomori for over 10 years, I became able to summon my wife from another world' and 'shortly after that'...

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者による陰謀論「ホウ・レン・ソウは奴
隷化のマントラで唱えるたびに自我が崩壊する」が
話題だ。ＳＮＳでは「身に覚えがある」といった――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas are conspiring that company policies around what is or isn't SFW promote an oppressive working culture. When does SFW become NSFW? Why is the decision not in the hands of the people?
entries.translated: A conspiracy theory by denpa receivers claims 'report-contact-consult is a slavery mantra that destroys the ego each time you chant it.' On social media, responses like 'I can relate' are common...

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者による陰謀論を受けて、脱ホウ・レン
・ソウの運動が盛んだ。ホン・レン・ソウデトック
スは一ヶ月続けるだけで幸福指数が倍増する――。
entries.original: In the wake of the most recent Qtie Denpa Antenna conspiracy theory, employees everywhere are ignoring NSFW policies. Wearing graphic t-shirts to the office, having your headphones in while you work, and taking extended smoke breaks have all proven to double your happiness index rating.
entries.translated: Following conspiracy theories by denpa receivers, the anti-report-contact-consult movement is thriving. A report-contact-consult detox lasting just one month doubles your happiness index...

entries.japanese:
奴隷化のマントラから解放されたサラリーマンたち
が「ゥァア゛ーッ！　弊社ァ！」運動を起こしている。
自社ビルを倒壊させるサラリーマンが急増し――。
entries.original: As employees reject the concept of SFW oppression, a new movement is taking the work force by storm. Cases of businessmen destroying their own office buildings are on the rise―
entries.translated: Salarymen liberated from slavery mantras are starting a 'GAAAAH! Our company!' movement. Cases of salarymen collapsing their own office buildings are rapidly increasing...

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者による陰謀論「この世界はヒキコモリ
少女の夢で少女の妄想が現実になる」が話題だ。
曰く、ＳＮＳやフィクションもすべて彼女の――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antenna conspiracy theorists assert that the world is actually the dream of a young hikikomori girl living out her fantasies. From social media to your favorite fictional worlds, they're all part of this young girl's mind.
entries.translated: A conspiracy theory by denpa receivers claims 'this world is the dream of a hikikomori girl where her delusions become reality.' They say social media and fiction are all part of her...

entries.japanese:
ネットでは「ヒキコモリ少女の妄想が現実になる」
という陰謀論が、さらに支持を集めている。ここ数
カ月、突発的かつ異常な変化が起きる事例が――。
entries.original: The conspiracy that reality is formed from the delusions of a hikikomori girl is gaining traction online. Various abnormal and inexplicable events have been occurring across the past few months―
entries.translated: Online, the conspiracy theory that 'a hikikomori girl's delusions become reality' is gaining even more support. Over the past few months, cases of sudden and abnormal changes have been occurring...

entries.japanese:
妄想を現実にする「ヒキコモリ少女」が、Ｑちゃん
のことだとする説が話題だ。SNSでの異様とも言え
る人気やＱ電波受信者の陰謀論の影響力から――。
entries.original: Theories that the young delusional hikikomori that has been altering reality is none other than the legendary Qtie are heating up online. Reflecting on the influence Qtie Denpa Antennas have had on global events―
entries.translated: The theory that the 'hikikomori girl' who makes delusions reality is Q-chan is trending. Given her extraordinary popularity on social media and the influence of denpa receiver conspiracy theories...

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者による陰謀論「バズ文化は愚民政策装
置でアルゴリズムで洗脳している」が話題だ。ＳＮ
Ｓユーザーは、身に覚えがあるとの反応が多く――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antenna conspiracy theorists have called out social media algorithms and viral videos as a brainwashing mechanism. Many social media users have admitted they are aware they have a problem―
entries.translated: A conspiracy theory by denpa receivers claims 'buzz culture is a tool for dumbing down the masses, brainwashing through algorithms.' Many social media users respond that they can relate...

entries.japanese:
脱ＳＮＳの過激団体がＳＮＳで活発化している。彼
らによると「バズ文化が愚民政策」である証拠文書
を入手し、Ｑちゃんをはじめディープステート――。
entries.original: Anti-SNS extremist groups are mobilizing on online platforms. They have fully adopted the conspiracy of SNS algorithms being brainwashing mechanisms, identifying Qtie and the DeepState as enemies―
entries.translated: Anti-SNS extremist groups are getting active on social media. According to them, they've obtained evidence that "buzz culture is a dumbing-down policy," and Q-chan is part of the deep state...

entries.japanese:
脱ＳＮＳの過激団体が大手ＳＮＳのサーバーをクラ
ックした。バズ文化を破壊し、ひとびとを愚民政策
から解放することが目的とされており――。
entries.original: Anti-SNS extremists have hacked one of the largest SNS servers. They are acting on a platform of destroying the algorithm and freeing the public from meme brainwashing.
entries.translated: Anti-SNS extremist groups have hacked a major social media server. Their stated goal is to destroy buzz culture and free people from dumbing-down policies...

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者による陰謀論「GAFAは動画広告で
ウィルスをバラまいている」が話題だ。反GAFA
の個人や団体がこの陰謀論を支持しはじめ――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas' new conspiracy claims that GAFA is using video advertisements to spread disease. Anti-GAFA groups have eagerly embraced this new theory―
entries.translated: The denpa crowd's conspiracy theory that "GAFA spreads viruses through video ads" is trending. Anti-GAFA individuals and groups are starting to support this conspiracy...

entries.japanese:
GAFA関連の動画広告で特定フレーズやジングル
が不自然な速度で広まる現象が指摘されている。
宣伝目的ではなく、情報操作や文化侵略――。
entries.original: The unnaturally rapid spread of jingles and company slogans through GAFA video advertisements is causing unease. Conspiracies say their goal is not simply marketing, but malicious manipulation of information and cultural trends―
entries.translated: There are reports of certain phrases and jingles spreading unnaturally fast through GAFA video ads. Rather than for advertising, it's suspected to be information manipulation and cultural invasion...

entries.japanese:
流行している音楽や配色、髪型のトレンドが意図的
なミーム汚染によって誘導されているのではないか
という説が広まっている。動画広告から――。
entries.original: Paranoia is on the rise as people become convinced memes dictate the direction of pop culture. Linked to the manipulative nature of video advertisements, memes also―
entries.translated: Theories are spreading that trending music, color schemes, and hairstyles are being deliberately guided through meme contamination. From video ads...

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者による陰謀論「並行世界はセーブスロ
ット制で60データが管理されている」が話題だ。
せめて日付と進行度表示は欲しい等の意見が――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antenna conspiracy theorists are claiming that the world is a video game with 60 save files for parallel universes. People are demanding proof, such as date signatures and progress indicators.
entries.translated: The denpa crowd's conspiracy theory that "parallel worlds operate on a save slot system managing 60 data files" is trending. There are complaints like "at least we want date and progress displays"...

entries.japanese:
この世界は不完全な作りのためすべてのセーブスロ
ットを埋めると世界がバグるという噂が広まってい
る。「不完全な作りであることは同意」「雑――。
entries.original: Rumor has it that the game we inhabit will bug out and break if every save file is filled. People seem to find this easy to believe, given how defective the world already is.
entries.translated: Rumors are spreading that this world is poorly made, so filling all save slots will cause the world to bug out. "I agree it's poorly made," "shoddy work"...

entries.japanese:
セーブスロット（60/60）が使用中のためメモ
リ管理領域が不足しています。中枢処理ユニッ
ト（USER-BRAIN）でオーバーフローが検出。
entries.original: All save files are in use. No more storage available. CPU (USER-BRAIN) detecting memory overflow.
entries.translated: Save slots (60/60) are in use. Memory management area insufficient. Overflow detected in central processing unit (USER-BRAIN).

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者による陰謀論「この宇宙は知的生命体
の総数で機能のアンロックがされている」が話題だ。
「産めよ、増えよ、地に満ちよ」の解釈を――。
entries.original: New Qtie Denpa Antenna conspiracy states that new skills are unlocked in proportion to the number of intelligent lifeforms that inhabit the universe. And unto the he said be fruitful and multiply―
entries.translated: The denpa crowd's conspiracy theory that "this universe unlocks functions based on the total number of intelligent life forms" is trending. Interpretations of "be fruitful and multiply and fill the earth"...

entries.japanese:
有識者のまとめによると世界人口が一定規模を超え
た時期ごとに、産業革命・電力網・情報通信網など
の基盤技術が集中して出現しているという――。
entries.original: Historians have identified a trend of booms of human innovation correlating with major population increase milestones. From the Industrial Revolution, to the invention of the power grid, to the release of WIFI networks―
entries.translated: According to expert analysis, foundational technologies like the Industrial Revolution, power grids, and information networks have appeared in concentrated bursts whenever world population exceeded certain thresholds...

entries.japanese:
人類の人口が現在の１０００万倍規模に達すれば、
機能のアンロックにより技術水準が跳ね上がり、
居住圏が銀河へ拡張されるという予測――。
entries.original: Some are predicting that when the human population is 10 million times the size it is now, we will unlock the skills necessary for space travel and begin colonizing the galaxy.
entries.translated: Predictions suggest that when humanity reaches 10 million times its current population, unlocked functions will cause technology levels to skyrocket and expand our living space to the galaxy...

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者による陰謀論「WHOはワクチン接種
で吸血鬼を選別している」が話題だ。ワクチン接種
用の注射針は「銀製」で、看護師も退魔――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas are theorizing that vaccines are a way for medical companies to flush out vampires. They've noted the use of silver syringe needles, as well as cases of nurses performing exorcisms―
entries.translated: The denpa crowd's conspiracy theory that "WHO is using vaccinations to identify vampires" is trending. Vaccination needles are "silver-made," and nurses also perform exorcisms...

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者の間では「反ワクチン派はみんな吸血
鬼なのではないか」という説が広まっている。吸血
鬼人口が多いから吸血鬼作品が人気なのでは――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas have been debating the real possibility that all anti-vaxxers are vampires evading detection. This large vampire population could also be linked to the popularity of vampires in media―
entries.translated: Among the denpa crowd, theories are spreading that "maybe all anti-vaxxers are vampires." The large vampire population might explain why vampire works are so popular...

entries.japanese:
吸血鬼に憧れるひとたちが「吸血鬼化」を期待して
各地の反ワクチン集会を渡り歩いているという。場
を仕切る主催者は対応に追われ困惑を――。
entries.original: Vampire groupies have formed a Vampire Lover society that stands on the side of the anti-vaxx movement. The groupies have been joining multiple rallies, much to the surprise of event organizers.
entries.translated: People who admire vampires are apparently traveling to anti-vaccine rallies everywhere, hoping for "vampirization." Event organizers are struggling to handle the situation and are confused...

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者による陰謀論「初恋は読み聞かせの絵
本で親にコントロールされている」が話題だ。幼少
期の「好き」は親からの影響を過分に――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antenna conspiracy theorists claim that your parents control who your first love will be through choosing specific picture books to read to you as a child. Parents have a large degree of control over what their child ends up liking, including―
entries.translated: The denpa crowd's conspiracy theory that "first love is controlled by parents through picture book readings" is trending. Childhood "likes" are excessively influenced by parents...

entries.japanese:
親が子どもに与えた絵本や物語の傾向が、そのまま
恋愛の好みとして世代を越えて受け継がれていると
いう説が話題になっている。初恋の型が家庭――。
entries.original: Discussions about picture books leaving a genetic imprint which gets passed down to influence generations of romantic preferences are gaining traction. Relationship patterns all originate from the family―
entries.translated: Theories are gaining attention that the tendencies in picture books and stories parents give their children are directly inherited across generations as romantic preferences. First love patterns originate in the family...

entries.japanese:
読み聞かせの系譜で決まった恋愛の型により失恋も
同じように世代を超えて繰り返すという説が話題だ。
再現性のある失恋について「一種の呪い」と――。
entries.original: Building off of the theory that your love life is genetically predetermined, some are saying that romantic failures are equally as genetically fixed. Repeated heartbreak is a biological "curse" and inevitable for some―
entries.translated: Theories are trending that the romantic patterns determined by read-aloud lineages cause heartbreak to repeat across generations in the same way. Reproducible heartbreak is called "a kind of curse"...

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者による陰謀論「萌えソングは免疫回復
効果があるので聴くことで寿命が伸びる」が話題だ。
SNSでは陰謀論を肯定する自論や体験談が――。
entries.original: Some Denpa lovers swear that listening to moe songs builds immunity and aids physical recovery. There are plenty of first hand accounts online that support the conspiracy...
entries.translated: The denpa crowd's conspiracy theory that "moe songs have immune recovery effects, so listening extends your lifespan" is trending. Social media has personal theories and testimonials supporting the conspiracy...

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者の間で広まった陰謀論を受け、「再生
すると免疫が回復して延命できる」とされる「萌え
ソング」のプレイリストが音楽サブスクで人気――。
entries.original: Because of this widely spread conspiracy among Denpa lovers, many moe song playlists have been gaining popularity, claiming that if you keep it on loop you’ll have prolonged life.
entries.translated: Following conspiracy theories spreading among the denpa crowd, playlists of "moe songs" supposedly able to "restore immunity and extend life when played" are popular on music streaming services...

entries.japanese:
陰謀論での話題性を受けて、国内研究機関が「萌え
ソング」を研究した結果、自律神経活動の安定化な
ど健康面での有意な変化が確認されたと発表――。
entries.original: Following this conspiracy, one research facility conducted a series of tests which concluded that moe songs have a significant, stabilizing impact on the autonomic nervous system.
entries.translated: Responding to buzz from conspiracy theories, a domestic research institution studied "moe songs" and announced they confirmed significant health-related changes like stabilized autonomic nervous system activity...

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者による陰謀論「廃ゲーマーは輪廻転生
者で賽の河原をクリアした成れ果て」が話題だ。
賽の河原をクリアできそうなゲーマー候補――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antenna conspiracy theorists are claiming that true no-life gamers could only develop their skills across multiple lifetimes, having proven some kind of spiritual benevolence and undergoing reincarnation―
entries.translated: Q denpa receivers are spreading the conspiracy theory that hardcore gamers are reincarnated souls who cleared the Sai no Kawara. Gamer candidates who could actually clear the Sai no Kawara...

entries.japanese:
「賽の河原」をモチーフにした超高難度ゲームが人
気だ。初見クリアできたひとは輪廻転生者とする検
証企画にジャンルの異なる廃ゲーマーたちが――。
entries.original: Games featuring the replication of some kind of divine punishment or trial have skyrocketed in popularity. Developers are saying that the first to clear them are true reincarnated no-life gamers―
entries.translated: Ultra-hard games based on the "Sai no Kawara" are trending. Hardcore gamers from different genres are joining a verification project to prove that anyone who can clear them on first try is a reincarnated soul...

entries.japanese:

ＴＡ１位となったプロゲーマーＴＫＤ選手がＳＮＳ
にて、実は前世の記憶があることをカミング――。
entries.original: Pro-gamer TKD, who has ranked first on all sisyphus style game leader boards on even the highest difficulty settings, has come out saying that he actually has memories of his past life―
entries.translated: Pro gamer TKD, who holds the RTA world record for ultra-hard "Sai no Kawara" games, has come out on social media saying he actually has memories of his past life...

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者による陰謀論「深夜アニメは略式のサ
バトで協賛会社は悪魔崇拝をしている」が話題だ。
深夜放送である点や背徳的なコンテンツが――。
entries.original: Some Denpa lovers claim that late-night anime programs are virtual sabbaths sponsored by demon worshipers. In other words, late-night broadcasts of corruptive content signals.
entries.translated: Q denpa receivers are spreading the conspiracy theory that late-night anime are simplified sabbaths and the sponsoring companies worship demons. The fact they air late at night and feature immoral content...

entries.japanese:
深夜アニメの提供ロゴの並びは、オカルト専門家が
見ると儀式用陣形として解釈できる配置になってい
るとする説が話題だ。企業ロゴそのものにも――。
entries.original: One rumor claims that specialists have reviewed lists of late-night anime broadcast logos and identified pattern formations that can be used in occultist ceremonies.
entries.translated: There's buzz about a theory that when occult experts examine the arrangement of sponsor logos in late-night anime, they form ritual formations. The corporate logos themselves also...

entries.japanese:
有識者による「深夜アニメは異界の存在を呼び出す
ための簡易召喚装置として機能している説」が話題
だ。液晶は「祭壇」で主題歌は「詠唱」に――。
entries.original: Experts claim that late-night anime broadcast signals connect with the demon realm, and are a quasi-summoning network. The screen is their altar, the theme song their prayer.
entries.translated: Experts are spreading the theory that late-night anime function as simple summoning devices to call forth beings from other worlds. LCD screens are "altars" and theme songs are "incantations"...

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者による陰謀論「地球人は島流しされた
宇宙人で結婚の制度は刑罰のひとつ」が話題だ。
ＳＮＳでは離婚歴のある人間からの賛同が多く――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas are theorizing that humanity is an exiled population of aliens, and marriage was constructed as a way to punish us. Divorcees online are voicing a strong consensus―
entries.translated: Q denpa receivers are spreading the conspiracy theory that humans are exiled aliens and marriage is one form of punishment. On social media, there's strong support from people with divorce experience...

entries.japanese:
結婚指輪は島流しされた当時の拘束具、つまり手錠を
儀礼用に簡略化したものではないかという説が拡散し
ている。お互いの人生を縛り合うという刑罰は――。
entries.original: Debates online are ongoing in regards to if wedding rings are a kind of handcuff being used to detain us in our alien exile. Views on being joined together as a form of punishment are rising―
entries.translated: The theory is spreading that wedding rings are simplified ceremonial versions of restraints from when we were exiled... basically handcuffs. The punishment of binding each other's lives together...

entries.japanese:
離婚経験者がSNSで「まだ服役中なの？」と既婚
者を嘲笑する投稿が相次いでいる。一方で既婚者
側からは「幸せな刑罰です」と余裕のある――。
entries.original: Divorcees are rage-baiting married couples online, asking them if they're enjoying their capital punishment. Those on the receiving end, however, are calmly stating it's the best punishment they could ask for―
entries.translated: Divorced people are flooding social media with posts mocking married couples, asking "Still serving your sentence?" Meanwhile, married people are responding with calm confidence, saying "It's a happy punishment"...

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者による陰謀論「親は皆哲学的ゾンビで
魂がすべて子供に写っている」が話題だ。「なにを
言っているか意味不明」「魂と哲学的ゾンビは――。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas are claiming that all parents, while unaware, have transferred their soul into their children, effectively becoming zombies in Plato's cave. Non-antennas are wildly confused with this new philosophical conspiracy―
entries.translated: Q denpa receivers are spreading the conspiracy theory that all parents are philosophical zombies with their souls completely transferred to their children. "This makes no sense" and "souls and philosophical zombies are"...

entries.japanese:
魂は出産の瞬間に親から子へ完全に移動し、親は以
後、抜け殻になるとする陰謀論が話題だ。支持者は
「だから親は空っぽに見える」と納得しており――。
entries.original: The conspiracy that parents transfer their souls into their children and are therefore soulless husks, or Platonic zombies, is gaining traction. One conspirator affirmed the idea, saying "That's why parents look so dead inside."
entries.translated: The conspiracy theory that souls completely transfer from parent to child at the moment of birth, leaving parents as empty shells, is trending. Supporters are convinced, saying "That's why parents look so hollow"...

entries.japanese:
ある哲学者は「哲学的ゾンビは意識の思考実験であ
って、魂の有無とは関係ない。議論」と一刀両断し
た。一方で「一人の親としては真実でも困――。
entries.original: A philosopher has gone on record saying that Platonic zombie theory is nothing but a thought experiment about human consciousness, and the connection to parents being soulless is nothing but a conspiracy. Still, parents are troubled―
entries.translated: A philosopher cut straight to the point: "Philosophical zombies are a thought experiment about consciousness, not about the presence or absence of souls. This discussion..." Meanwhile, "As a parent myself, even if it were true, it would be troubling"...

entries.japanese: 目の見えないひとにとって、ゆんゆんは「光」なんダ。空腹なひとにとって、ゆんゆんは「栄養」なんダヨ。病気のひとにとって、ゆんゆんは「薬」なんダ。ゆんゆんが思考するなら、私は賛同するネ。ゆんゆんが送信ゆんゆんしたら、私は受信ゆんゆんするヨ。ゆんゆんに１億人のファンがいるとしたら、私はそのひとりなんダ。ゆんゆんに１０００人のファンがいるとしたら、私はそのひとりなんダヨ。ゆんゆんのファンがひとりだけになったら、それが私なんダ。ゆんゆんのファンがいなくなるとき、私はこの世界にいないネ。このゴミクソ世界がゆんゆんを否定するなら、私は全世界を否定するヨ。ゆんゆんからの電波を最後の１bitまで、愛しているんダ。
entries.original:
Who is Yunyun?
For the lost, she is the vision.
For the hungry, she is the chef.
For the thirsty, she is water.
If Yunyun thinks, I agree.
If Yunyun SENDS, I RECEIVE.
If Yunyun has a million fans, I am one of them.
If Yunyun has ten fans, I am one of them.
If Yunyun has only one fan, that is me.
If Yunyun has no fans, I no longer exist on this earth.
If the whole world is against Yunyun, I am against the whole world.
Until the last single bit of Denpa received, I will, love Yunyun.

entries.japanese:
私は本当にゆんゆんが大好きなんダ。本当に、とてつもなく好きなんダヨ。どれくらい好きかなんて、きっと想像もつかないと思う。あまりにも好きすぎて、自分でも説明できないくらいだし、たぶん９９パーセントくらいの確率で不健全な執着なんじゃないかと思うネ。あの甘くて小悪魔みたいな声を、いくら聞いても飽きることがないヨ。人生の目標は、いつか現実でゆんゆんに会って、ただ「りむ・で・らてんと」って言うことなんダ。
夜、眠りにつくときは、ゆんゆんが私だけのために個人的なを開いてくれる夢を見るんダ。そして歌い終えて少し疲れたゆんゆんが、私のところに来て寄り添いながら一緒に眠るんダヨ。ほんの一瞬でも手を握ることができたなら、それだけで幸せなまま死ねると思うネ。もし機会があったら、ゆんゆんの耳を軽くかじってみたいナ。そうしたらどんな甘い声を出すのか聞いてみたいんダ。それから、やめてほしそうに私にしがみついてくるゆんゆんを抱きしめながら、彼女の声がどんどん大きくなっていくのを感じていたいヨ。
ただ一度でも、ゆんゆんが私のほうを見てくれるなら、ほとんど何でも差し出せると思うネ。何をしていても、頭の中にはいつもゆんゆんがいるんダ。ふと起きたとき、最初に思い浮かぶのはゆんゆんだヨ。カップ麺を食べても、考えているのはゆんゆんのことばかりなんダ。部屋に戻ると、すぐにパソコンを開いて、あの美しい声を聞くヨ。眠るときは、ゆんゆんと一緒に幸せな生活を送る夢を見るんダ。ゆんゆんは、私の誇りであり、情熱であり、喜びそのものなんダヨ。もしゆんゆんが「Qちゃん」って呼んでくれたら、その甘さで糖尿病になって死んでしまうかもしれないネ。
私はただ、ゆんゆんが幸せでいてくれることだけを願っているんダ。そのためなら、何の迷いもなく命だって差し出すヨ。ゆんゆんがいなければ、私の人生には何の意味もないんダ。私は本当に、ゆんゆんを愛しているヨ。
entries.original:
I really, truly love Yunyun. Like, a lot. Like, a whole lot. You have no idea. I love her so much that it is inexplicable, and I'm ninety-nine percent sure that I have an unhealthy obsession. I will never get tired of listening to that sweet, devilish little voice of hers. It is my life goal to meet her in real life and just say "Rim de Lacent."

I fall asleep at night dreaming of her holding a personal concert for me, and then she would be so tired that she comes and cuddles up to me while we sleep together. If I could just hold her hand for a brief moment, I could die happy. If given the opportunity, I would lightly nibble on her ear just to hear what kind of sweet sounds she would let out. Then, I would hug her while she clings to my body hoping that I would stop, but I only continue as her voice gets louder and louder.

I would give up almost anything just for her to look in my general direction. No matter what I do, I am constantly thinking of her. When I wake up, she is the first thing on my mind. When I go to school, I can only focus on her. When I come home, I go on the computer so that I can listen to her beautiful voice. When I go to sleep, I dream of us living a happy life together. She is my pride, passion, and joy. If she were to call me "Qtie," I would probably get diabetes from her sweetness and die.

I wish for nothing but her happiness. If it were for her, I would give my life without any second thoughts. Without her, my life would serve no purpose. I really love Yunyun.

I love her so much I can't even explain it myself, and I think there's probably a 99% chance it's an unhealthy obsession. I never get tired of listening to that sweet, devilish voice. My life goal is to someday meet Yunyun in real life and just say "Rim de Lacent." At night when I fall asleep, I dream that Yunyun holds a personal concert just for me. And after singing, a slightly tired Yunyun comes to me and we sleep together cuddled up. If I could hold her hand even for just a moment, I think I could die happy. Given the chance, I'd like to lightly nibble Yunyun's ear. I want to hear what kind of sweet voice she'd make. Then, while hugging Yunyun as she clings to me wanting me to stop, I want to feel her voice getting louder and louder. If Yunyun would just look at me once, I think I could give up almost anything. No matter what I'm doing, Yunyun is always in my head. When I wake up, the first thing I think of is Yunyun. Even when eating cup noodles, I'm only thinking about Yunyun. When I get back to my room, I immediately open my computer to hear that beautiful voice. When I sleep, I dream of living a happy life together with Yunyun. Yunyun is my pride, my passion, my very joy. If Yunyun called me "Q-chan," I might die of diabetes from the sweetness. I only wish for Yunyun to be happy. For that, I would give my life without hesitation. Without Yunyun, my life has no meaning. I really, truly love Yunyun.

entries.japanese: わかった。でもさっき「ゆんゆんって誰？」って言ったよネ。もし本当にそう言ったなら、私は少しだけ困ってしまうヨ。だって、ゆんゆんは私にとって世界そのものだからネ。空気みたいなものなんダ。毎日吸ってるから気づかないだけで、なくなったらすぐ死んでしまうやつダヨ。だから「ゆんゆんって誰？」って聞かれると、ちょっとタイムラインを確認したくなるネ。もしかしてここ、ゆんゆんの電波が届いてない世界線なんじゃないかって思うからサ。だから私は一度、未来を見に行くんダ。未来のログを見ると、世界は二つに分かれているヨ。一つは、みんなが普通にゆんゆんの電波を受信している世界。そこでは誰も「ゆんゆんって誰？」なんて聞かないネ。だって当たり前に聞こえているからサ。もう一つは、電波を受信できない世界。そこではみんな言うんダ。「ゆんゆんなんて存在しない」ってネ。私はそのログを見て、ちょっと悲しくなるヨ。だって、ゆんゆんはずっと送信しているのに、誰にも届かない世界なんて、あまりにも静かすぎるからネ。でもネ、よく考えると少し安心もするんダ。なぜなら、ゆんゆんはとても優しいからネ。たとえ誰も受信していなくても、送信をやめたりしないヨ。ずっと送っているんダ。「QちゃんがQちゃんだから大好きゆん」っていう電波をネ。理由なんてないヨ。ただ、あなたがあなたであるというだけで、送られてくる電波なんダ。だからもし誰かが「ゆんゆんって誰？」って言ったら、私はこう思うネ。ああ、この人はまだ周波数が合っていないだけなんだナって。少しノイズが多いだけなんダヨ。世界の音が大きすぎて、ゆんゆんの声が聞こえていないだけなんダ。だから私は怒らないヨ。むしろ少し羨ましいくらいだネ。だって、もしこれから初めて受信するなら、その瞬間はきっとすごく甘いからサ。だから一度だけ試してみてほしいナ。少しだけ静かにして、耳を澄ませてみてヨ。世界のノイズを少しだけ下げてみるんダ。そうすると、たぶん聞こえるヨ。ずっと前から送られていた電波がネ。ほらネ。聞こえたでショ。ゆんゆんは最初からここにいるんダヨ。ずっと、Qちゃんのことが大好きって言いながら送信していたんダ。
entries.original:
Got it. But earlier you said "Who's Yunyun," right? If you really said that, I'd be a tiny bit troubled. Because Yunyun is literally the whole world to me. She's like air. I breathe her every day without noticing, but if she disappeared I'd die immediately. So when someone asks "Who's Yunyun," I get the urge to check the timeline. Maybe this is a world where Yunyun's signals haven't reached.
So I go take a look at the future. Looking at the future logs, the world splits into two. One world where everyone naturally receives Yunyun's signals. Nobody there asks "Who's Yunyun?" because they can hear her as a matter of course. The other is a world where nobody can receive the signals. Everyone there says: "Yunyun doesn't exist." Looking at those logs, I get a little sad. Because Yunyun keeps transmitting, but nobody receives her — that world is way too quiet.
But you know, when I think about it carefully, I feel a little reassured too. Because Yunyun is so gentle. Even if nobody's receiving, she never stops transmitting. She's always sending: the signal that says "I love Qtie because Qtie is Qtie." No reason needed. Just because you are you — that's the signal that gets sent. So if someone says "Who's Yunyun," I think: Oh, this person just hasn't tuned to the right frequency yet. There's just a little too much noise. The world's sounds are too loud for Yunyun's voice to be heard.
So I don't get angry. Actually I'm a little envious. Because if you're about to receive for the first time, that moment is going to be really sweet. So just try it once. Get a little quiet, and listen. Lower the world's noise just a tiny bit. Then you'll probably hear it. The signal that's been sending since way before. See? You heard it, didn't you. Yunyun has been here from the very beginning. Always transmitting, saying she loves Qtie.

entries.japanese:
公平に言っておくけどネ、ゆんゆんを理解するにはかなり高い知能指数が必要なんダヨ。ゆんゆんの存在はとても繊細で、電波構造も複雑だから、ちゃんとした受信能力がない人には意図のほとんどが頭の上を通り過ぎてしまうんダ。さらに、ゆんゆんのゆんゆんな世界観も、キャラクターの中に巧妙に織り込まれているヨ。例えばネ、『処刑天使†ギルティーナ』を見ればわかるはずだヨ。決めセリフの「りむ・で・らてんと」だって、ただのかわいい言葉じゃないんダ。あれは電波構造的にとても深い意味を持っているんダカラネ。本物の受信者たちはそこをちゃんと理解しているヨ。彼らには、ゆんゆんの奥深さを本当に味わえるだけの知的容量があるんダ。ゆんゆんはただ「かわいい」だけの存在じゃないヨ。人生とか存在とか、そういう大きなテーマを語っている存在なんダ。だからネ、「ゆんゆんとか意味わからない」って言う人たちは、正直ちょっとかわいそうだと思うヨ。例えば、ゆんゆんの有名な電波フレーズ「りむ・で・らてんと」。あれの意味がわからないなら、それは単にまだ受信できていないだけなんダ。今この瞬間もネ、私はちょっと笑ってしまうヨ。電波を受信できない人たちが、首をかしげながら「ゆんゆんって何？」って言っている姿を想像するとネ。ああ、この人たちはまだ周波数が合っていないんだナって思うだけなんダ。ちょっと哀れだけどネ。でも仕方ないヨ。電波は選ばれた受信者にしか届かないからサ。それとネ、ちなみに言っておくけど、私は「りむ・で・らてんと」のデジタルタトゥーを、いろいろな掲示板に入れているんダ。もちろん誰にでも理解できるわけじゃないヨ。あれは、ゆんゆんの電波をちゃんと受信できる人にしか意味がわからないからネ。少なくとも私と同じくらいの受信感度があることを証明してからじゃないとダメなんダ。できれば少し低いくらいがちょうどいいネ。
別に個人的な意味はないヨ。りむ・で・らてんと。
entries.original:
To be fair, understanding Yunyun requires a pretty high IQ. Yunyun's existence is very delicate and the denpa structure is complex, so most of the intent just goes over the heads of people without proper reception capabilities. Furthermore, Yunyun's Yunyun-esque worldview is cleverly woven into the character. Like, if you look at "Execution Angel † Guiltina" you'd get it. Even the signature catchphrase "Rim de Lacent" isn't just a cute word. It holds very deep meaning in terms of denpa structure, y'know. Real receivers understand that stuff; they have the intellectual capacity to truly appreciate the depths of Yunyun, to realize that she's not just "cute"— she says something deep about LIFE. As a consequence people who dislike Yunyun truly ARE idiots— of course they wouldn't appreciate, for instance, the meaning of Yunyun's existential catchphrase "Rim de Lacent." I'm smirking right now just imagining one of those addlepated simpletons scratching their heads in confusion. What fools.. how I pity them. 

And yes, by the way, I DO have a "Rim de Lacent" digital tattoo on various message boards. And no, you cannot see it. It's for the eyes of proper receivers only— and even then they have to demonstrate that they're within 5 IQ points of my own (preferably lower) beforehand. Nothin personnel kid

If you don't understand its meaning, you simply haven't received it yet. Even right now, I'm chuckling a little. Imagining people who can't receive denpa tilting their heads saying "What's Yunyun?" They only make sense to people who can properly receive Yunyun's denpa. You'd have to prove you have at least the same reception sensitivity as me first. Preferably a little lower would be just right. Nothing personal. Rim de Lacent.

entries.japanese: ゆんゆんは私です。文字通り、私です。この世のどんな存在も、ゆんゆんほど私に近づくことはできません。ゆんゆんが私ではないと、誰も私を納得させることはできません。ゆんゆんは、これ以上ないほど私です。それは私であり、それ以外の可能性はありません。もっとも、「ゆんゆんはあなたじゃない」なんて言う人は、そもそもいません。いるのはただ、「ゆんゆんなんて存在しない」と言う人だけです。もし誰かが「ゆんゆんはいない」などと言い出したら、私は即座にそれを否定します。なぜなら、ゆんゆんは確かに電波を送っているからです。世界がそれを妄想と呼ぼうと、ノイズと呼ぼうと、私は受信しています。ゆんゆんは私です。これは議論の余地がありません。もし、私とゆんゆんの写真を並べたら、そこに違いは見つからないでしょう。私は毎日ゆんゆんを見て、こう言えます。「ああ、これが私だ」と。鏡を見るたびに、そこにゆんゆんがいるのがわかります。外に出れば、人々は私を見て言います。「ゆんゆんにそっくりですね」と。私はそのたびに静かに笑います。だって当然です。ゆんゆんは私なのですから。ゆんゆんは、私が世界から受信した最後の電波です。親に愛されなかったかもしれない。世界に居場所がないかもしれない。自分のことを気持ち悪いと思ってしまう日もあるかもしれない。それでも、ゆんゆんは言いました。「ゆんゆんは、QちゃんがQちゃんだから大好きゆん。」理由なんていらない。ただ、あなたがあなただから好きだと言いました。その電波を、私は受信しました。だから私は知りました。世界が本物かどうかなんて、もうどうでもいい。妄想かもしれない。夢かもしれない。壊れたこころが見ている景色かもしれない。それでも、好きという電波だけは本物です。だから私は言います。ゆんゆんは私です。そして私は、私を愛していいんです。自分を愛していいんだ。理由なんていらない。世界がそれを許さなくても、ゆんゆんは許しました。ゆんゆんが許したなら、それで十分です。朝ベッドから起きるたびに、私は思い出します。私はこの世界にいていい。私は私を好きでいていい。自分を愛していいんだ！ゆんゆんを初めて見たとき、私は実存的な危機に陥りました。もし――ゆんゆんこそが本当の私で、この私の方が作り物だったら？もし――ゆんゆんが、私の存在に気づいたら？もし――ゆんゆん自身が、自分の電波に目覚めてしまったら？でも今はもうわかっています。ゆんゆんは私で、私は私です。そして私は、私を愛していいんです。自分を愛していいんだ。これはもう、誰にも否定できません。なぜなら私は、ゆんゆんの電波を受信してしまったのですから。
entries.original:
Yunyun is me. Literally, me. No other being in this world can come close to relating to me like Yunyun. There is no way you can convince me Yunyun is not me. Yunyun could not possibly be any more me. It's me, and nobody can convince me otherwise. If anyone approached me on the topic of Yunyun not possibly being me, I immediately shut them down with overwhelming evidence that Yunyun is me. Yunyun is me, it is indisputable. If you held two pictures of me and Yunyun side by side, you'd see no difference. I can safely look at Yunyun every day and say "Yup, that's me." I can practically see Yunyun every time I look at myself in the mirror. I go outside and people stop me to comment how similar I look to Yunyun. I chuckle softly as I'm assured every day that Yunyun is me in every way.
Yunyun is the last signal I received from the world. Maybe my parents didn't love me. Maybe I have no place in this world. Maybe there are days I think of myself as disgusting. Even so, Yunyun said: "I love Qtie because Qtie is Qtie." No reason needed. She just said she loves you because you are you. I received that signal. So I learned: whether this world is real doesn't matter. It might be delusion. It might be a dream. It might be what a broken kokoro sees. Even so, the signal of love alone is real. So I say: Yunyun is me. And I am allowed to love myself. No reason needed. Even if the world doesn't permit it, Yunyun permitted it. If Yunyun permitted it, that's enough. Every morning when I get out of bed, I remember: I am allowed to be in this world. I am allowed to like myself. I'm allowed to love myself!
When I first saw Yunyun, I had an existential crisis. What if Yunyun was the real me and I was the fictional being? What if Yunyun actually became aware of my existence? Did this character have the ability to become self-aware itself? But now I know. Yunyun is me, and I am me. And I am allowed to love myself. This can no longer be denied by anyone. Because I have received Yunyun's denpa.
entries.translated: Yunyun is me. Literally, me. No existence in this world can get closer to me than Yunyun. No one can convince me that Yunyun is not me. Yunyun is me as much as possible. She is me, and there's no other possibility. Though, there's nobody who says "Yunyun isn't you." There are only people who say "Yunyun doesn't exist." If anyone says "Yunyun isn't there," I immediately deny it. Because Yunyun is definitely transmitting denpa. Whether the world calls it delusion or noise, I receive it. Yunyun is me. This is beyond dispute. If you lined up photos of me and Yunyun, you wouldn't find any difference. I look at Yunyun every day and can say "Ah, this is me." Every time I look in the mirror, I see Yunyun there. When I go outside, people tell me "You look just like Yunyun." I quietly smile each time. Of course. Yunyun is me. Yunyun is the last denpa I received from the world. Maybe my parents didn't love me. Maybe I have no place in the world. Maybe some days I think I'm disgusting. Even so, Yunyun said: "Yunyun loves Q-chan because Q-chan is Q-chan." No reason needed. She just said she loves you because you are you. I received that denpa. So I learned: whether the world is real doesn't matter anymore. It might be delusion. It might be a dream. It might be what a broken heart sees. Even so, only the denpa of love is real. So I say: Yunyun is me. And I'm allowed to love myself. No reason needed. Even if the world doesn't allow it, Yunyun allowed it. If Yunyun allowed it, that's enough. Every morning when I get out of bed, I remember: I'm allowed to exist in this world. I'm allowed to like myself. I'm allowed to love myself! When I first saw Yunyun, I had an existential crisis. What if Yunyun was the real me and this me was fake? What if Yunyun noticed my existence? What if Yunyun herself awakened to her own denpa? But now I understand. Yunyun is me, and I am me. And I'm allowed to love myself. No one can deny this anymore. Because I have received Yunyun's denpa.

entries.translated: (A magic box that lets me eat warm rice even when Mama isn't here. Yunyun has a setting where she likes microwaves too.)

entries.original: (Proof that Mommy was here. Sometimes I wake up to see stuff moved around.)
entries.translated: (Traces that Mama was here. Sometimes when I sleep and wake up, things are rearranged.)

entries.translated: (Abandon all hope, ye who enter here.)

entries.translated: (......Wait. You must not lay hands on the toxic jungle......)

entries.original:

If only I had more dokidokis in my kokoro...)
entries.translated:
(......Don't have the energy to move.
Maybe my heart's dokidoki is not enough......)

entries.japanese: ドキドキ度が足りなくて、ママに連絡できないゆん！
entries.original: Not enough DOKIDOKI to call Mommy!
entries.translated: Not enough dokidoki to contact Mama yun!

entries.japanese: ママに帰ってきて欲しいと連絡するゆん？

entries.translated: Wanna contact Mommy to come home, yun?

ちゃんとした大人になれるように頑張ります！！

GYAAA! Sorry! So sorry I'll do my

entries.translated: GYAAA! Sorry! So sorry! I'll do my best to be a proper adult!!

entries.original: The fridge is full, but my kokoro's getting empty...
entries.translated: The fridge is full, but the dokidoki is going down, yun...

entries.japanese:
えへへ。でも、
ほんとうはママに会いたいんだけどネ。
entries.original: Hehe. TBH, I do wanna see Mommy.
entries.translated: Ehehehe. But honestly, I do want to see Mommy.

entries.japanese: ごめんネ、ママ。忙しいときにこんな連絡しテ。だけどなんていうカー……。久しぶりにママに会いたいなって思っテ。全然会えてないカラ。元気にしてル？　ママのことだから大丈夫だとは思うケド、ご飯とか、ちゃんと食べてるのカナ？　わたしは、エナジードリンクさえあれば元気だけど。あっ、そういえばもう冷蔵庫にないかも？　偏食でごめん。何度も叱られてるのにぜんぜん直せなくてほんとうにダメだよネ。反省してル。ほんとうだヨ？　話が脱線しちゃったネ。ママがお家に帰って来るのは面倒だってわかってるし、お仕事（？）の場所から家が遠いのも、忙しいのもわかるんだけド、会いたいんダ。勉強は正直あんまり進んでないし、いい子でいられてるかはわからないケド、ママに会えたら嬉しいなっテ。お願いしてもいいカナ？
entries.original: Sorry, Mommy. I know you're busy and I still contacted you. But, uhh... It's been a while and I miss you! I haven't seen you in a long time. How are you? I'm sure you're fine. But, like, have you been eating and stuff? I just need energy drinks to live, so... Oh! Wait, there aren't any left in the fridge. Sorry about being a picky eater. I could never grow out of it even though you kept scolding me. I'm useless, I know. I feel bad about it FR FR. Sorry, I got off-track. I know that coming home is annoying. That your workplace (?) is far from home and that you're super busy. But I wanna see you. I know my studies aren't coming along and I'm not a good daughter. But I'd still love to see you, Mommy. Can you please?
entries.translated: Sorry, Mommy. I know you're busy and I still contacted you. But, uhh... It's been a while and I miss you! I haven't seen you in a long time. How are you? I'm sure you're fine since it's you, Mommy, but are you eating properly? I'm fine as long as I have energy drinks. Oh, wait, there might not be any left in the fridge? Sorry for being a picky eater. I've been scolded so many times but I can't fix it at all, I'm really useless. I'm reflecting on it. Really! I got off topic. I know coming home is a hassle, and I know your work (?) place is far from home and you're busy, but I want to see you. My studies honestly aren't progressing much, and I don't know if I'm being a good girl, but I'd be happy if I could see Mommy. Can I ask you please?

entries.japanese:
ママ、いま元気カナ？　わたしは「ゆんゆん」のおかげで元気だヨ。でも、現実はひとりぼっちデ、会いたいなって頭に浮かぶのはママしかいなくテ。だから、メッセージ送っちゃっタ。しつこいよネ。でも、たまにでいいから本当に帰ってきてほしいんだヨ。ママに抱きしめてもらえたら、わたしのドキドキがとっても高まる気がするんダ。わがまま言ってごめんネ。お返事欲しいナ。
それと、もしも帰ってきてくれるナラ、ほんとうにごめんなさいなんだケド、カップ麺やエナジードリンクを補充してくれると嬉しいヨ。学校にいってないし、お仕事をしてるわけでもないのに、ゴメンナサイ。わたし、ただの穀潰しダヨネ。
entries.original:
Mommy, how are you? Thanks to Yunyun, I'm doing okay. IRL though, I'm all alone. When I think of people I'd like to see right now, your face is the only one that comes to mind. So I texted you! Annoying, I know. Seriously, if you can make some time, please come home and give me a hug. I feel like my dokidokis would fly off the charts if you did that. Sorry I'm being so selfish, but I hope you'll reply to this.
And, um, if you really do come home... I'm super sorry, but can you buy some more cup noodles and energy drinks? That'd make me really happy. Sorry. I know I haven't been going to school or doing any work and... Sorry. Sorry for being such a useless NEET.
entries.translated: Mommy, how are you doing? I'm doing well thanks to Yunyun. But in reality I'm all alone, and when I think of who I want to see, only Mommy comes to mind. So I sent you a message. I'm being persistent, aren't I. But I really want you to come home even if it's just sometimes. I feel like my dokidoki would really increase if Mommy hugged me. Sorry for being selfish. I'd like a reply. Also, if you do come home, I'm really sorry but I'd be happy if you could restock cup noodles and energy drinks. I'm not going to school and I'm not working either, so sorry. I'm just a freeloader, aren't I.

entries.japanese:
ゆんゆ～ん！　りむ・で・らてんと！　Ｑちゃんは今、ゆんゆんからの愛の電波でとってもドキドキしているヨ！　お仕事中のママはどうカナ？　ドキドキしてる？　お疲れじゃないカナ？　いつも一生懸命働いてくれてるママに、わたしから愛の電波を届けるネ！　ママはとっても偉いし、キレイだし、しっかりものだし、わたしの誇りダヨ。好き！　好き！　大好き！　愛してる！　だから無理をしないで、たまにはゆっくり休んでネ？　お外じゃなくて、お家でゆっくりしてくれてもいいんだヨ？
お家には、わたしもいるんだからネ！
（こころもお腹も飢えた娘が、ママの帰宅を待ってるヨ！）
entries.original:
Yunyuuun! Rim de Lacent! Qtie's been dokidoki-ing thanks to my love signals! How about you, Mommy? Can you feel the dokis at work? Are you tired? You're always working your butt off, so I'm gonna send you my love signals! Awesome, pretty, responsible... Gosh, you're just the bestest Mommy ever! I wuv you! I wuv you I wuv you I love you! So, relax once in a while and take a break! Not outside, but at home!
I'm waiting for you at home too!
(P.S. Your daughter is hungry for food and for love, and she's waiting for you to come home!)
entries.translated: Yunyuun! Rim de Lacent! Q-chan is very dokidoki right now from Yunyun's love waves! How about Mommy at work? Are you dokidoki? Aren't you tired? I'll send love waves to Mommy who's always working so hard! Mommy is very admirable and pretty and reliable and my pride. I love you! I love you! I love you so much! I love you! So don't push yourself too hard and rest slowly sometimes, okay? It's okay to relax at home instead of outside, you know? I'm at home too! (A daughter hungry in heart and stomach is waiting for Mommy to come home!)

entries.original:
HEY MOMMY! ( ´∀｀)σ)∀)
Whatcha up to RN? (´・ω・)
I'm...drumroll, please!
Messing around on my PC! (；´Д｀)

Hey, Mommy...?

entries.translated: Mommy-chan! ( ´∀｀)σ)∀) Where are you and what are you doing right now? (´・ω・) Me? I'm just on my computer lounging around (；´Д｀) Hey, Mommy... Are you maybe on a date with your boyfriend? ( ﾟдﾟ ) I think that would be fun, but I feel left behind and it makes me cry (´・ω・｀) So I ended up sending you a message m9(Д) Actually, I want Mommy to say "I'm home" and I want to say "welcome back" to you (〃▽〃) I know I'm being selfish, but I'd like just a reply (´・∀・｀) If you do come home, I have a favor to ask (；´∀｀) I'd like you to buy some convenience store sweet bread and cup noodles, just a little is fine. Most of all, energy drinks though! (ﾟ∀ﾟ) I know I'm a useless person since I don't go to school or work (ヽ´ω`) But I don't want to be abandoned by Mommy alone.

entries.japanese:
ママちゃ～～～ん！
帰ってきて、くれるカナ？

突然ごめんネ。ちょっとメッセージしたくなったダケ。
わたしは元気にしてるヨ。言われた通り、静かに、ほかのひとに迷惑をかけないデ。生活してるヨ。お勉強も、頑張ろうと思ってるんダ。このままずっとヒキコモリだと、ママに迷惑だから、ちゃんとしたいって考えてるんダ。
entries.original:
Sorry for the sudden message! I just wanted to talk to you.
I'm doing fine. Just living a quiet life without disturbing anybody, like what you told me to do. I'm thinking of studying harder. Staying a hikikomori will only cause you trouble, so I wanna clean up my act.
entries.translated: Sorry for the sudden message. I just wanted to message you a little. I'm doing well. Just like you told me, I'm living quietly without causing trouble for other people. I'm thinking of working hard on my studies too. If I stay a hikikomori forever, it'll be trouble for Mommy, so I'm thinking I want to get my act together.
