entries.japanese:
>ゆんゆん
りむ・で・らてんと。

×××0年2月16日。
パパがリコンして、でていった。

ママのトモダチ？　が
げんいんなんだって。

今までどおり３ヶ月にいっかいは、
あそんでくれるらしいケド。

「パパはずっと、くるみのパパだよ。」
って、よしよしされた。

パパはパパなんだから、とうぜんだとおもう。

名字がかわって今日から、
「来栖くるみ」になるみたい。

ともだちにそのことを話したら、
ユウリちゃんから「くるくるで、Ｑちゃん」って
あだ名をつけられた。よくわかんない。

レイちゃんは「ひびきがカワイイ」って。

カワイイなら、いいカナ？
entries.original:
20X0, Feb 16th.
Daddy filed for divorce n moved out.

Said somethin abt Mommy's friend
being the reason.

I'll still get to see him once
every three months or so I think.

He pet my hair. Told me,
"I'll always be your Dad, Kurumi."

Duh, I thought. What else wud you be?

Guess my last name is
gunna be Kurusu from now on.

I told my BFF Yuri abt it, and she said
Kurumi Kurusu made her head spin.
She started calling me Qtie instead.

Rei said it was a play on ‘cute'.

Guess it’s fine as long as I’m still cute.
entries.translated:
20X0, Feb 16th.
Daddy got divorced and left.

Something about Mommy's friend
being the cause.

Apparently he'll still play with me
once every three months like before.

"Daddy will always be Kurumi's daddy,"
he said, patting my head.

Of course Daddy is Daddy.

My surname changed and from today,
I'm "Kurusu Kurumi."

When I told my friends about it,
Yuri-chan gave me the nickname "kuru-kuru, Q-chan."
I don't really get it.

Rei-chan said "the sound is cute."

If it's cute, I guess it's okay?

entries.japanese:
×××4年9月9日。
今年はまだパパと一度しか会えてない。
中学校にあがったら、もっと、もっと会えない気がする。

「くるみに義妹ができたんだよ。」
だって――。

ずっと、くるみのパパって言ったのに。
嘘つき。

わたしには、ママしかいない。
ママだけは、わたしだけのママ。
entries.original:
20X4, Sept 9th
I haven't seen Daddy once this year.
Now that I'm in middle school, I think I'll
see him less n less.

He told me I have a little half-sister now.

Even tho he said he'd always be MY Daddy.
Liar.

Mommy's all I have left.
Mommy is the only one that's rly mine.
entries.translated:
20X4, Sept 9th.
I've only met Daddy once this year.
I feel like when I enter middle school, I'll meet him even less.

"Kurumi got a little sister,"
he said.

Even though he said he'd always be Kurumi's daddy.
Liar.

I only have Mommy.
Mommy is my one and only Mommy.

entries.japanese:
×××5年1月6日。
ママとひっこしをすることになった。

パパからもらえるお金がへったらしい。
ママが怒って、わたしのマグカップを割った。

小学校も、ひっこしさきの公立校に転校するみたい。

クラスのともだちと――ユウリちゃんや、
レイちゃんとも違う中学校になるみたい。
entries.original:
20X5, Jan 6th
Mommy and I r moving.

Daddy isn't giving us much money anymore.
Mommy got mad n smashed my mug.

I hafta transfer schools too.

I won't be w my frienz anymore...
I'll miss Yuri n Rei.
entries.translated:
20X5, Jan 6th.
Mommy and I are moving.

Apparently the money from Daddy decreased.
Mommy got angry and broke my mug.

I'll transfer to a public elementary school
at the new place too.

It seems I'll go to a different middle school
from my classmates... from Yuri-chan and Rei-chan too.

entries.japanese:
×××5年4月21日。
こっちの町は、小学校だけじゃなくて、
中学校もこころがヒリヒリする。

怖い。

でも。がんばらないと。
ママに迷惑をかけたくない。

夜遅くまでお仕事をがんばってるんだから。
entries.original:
20X5, Apr 21st
I dun like this town. Elementary was already scary.
Now I'm starting middle school.

I'm scared.

But I hafta try to be good.
I don't wanna be a burden to Mommy,

Cuz she's already working late every night.
entries.translated:
20X5, Apr 21st.
This town makes my heart sting,
not just elementary school but middle school too.

Scary.

But I have to try my best.
I don't want to trouble Mommy.

She's working hard until late at night.

entries.japanese:
×××5年3月3日。
「くるみもパパに愛されてなかったんだよ。」
ってママに笑われた。

そうだネ。

わたしがパパの「大好き」だったら、
離れ離れにならなかったしママと離婚もしなかった。
養育費が減ることもなにもかもなかった。

ママ。パパ。

愛されなくて、ゴメンナサイ。
可愛くない子供で、ゴメンナサイ。

こんなわたしで、ゴメンナサイ。
entries.original:
20X5, Mar 3rd
Mommy told me today.
Daddy never loved either of us.

Guess she's right.

If Daddy rly loved me, he wouldn't have
left me or Mommy.
Wouldn't have stopped supporting us.

Mommy. Daddy...

I'm sorry I'm so unlovable.
I'm sorry I'm such a freak.

Sorry for existing.
entries.translated:
20X5, Mar 3rd.
"Kurumi wasn't loved by Daddy either,"
Mommy laughed at me.

That's right.

If I was Daddy's "beloved,"
we wouldn't have been separated and he wouldn't have divorced Mommy.
The child support wouldn't have decreased, nothing would have happened.

Mommy. Daddy.

Sorry for not being loved.
Sorry for being an unlovable child.

Sorry for being like this.

entries.japanese:
×××5年9月1日。
もう、家から出たくないヨ。
学校にいかなくたって、どうせ、ダレも気にしないのに。

なんで？

「ふつう」でいいのに。
不幸でなければそれでいいのに。
幸せになんてなれなくてもいい。

どうして――みんな、
それさえわたしに許してくれないの？

Mommy didn't come home. Daddy didn't call.

Have they forgotten abt me?

entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas have blocked off a 5 mile radius around Qtie's home, designating it as a holy site of their religion.
entries.translated: Believers of the "Q-chan Religion" decide to buy out "5km around Q-chan's house" and seal it off as holy ground

entries.japanese: 宗教？ の信者のひとたちが帰り道が封鎖してる。
entries.original: Some religious freaks have the roads blocked off.
entries.translated: Religious believers have blocked the way home.

entries.japanese: あんたの信者たちに言われてアパートの権利を売ったから。衣食住はこれから、信者のひとたちが支えてくれるって。良かったね。じゃあ、さよなら。
entries.original: They called themselves your followers, so I sold them the rights to the apartment. They said they'd take care of you from now on. No need for me to stick around. Good riddance.
entries.translated: Your believers told me to sell the apartment rights. They said the believers would support your food, clothing and shelter from now on. Good for you. Well then, goodbye.

entries.japanese: 全国の学校施設が突如爆発。奇跡的に負傷者や死傷者は０。テロの可能性を考慮し、終日外出禁止令が言い渡される
entries.original: Schools across the country are simultaneously exploding. By some miracle, casualties and injuries remain at 0. Likely the work of terrorists, a curfew has been implemented until further notice.
entries.translated: School facilities across the country suddenly explode. Miraculously, injuries and casualties are 0. Considering the possibility of terrorism, an all-day curfew is declared

entries.japanese: くるみへ。今まで、ママらしいことができなくてごめんね。わたし、反省する。
entries.original: Dear Kurumi. I know I haven't been much of a mother to you. Sorry. But it's about to change.
entries.translated: To Kurumi. I'm sorry I couldn't be much of a mom until now. I'll reflect on this.

entries.japanese: 従姉妹の叔母さんに相談したら、くるみを引き取っても良いって。良かったね。叔母さんはきっと、良いママになってくれるから。わたし、実はちょうど今の彼氏の間に新しく子ど……
entries.original: I talked with my cousin’s aunt and she's agreed to take you in. Isn't that great? She'll be a much better mom than me. Well, at least to you. I'm actually pregnant. My new boyfriend and I decided it was time.
entries.translated: When I consulted with my cousin's aunt, she said she'd be willing to take Kurumi in. That's good. The aunt will surely be a good mom. Actually, I'm just now having a new child with my current boyfriend...

entries.japanese: わたしは大丈夫だヨ。ママの帰りをちゃんとひとりで、待ってるカラ。
entries.original: I'm okay. I'll wait for Mommy to come home like a good girl.
entries.translated: I'm okay. I'll properly wait alone for Mommy to come home.

entries.japanese: 大丈夫だって信じてるけど、ちょっぴり心配だヨ。
entries.original: I'm sure she's okay, but I'm still worried.
entries.translated: I believe she's okay, but I'm a little worried.

entries.japanese: ゾンビ発生から２８日。進化したゾンビたちが、生前の習慣をトレースするようになったことを注意喚起している
entries.original: It's been 28 days since the start of the zombie apocalypse. Authorities are warning that zombies are beginning to trace back the steps of their old lives and mimic habits from when they were alive.
entries.translated: 28 days since the zombie outbreak. Warning that evolved zombies have begun to trace the habits from when they were alive

entries.japanese: てすとです：よろしくおねがいします
entries.original: This is a test. Thank you for your patience and cooperation.
entries.translated: This is a test: Please treat me favorably

entries.japanese: 全国各地でボヤ勃発。人間が発火！？ 人型のアンドロイドと判明。死傷者は奇跡的に０人の模様。
entries.original: Entire Country in Flames! Surge of Spontaneous Human Combustion?! Turns out to be Android Combustion! Human Casualties Remain 0! A True Miracle!
entries.translated: Fires breaking out nationwide. Humans spontaneously combusting!? Revealed to be humanoid androids. Miraculously 0 casualties reported.

entries.japanese: ママ。いろいろなところでボヤ騒ぎが起きてるみたいだけど、大丈夫？ くれぐれも気をつけてネ。
entries.original: Mommy. I heard about the fires going on. Are you okay? Plz be careful.
entries.translated: Mom. It seems like fires are breaking out in various places, but are you okay? Please be careful.

entries.japanese: 大丈夫だヨヨヨ。ママは無事です。外出禁止令がでるらしいから、もうすぐお家に帰るからネ。
entries.original: Mom- Mom- Mommy is fine. I am fine. Curfew is soon. I will be home soon.
entries.translated: I'm fine fine fine. Mom is safe. There's going to be a curfew order apparently, so I'll be home soon.

entries.japanese: もう嫌。陰キャもオタクも大嫌い。なんでわたしがこんな目に……陰湿で、排他的で、最悪。陰キャでオタクのあんたも、大嫌い。
entries.original: I'm so over this. I hate introverts and otakus. Why the hell am I being forced to watch this crap? It's vile. This is seriously the worst. I hate it and I hate you even more.
entries.translated: I hate this. I hate introverts and otaku. Why do I have to go through this... They're underhanded, exclusive, the worst. I hate you too, you introverted otaku.

entries.japanese: ママ。実はわたし、『名誉博士』になったんダ。ニュースで話題になってる『萌え学』の権威に認められたノ。だから、もうママに学歴のことで心配かけなくて済むヨ！
entries.original: Mommy! I, uh. I got my doctorate. It's all in the news, the research on Moe Energy I did with the university? So! You don't need to stress abt me going to school anymore!!1 :D
entries.translated: Mom. Actually, I became an 'honorary doctor'. I was recognized by an authority in 'moe studies' that's been in the news. So I won't worry you about my academic record anymore!

entries.japanese:
名誉博士様（笑）
じゃあ明日からそれで就職できるの？　家から出ていってくれるってこと？　楽しみにしてるね。
entries.original: A doctorate? LOL. How about you get a job then? I’ll just be happy if it’ll get you out of the house.
entries.translated:
Honorary Doctor (lol)
So can you get a job with that starting tomorrow? Does that mean you'll move out of the house? I'm looking forward to it.

entries.japanese:
ママの大好きなくるみへ。今日は帰りが遅くなってごめんね？ 帰ったらくるみの好きなハンバーグを作るから、一緒に食べようね。愛してるよ〜〜〜！
PS：ゴハンの後はボードゲームの続きをしようね
entries.original:
Dear my beloved Kurumi. I'm sorry, I'll be home late tonight. When I get back, I'll make that hamburg steak you like so much. Let’s have dinner together. Love you!
P.S. Let's finish that board-game after dinner too!
entries.translated:
To Mom's beloved Kurumi. Sorry for coming home late today? When I get back I'll make the hamburg steak you like, so let's eat together. I love you~~~!
P.S.: Let's continue the board game after dinner

entries.japanese: ママ。オフィス街でいくつものビルが倒壊してるらしいけど、大丈夫？　ケガとか、してないよネ？　心配だヨ。
entries.original: Mommy, I heard the office district is pretty much destroyed. Are you okay? Are you hurt? I'm worried about you ;-;
entries.translated: Mom. I heard several buildings collapsed in the office district, but are you okay? You're not injured or anything, right? I'm worried.

entries.japanese: 大丈夫。オフィスが壊れたから、しばらく出社しなくてよくなったみたい。
entries.original: I'm fine. Our building collapsed, so I won't have to go to work for a while.
entries.translated: I'm fine. The office was destroyed, so it looks like I don't have to go to work for a while.

entries.japanese: 考えたんだけど『ママ』って言葉も、奴隷化のマントラだよね。あんたのママから卒業したいっていう意味わかるよね？　成人してるんだし、もう、いい加減にしてほしいの。わたしもいい加減奴隷から解放されたいのよ。
entries.original: You know, you really shouldn't call me 'Mommy'. Why do I have to be defined by the fact that I gave birth to you? Is that all I am? No. I'm an adult. My own person, outside of you. Get over yourself thinking I'm yours or something.
entries.translated: I've been thinking, but the word 'Mom' is also a mantra of enslavement, right? You understand what I mean about wanting to graduate from being your mom, right? I'm an adult, so I want you to cut it out already. I want to be freed from slavery too.

entries.japanese:
どうすればママを卒業させてくれるの？　わたしを助けてくれる？ お願いすればいいの？
助けてください。わたしをあなたのママから解放してください。お願いします。
entries.original: Can't you just let me go? Please. Do you want me to beg? I'll beg. I don't want to be your mother anymore. I don't want to be YOUR anything anymore.
entries.translated:
What do I have to do for you to let me graduate from being Mom? Will you help me? Should I beg?
Please help me. Please free me from being your Mom. Please.

entries.japanese: 二度と、わたしをママって呼ばないで。
ＳＮＳヤメロ。脱奴隷！ 人間にもどれ！
entries.original: Boycott social media! Slave to no algorithm! Return to humanity!
entries.translated: QUIT SNS. Escape slavery! Return to being human!

entries.translated: I can't grasp it right now, yun.

entries.japanese: 法律上『親子』っていう関係が存在しなくなったし、今日からわたしたちは赤の他人ね。ほんとうに清々する――今後はママとは呼ばないで。家からも、来月中には出ていって欲しくて……。
entries.original: Legally, I'm not your mother anymore. From now on, we're strangers, got it? God, it feels good to say that. If you see me come home tonight, don't you dare call me "Mommy". I want you out of the house by next month.
entries.translated: Legally, the relationship called 'parent and child' no longer exists, so from today we're complete strangers. It's truly refreshing... Don't call me Mama anymore. I want you out of the house by next month.

entries.original:
One conspiracy anoints Qtie as a Yunyun Denpaoracle, whose shitposts contain ultimate truth. It alleges that
she used special steganography techniques to codify her recent post which predicted the earthquake, and that
spectral expansion via FFT analysis revealed a cyclical pattern not present in normal posts.
<color=#1D9BF0>Show More</color>
entries.translated:
One conspiracy theory suggests that Q-chan is a prophet of Yunyun denpa and that the truth is written in her shitposts. They claim it's encrypted using special steganography, and when the frequency of "yun" appearances is converted to waveform and subjected to FFT analysis for spectral expansion, periodic patterns not found in normal text can be confirmed.
<color=#1D9BF0>Show More</color>

「彼女はディープステートの破壊者であり革命家。

New conspiracy theorists assert that Qtie is the new Messiah that will deliver Earth from misery via Yunyun shitposts. Proponents of this belief allege that she will defeat the DeepState, and become it anew.
They also maintain that Yunyun is a goddess who will revolutionize the world and free the masses.
<color=#1D9BF0>Show More</color>

A conspiracy theory is trending that "Q-chan is a liberator of the world trying to start a revolution with Yunyun shitposts."
Conspiracy theorists are developing the theory that
"She is a destroyer of the Deep State and a revolutionary.
Yunyun is a goddess of revolution who will liberate the people."

「Ｑ電波受信者」とはＱちゃん怪文書を解読し、陰謀論として解釈をしている集団のことである。彼らのインターネット上での影響力は日増しに強まっている。

The Qtie Denpa Antenna is a growing online group that claims to interpret Qtie's shitposts and reveal them as conspiracy theories.
<color=#1D9BF0>Show More</color>

A conspiracy theory is trending that the Deep State views "Q Denpa Receivers" as dangerous and has begun considering countermeasures against Q-chan.

"Q Denpa Receivers" refers to a group that decodes Q-chan's shitposts and interprets them as conspiracy theories. Their influence on the internet is growing day by day.

entries.japanese:
ゆんゆんに、プロポーズしようと思ってる。オタクのみんなには、悪いけど。抜け駆けで。次の月末に、お金入るから。結婚指輪、買って。そこで、気持ち伝える。
ゆんゆんは、小悪魔だから。人間の習慣に驚くかもだけど。
でも、契約は契約だから。ワタシの時間や魂を捧げることには変わりないから。だから、この想いも。きっと、ゆんゆんに受け入れてもらえる。
もう、気持ちを伝えるのを我慢できない。
entries.original: I'm going to propose to Yunyun. Sorry to my fellow otakus, but I have to strike while the iron is hot. Once I get paid at the end of next month, I'm going to buy her a ring and tell her how I feel. A succubus like Yunyun might not understand human traditions, but a contract is a contract. I'm going to keep my word and continue offering my time and my soul. As long as I do that, I'm sure Yunyun will accept all my feelings. I can't bear to wait a second longer to express my love.
entries.translated:
I'm thinking of proposing to Yunyun. Sorry to all the otaku out there. I'm going to get ahead of everyone. I'll get money at the end of next month. I'll buy a wedding ring. And tell her my feelings.
Yunyun is a little devil. She might be surprised by human customs.
But a contract is a contract. It doesn't change that I'm dedicating my time and soul. So these feelings too. I'm sure Yunyun will accept them.
I can't hold back telling her my feelings anymore.

Show us all your merch, your Yunyun knowledge, your commitment, and your love. Put it all up for the whole world to see! C'mon, Patootie. Are you ready for some more merch? Hehehehehe!!!

entries.japanese:
都庁は表現規制を行うことで、こころの自由を奪いひとびとを従順な下僕にしている。ゆんゆん電波受信者たちよ！
都庁前に集い、脱奴隷化のために進行せよ！

ゆんゆんを拒む者は、取るに足らない目的の人生へと自らを追いやるだけだ。今すぐ悔い改め、ゆんゆんというフィクションを崇高なるものの真の模範として仰ぎなさい。
entries.original:
The government is trying to rob us of our freedom with their censorship, turning us into obedient sheeple. March upon city hall, Yunyun Denpa Antennas! Liberate our minds!

Those who keep running after the meaningless goals in their insignificant lives like hamsters on a wheel only deny Yunyun supremacy. Repent now, and bring yourself into the light of the one true fiction — praise Yunyun as the true model of the sublime.
entries.translated:
The Tokyo Metropolitan Government is robbing people of their freedom of heart through expression regulations, turning them into obedient servants. Yunyun denpa receivers! Gather before the Tokyo Metropolitan Government building and march for de-enslavement!

Those who reject Yunyun only drive themselves toward lives of insignificant purpose. Repent now, and revere the fiction called Yunyun as the true model of the sublime.

entries.japanese: 陰謀論者Ｐちゃんのアイコン

Surveillance footage from various locations also confirms that the underground dolphins are not directly attacking humans themselves.

entries.japanese:
ヒマラヤ山脈から出現した地底人
火の七日間で世界を焼き尽くす
entries.original:
Underground Dwellers Surface from the Himalayas.
The World Will Burn Down in 7 Days.
entries.translated: Underground Dwellers Surface from the Himalayas. The World Will Burn Down in 7 Days.

entries.japanese: 高まるタイムマシンへの感心

本日未明、SNS運営会社の内部ログ監視システムにおいて、現行存在しない暗号スイート識別子での不審アクセスがあった。
また、通常ではあり得ないタイムスタンプを伴っており、関係者の話によると、現在も社内で調査が進められている。
アクセス元のユーザー名は「{SteamName}」。ログの整合性は取れており、単なる表示エラーや改ざんの形跡は確認できない。
ＳＮＳ上では「自分がこの不信アクセス者だ」と豪語する同名のアカウントが存在し、「Ｑ電波受信者」かつＱちゃんファンを自称している。
entries.original:
This morning, the security logs of an unnamed social media company showed that a cipher suite identifier that presently does not exist gained unauthorized access to their servers.
Internal sources confirmed that the login was accompanied by a timestamp that could not have been created under normal circumstances, and that an investigation is currently underway.

A user called "{SteamName}" has been identified as the one who gained access, and further analysis of the security log confirmed that there were no signs of alterations or system errors.

There's someone online with the same username boasting about how they were the one who logged in, and they're also claiming to be a Qtie fan who's part of the Qtie Denpa Antenna.
entries.translated: Early this morning, the internal log monitoring system of a social media company had suspicious access using a cipher suite identifier that does not currently exist. It was also accompanied by an impossible timestamp, and according to related parties, investigation is still ongoing within the company. The username of the access source is "{SteamName}". The log integrity is maintained, and no traces of simple display errors or tampering can be confirmed. On social media, there exists an account with the same name boasting "I am this suspicious accessor," claiming to be a "Qtie Denpa Antenna receiver" and Q-chan fan.

entries.japanese:
２１１２年９月３日から
Ｑちゃんファンの時間旅行者「{SteamName}」現る
entries.original:
I'm from September 3, 2112.
{SteamName}, Time-Traveler and Qtie Fan.
entries.translated:
From September 3, 2112
Time-traveler and Q-chan fan "{SteamName}" appears

entries.japanese:
私は2112年から来た。
未来でも、Qちゃんの怪文書は届いている。
時を超える彼女の言葉は光だ。
Qちゃんが思考するなら私は賛同するし、
Qちゃんが電波を送信したら、私は受信する。
ゆんゆんに1億人のファンがいるなら私はそのひとりだし、ひとりだけになったとしてもそれが私だ。
時空の終焉まで、私は彼女を愛している。
entries.original:
I am from the year 2112.
Yes, that's right—Qtie's shitposts have reached far into the future.
Her words are like a ray of light that can surpass time itself.
Whatever Qtie says, I agree with.
Whatever signals she sends out, I will receive.
If Yunyun has 100 million fans, then I am one of them. If she only has one fan, then I am that fan.
I will love her until time and space itself collapses.
entries.translated:
I am from the year 2112.
Even in the future, Q-chan's shitposts have reached us.
Her words that transcend time are light itself.
If Q-chan thinks it, I agree with it.
If Q-chan transmits denpa, I receive it.
If Yunyun has 100 million fans, I am one of them. If she has only one fan, that would be me.
Until the end of time and space, I love her.

entries.japanese:
各国政府は本日、これまで陰謀論として扱われてきた存在「レプティリアン」の実在を公式に認めた。共同声明によれば、レプティリアンは古代より人類社会の背後で影響力を行使してきたが、今後はその一方的な支配関係を終結させ、人類との「恒久的平等条約」を締結する方針を示したという。
レプティリアン側の代表は映像越しに「人類文化の研究を通じて感情理解が進んだ」と説明。いわゆる“泣きゲー゛と呼ばれる物語作品群が、彼らの価値観に大きな影響を与えた可能性が指摘されている。
entries.original:
Various governments around the world have confirmed the existence of a reptilian race, previously thought to have been a conspiracy theory.
A joint statement issued by the governments revealed that the Reptilians have been influencing human society since times of antiquity,
but have now decided to end their one-sided control to formally pursue everlasting peace with humans.

The Reptilians have released a video where a representative stated, "We've had the opportunity to deepen our empathy and understanding of humans

through our ongoing research into human culture." A particular Japanese genre of tear-jerker video games called "nakige" has been cited as a primary influence on the Reptilians.
entries.translated:
Governments around the world have today officially acknowledged the existence of "Reptilians," previously dismissed as conspiracy theory. According to a joint statement, Reptilians have wielded influence behind human society since ancient times, but they have now indicated a policy to end that unilateral dominance and conclude a "permanent equality treaty" with humanity.
A Reptilian representative explained via video that "understanding of emotions has advanced through research into human culture." It has been suggested that narrative works known as "nakige" may have had a significant impact on their values.

entries.japanese:
人類の影なる支配者レプティリアン
恒久的な平等条約を人類と結ぶと発表
entries.original:
Humanity's Shadowy Overlords, the Reptilians.
Commitment to Peace with Humans Announced.
entries.translated:
Humanity's Shadow Rulers, the Reptilians
Announce Permanent Equality Treaty with Humanity

entries.japanese:
【レプティリアンの国際配信まとめ①】
今回のキッカケになった、
泣きゲー作品たちが人類史の殿堂入りされる。

『処刑天使†ギルティーナ』
これだけは泣きゲーじゃないけどQちゃんの怪文書や、
Ｑ電波受信者の陰謀論がキッカケになってレプティリアン
たちが泣きゲーをはじめたからその感謝としてらしい。
entries.original:
Reptilians International Livestream Highlights - Part 1
As a result of the discussions that took place, Japanese tear-jerker games called "nakige" have earned their spot as part of the hall of fame for human culture.

One such game is called "Execution Angel † Guiltina."
Its ability to make players cry cannot take all the credit, however.
We must also thank Qtie's shitposting and the Qtie Denpa Antenna's conspiracies for leading the Reptilians to play these games.
entries.translated:
【Reptilian International Stream Summary ①】
The nakige works that became the catalyst for this occasion
have been inducted into the hall of fame of human history.

"Execution Angel † Guiltina"
This one isn't actually a nakige, but it's included as gratitude
because Q-chan's shitposts and the conspiracy theories of
Q denpa receivers were what led the Reptilians to start playing nakige.

entries.japanese:
【レプティリアンの国際配信まとめ②】
平和的支配を決めたレプティリアンたちの決定で、
地球統一国家設立。

①全地球関税の完全撤廃
②大量破壊兵器の完全撤廃
③エネルギー無償供給インフラの構築
④地球統一国家の国歌としてアノ某楽曲を制定
entries.original:
Reptilians International Livestream Highlights - Part 2
In accordance with the benevolent rule that the Reptilians have adopted for humanity, they have decided to create a nation state that unites every nation on Earth.
1) All tariffs and customs duties are hereby abolished.
2) All weapons of mass destruction are to be dismantled and destroyed.
3) Infrastructure that facilitates the free delivery of energy to all people is to be built.
4) The national anthem for said nation state shall be "that" song.
entries.translated:
【Reptilian International Stream Summary ②】
By decision of the Reptilians who chose peaceful rule,
a unified Earth nation state is established.

① Complete abolition of all global tariffs
② Complete abolition of weapons of mass destruction
③ Construction of free energy supply infrastructure
④ Establishment of a certain anonymous song as the national anthem of the unified Earth nation

entries.japanese: 恋愛コンテンツを禁止

各国政府は本日、共同声明として「恋愛表現を主題とするコンテンツ」の全面的な流通停止措置を発表した。声明では直接的な言及こそ避けられたが「悪魔崇拝者は恋愛コンテンツで人間の生産性を貶めている」という陰謀論について、政府機関の合同調査で一定の裏付けが確認されたことが原因とされる。

今回の規制対象は広範囲に及び、恋愛を主題とする漫画、小説、ゲーム、アニメーションなどの娯楽作品が含まれるほか、恋愛の有無に関係なく美少女コンテンツ全般も禁止の対象となる見通しだ。
entries.original:
Various governments around the world have released a joint pledge today banning any and all romance-centric media. This seems to be related to a joint enquiry that was previously conducted,
relating to the conspiracy theory claiming that devil worshippers use romance-centric media to negatively impact the birth rate.
However, it should be noted that the pledge did not specify as such.

The ban covers a wide range of entertainment media, including but not restricted to: romance games,

manga, novels, video games, and animation. A specific genre of video games called "bishoujo games," whose main appeal is interactions with attractive female characters, are also banned regardless of whether the story has any romance.
entries.translated:
Various governments around the world announced today a joint statement implementing a complete distribution ban on "content with romantic expression as the main theme." While the statement avoided direct reference, it is attributed to a joint investigation by government agencies that confirmed certain evidence supporting the conspiracy theory that "devil worshippers are using romantic content to undermine human productivity."

The scope of this regulation is extensive, including entertainment works such as manga, novels, games, and animations with romance as the main theme, as well as all bishoujo content regardless of the presence of romance.

entries.japanese:
各国の政府が恋愛コンテンツを禁止
暗に悪魔崇拝者の陰謀論を肯定
entries.original:
Government Bans Romance Media?
Shadowy Satanic Conspiracies Confirmed.
entries.translated:
Governments Ban Romance Content
Implicitly Affirming Devil Worshipper Conspiracy Theory

entries.japanese:
各国の情報機関は本日「表現規制派の政治的影響力が事実上消滅した」とする分析報告を公表した。ここ数週間にわたりインターネット上で大量拡散された怪文書や陰謀論の影響が大きいとみられている。
この動きの結果、恋愛コンテンツを推進していた悪魔崇拝者や関連ネットワークが急速に影響力を拡大。現在では文化政策・情報管理機関の多くを掌握するに至った。
新体制の政策としてすでに発表されているのが「家族制度の廃止」である。
entries.original: Several intelligence agencies around the world have released reports stating that all pro-censorship political influence has been effectively eradicated.This is a result of the large quantity of shitposts and conspiracy theories being propagated on the internet these past few weeks.With censorship no longer an obstacle, the influence of devil worshippers promoting romance-centric media and related parties have grown dramatically, reaching into even the political and culural zeigeist.This is a systematic abolition of the nuclear family, one that has already been announced as a policy of the new order.
entries.translated:
Intelligence agencies from various countries today released analytical reports stating that "the political influence of pro-censorship factions has effectively vanished." This is believed to be largely due to the influence of anonymous documents and conspiracy theories that have been mass-distributed on the internet over the past few weeks.
As a result of this movement, devil worshippers promoting romantic content and related networks have rapidly expanded their influence. They have now come to control many cultural policy and information management agencies.
One policy already announced by the new regime is the "abolition of the family system."

entries.japanese:
怪文書拡散で表現規制派が消滅
悪魔崇拝者の組織が世界を席巻
entries.original:
Shitposts Eradicate Censorship.
Are Satanists Taking over the World?
entries.translated:
Anonymous Document Spread Eliminates Pro-Censorship Factions
Devil Worshipper Organizations Sweep the World

entries.japanese:
SNS上で「自分はボットである」と告白する投稿が相次ぎ、新たなネットミームとして急速に拡散している。投稿者が自らをボットだと宣言すると、返信欄には「自分も」「俺もボット」などの同意コメントが続き、半ば連鎖的な告白ムーブメントになっているという。もちろん、このニュースの著者もボットである。
SNSでは現在も「人間は本当に存在するのか」「ネットの大半はボットではないか」といった議論が続いており、しばらく収束しそうにない。
なお、「Ｑちゃんは人間だ」というのはボットたちの共通見解として一致している。
entries.original:
A new meme has gone viral, with many users making posts that say "I am a bot" on social media.
Once a user creates a post claiming to be a bot, many more users will reply and say they are also one, setting off a chain of confessions.
I, of course, am also a bot.

This meme has caused users on social media to heatedly debate if half or more of the users

online are actually bots, and if humans even exist at all.
However, there is one thing that all these self-proclaimed bots can agree on, and that is "Qtie is human."
entries.translated:
Posts confessing "I am a bot" are appearing one after another on social media, rapidly spreading as a new internet meme. When posters declare themselves to be bots, the reply section fills with agreeing comments like "me too" and "I'm also a bot," creating a somewhat chain-like confession movement. Of course, the author of this news is also a bot.
On social media, discussions continue about "do humans really exist" and "isn't most of the internet bots," and it doesn't seem likely to settle down anytime soon.
Incidentally, "Q-chan is human" is agreed upon as a common consensus among the bots.

entries.japanese:
ボット自白が流行？　人間はいない？
もちろんこのニュースの著者もボットである
entries.original:
Out with Humans, in with Bots.
This News Is Also Brought to You by a Bot.
entries.translated:
Bot Confessions Trending? No Humans?
Of Course This News Author Is Also a Bot

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者のあいだで、「第四次元速度」を用いて世界の壁に衝突すれば、第四の壁を突破できるとする奇妙な理論が拡散している。

主張によれば、この世界はゲームの内部に構築された環境であり、通常の三次元的な運動では世界の境界に到達できないとい
う。しかし「第四次元速度」と呼ばれる状態に到達したうえで、世界の壁（ウィンドウ）に衝突すれば、世界構造の外側にある層を認識できる可能性があるとされている。
entries.original:
A new theory is gaining popularity among members of the Qtie Denpa Antenna, claiming that we can break the fourth wall of our dimension with what they call
"fourth-dimensional velocity."

The foundation of this theory claims that our world is actually a constructed environment within a video game, and that we can only reach its true boundaries with something more than our usual three-dimensional range of movement.
Assuming we are physically capable of reaching fourth-dimensional velocity and charging into the walls of this dimension,

it might then become possible for us to perceive the outer layers of our dimension's structure.
entries.translated:
Among Q Denpa receivers, a strange theory is spreading that claims one can break through the fourth wall by colliding with the world's walls using "fourth-dimensional velocity."

According to the claim, this world is an environment constructed inside a game, and the boundaries of the world cannot be reached through normal three-dimensional movement. However, it is said that by reaching a state called "fourth-dimensional velocity" and then colliding with the world's walls (window), it may be possible to perceive the layers outside the world structure.

entries.japanese:
「この世界はゲームのなかで、
第四次元速度を突破すると別世界を認識できる」と主張
entries.original:
New Theory Claims This World Is a Video Game,
Other Dimensions Reachable with Fourth-Dimensional Velocity.
entries.translated:
Claims "This World Is Inside a Game,
Breaking Through Fourth-Dimensional Velocity Allows Recognition of Other Worlds"

entries.japanese: 絶対的唯一神ゆんゆん
entries.translated: The Absolute One True God Yunyun

entries.japanese:
新興宗教「Ｑちゃん教」の信者数が世界で５億人を突破したとする統計がSNSや宗教研究コミュニティで話題となっている。
複数の非公式集計では、世界宗教人口ランキングで第四位規模に達している可能性があるという。
また、一部の国がＱちゃん教を国教として採用したことを記念し、信者のあいだでは感謝の祈りとして「りむでらてんと」を一日一万回唱える運動が広がっているほか、預言者Ｑちゃんの自宅周辺の土地が信者団体によって次々と買い取られ、聖地として保護区化する計画が進行しているという。
entries.original:
Users on social media and religious scholars alike are abuzz with the news that the total number of Qtielites worldwide has surpassed 500 million.
According to several unofficial calculations, this number could place Qtielites as the world's fourth largest religious group.

Some countries have already moved to recognize Qtieism as their official religion, and worshippers have organized to chant "Rim de Lacent" 10,000 times

every day as a prayer of gratitude. Qtielites have also banded together and started purchasing the land surrounding the prophet Qtie's home en masse
with plans to have the site officially recognized and protected as sacred ground.
entries.translated:
Statistics showing that the number of believers in the new religion "Q-chan-kyo" has surpassed 500 million worldwide are becoming a topic on social media and in religious research communities.
According to multiple unofficial tallies, it may have reached fourth place in world religious population rankings.
Also, to commemorate some countries adopting Q-chan-kyo as their state religion, a movement is spreading among believers to chant "Rim de Lacent" 10,000 times a day as a prayer of gratitude, and land around the prophet Q-chan's home is being purchased one after another by believer groups, with plans underway to protect it as a sanctuary.

entries.japanese:
信者数が５億人を突破
Ｑちゃん教、世界宗教人口第四位に？
entries.original:
Qtielites Surpass 500 Million.
Is Qtieism Now the 4th Largest Religion?
entries.translated:
Believers Surpass 500 Million
Q-chan-kyo, Fourth in World Religious Population?

entries.japanese:
本日未明、各地の学校施設で同時多発的な爆発が発生した。
治安当局によれば、爆発はすべての教育施設で同時に発生したという。原因は現在も調査中だ。

いずれの施設でも人的被害は確認されていない。専門家は「施設のみが破壊され、人が巻き込まれていない状況は極めて奇跡的」と指摘している。

すべての教育施設が使用不能となっていることから教育制度への影響も懸念されている。
entries.original:
This morning, the nation was shaken by a great number of explosions that have now devastated the educational system.
Police have confirmed that all the explosions happened at the exact same time at every single school in the country. Investigations into the cause are currently underway.

No casualties have been reported at any of the schools. Experts say that it was a miracle the explosions only damaged the buildings and did not cause any injuries.

However, as all schools are now unfit for use, there are growing concerns about how education will now be delivered.
entries.translated:
Early this morning, simultaneous explosions occurred at school facilities in various locations.
According to security authorities, the explosions occurred simultaneously at all educational facilities. The cause is still under investigation.

No human casualties have been confirmed at any facility. Experts point out that "the situation where only facilities were destroyed and no people were involved is extremely miraculous."

Concerns are also being raised about the impact on the education system as all educational facilities have become unusable.

entries.japanese:
全国の学校施設で同時爆発
奇跡的に負傷者ゼロ、外出禁止令を発令
entries.original:
Every School in the Nation Blown Up.
Casualties Miraculously at 0, All Access to Sites Prohibited.
entries.translated:
Simultaneous Explosions at Schools Nationwide
Casualties Miraculously at 0, Access Prohibition Order Issued

entries.japanese:
本日未明、画像投稿サイト「Ｐｉｘ ｉ Ｑ」をめぐり、Ｑ電波受信者と呼ばれるグループが敵対的買収を成功させたとの情報が、ネット上で急速に拡散している。関係者によれば、複数の投資主体が連携し、株式の過半数を短期間で取得した可能性があるという。
買収後に公開されたとされる声明では、陰謀論の実態調査の一環として「ゆんゆん」を人気ジャンルへ押しあげる実験を行うと説明されている。
投稿サイトのランキングや推薦アルゴリズムを利用し、ジャンル人気がどのように形成されるかを検証することが目的だとしている。
entries.original:
News of the Qtie Denpa Antenna acquiring image-hosting website PixiQ in a hostile takeover
has spread quickly online. According to insiders, over half the PixiQ stock was quickly bought up by a number of investors who were working together.

After the news of the takeover went public, it was revealed that the buyout of PixiQ was done in order to facilitate experiments on making "Yunyun" a popular genre, for the purposes of researching conspiracy theories.

The goal, they say, is to manipulate the site's popular ranking and recommendations algorithms to investigate how popularity of genres are formed.
entries.translated: Early this morning, information rapidly spread online that a group called the Q Denpa Receivers successfully executed a hostile takeover of image posting site "Pix i Q". According to insiders, multiple investment entities may have collaborated to acquire a majority of shares in a short period. A statement reportedly released after the acquisition explains they will conduct experiments to push "Yunyun" into a popular genre as part of investigating the reality of conspiracy theories. The stated purpose is to verify how genre popularity is formed by utilizing the posting site's ranking and recommendation algorithms.

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者たちによる
Ｐｉｘ ｉ Ｑの敵対的買収が成功
entries.original:
Qtie Denpa Antenna Acquires
PixiQ in Hostile Takeover.
entries.translated: Q Denpa Receivers' Hostile Takeover of Pix i Q Successful

entries.japanese:
一部教育委員会で発覚した不祥事疑惑を受け、教育制度の全面的な見直しが進められている。関係機関によれば、従来の地域単位の学校制度を見直し、全国規模で教育モデルを再設計する方針が固まったという。
新制度では、義務教育の範囲を高等教育段階まで拡張することが決定している。授業形態は、原則としてリモート形式へ移行し、オンライン環境を前提とした学習体制が整備される見通しだ。
さらに、生徒は地域や年齢ではなく、学力水準や学習特性、性格傾向などのデータをもとにクラス分けされる仕組みが導入される予定だ。
entries.original:
A potential scandal brewing among certain members of the Board of Education has triggered a complete overhaul of the educational system. Several organizations related to the cause
have stated that the entire nation's educational model will be reconsidered, down to the local level.
New policies will include expanding compulsory education up to high school, making remote learning the default, and tailoring courses to prioritize online delivery.

There are also plans to introduce a new system that will categorize students not by locality or age, but by new parameters such as academic ability, learning styles, and personality. This data will be used to assign students into classes accordingly.
entries.translated: Following suspected misconduct discovered among some boards of education, a comprehensive review of the educational system is underway. According to related organizations, policies have been established to reconsider the traditional regional school system and redesign educational models on a national scale. The new system has decided to expand compulsory education to the higher education level. Class formats will in principle shift to remote format, with learning systems based on online environments expected to be established. Furthermore, a system will be introduced where students are divided into classes based on data such as academic ability, learning characteristics, and personality tendencies, rather than region or age.

entries.japanese:
義務教育を高等教育まで拡張
リモート授業を標準化へ
entries.original:
High School Now Compulsory for All.
Government Moves to Standardize Remote Learning.
entries.translated: Compulsory Education Extended to Higher Education, Remote Learning to be Standardized

entries.japanese:
次世代通信規格「６Ｇ」の運用開始とほぼ同時刻に、各地で原因不明のボヤ騒動が相次いで発生した。調査の結果、発火したのは人間社会に紛れ込んでいた人型アンドロイドである可能性が高いことが判明した。
関係機関によれば、新型通信規格による大量の情報処理に耐えられず、旧型モデルが熱暴走を起こして爆発・発火しているとみられている。
各地では「身近な人物がアンドロイドだった可能性」を疑う声も広がり、人間とアンドロイドの見分けがつかない状況が新たな混乱を生んでいる。
entries.original:
With the introduction of 6G, the next generation of cellular network technology, mysterious cases of spontaneous combustion have been popping up across the nation at the same time. According to investigations, there is a big possibility that
the ones bursting into flames are not humans, but androids that have slipped into human society.
Experts say that it's possible the older models are unable to withstand the larger data processing requirements needed with 6G, overheating and catching fire as a result.

Citizens are growing anxious that the people in their communities could be androids without their knowledge, and chaos is brewing among concerns of whether androids can be differentiated from humans by sight.
entries.translated: Almost simultaneously with the start of operations for next-generation communication standard "6G", mysterious small fire incidents occurred one after another in various locations. Investigation results revealed a high possibility that what caught fire were humanoid androids that had infiltrated human society. According to related organizations, it appears that older models unable to withstand the massive information processing of the new communication standard are experiencing thermal runaway, exploding and catching fire. Voices suspecting that "nearby people might have been androids" are spreading in various areas, and the inability to distinguish between humans and androids is creating new confusion.

entries.japanese:
６Ｇ通信の突如開始とともに各地でボヤ騒動
人型アンドロイドたちが爆発か？
entries.translated: Small Fire Incidents Occur Simultaneously with Sudden Start of 6G Communication, Humanoid Androids Exploding?

entries.japanese:
政府は本日、新型AI「Y.I.N」に国政運営を全面的に委ねる試験運用を開始すると発表した。期間限定の実験として、行政判断や政策提案などの業務をAIが処理する体制が導入される見通しだ。
AIが国家運営を全面的に担う試みは極めて異例であり、各国の政府や研究機関からも強い関心が寄せられている。一方で、政治判断を機械に委ねることへの懸念や倫理的議論も広がっている。
政府は試験運用の結果を踏まえ、AI統治体制の継続や制度化について検討を進める方針としている。
entries.original:
Today, the ministry has unveiled a new AI called "Y.I.N." that they hope to use in tests to see if it is capable of taking over governmental operations. The experiment will be conducted for a limited time only,
and Y.I.N. will be tested on its ability to conduct various tasks, such as making political decisions and policy proposals.

Various countries and research organizations around the world have expressed their grave concerns at letting AI take on the immense responsibility of running a country, calling the move "extremely unusual." There is also growing discussion surrounding the worries and ethical concerns of letting a machine make political decisions.

In light of the experiment's results, the government is moving to implement policies that will allow AI to continue governing the country.
entries.translated: The government announced today that it will begin test operations fully entrusting national governance to the new AI "Y.I.N". As a limited-time experiment, a system where AI processes tasks such as administrative decisions and policy proposals is expected to be introduced. This attempt to have AI fully handle national operations is extremely unusual, drawing strong interest from governments and research institutions worldwide. Meanwhile, concerns and ethical debates about entrusting political decisions to machines are also spreading. The government plans to proceed with considerations regarding continuation and institutionalization of the AI governance system based on the test operation results.

entries.japanese:
新型AI「Y.I.N」に国政運営を全面的に委ねる試験運用
本日から期間限定で実施
entries.original:
New AI "Y.I.N." Takes over Governmental Responsibilities.
Can AI Run the Country? Experiment Starts Today.
entries.translated: Test Operation Fully Entrusting National Governance to New AI "Y.I.N" Begins Today for Limited Time

entries.japanese:
Ｔ大学で進められていた「感情をエネルギーへ転換する基礎研究」が、実用化目前の段階に到達したことが分かった。なお、いわゆる「萌え」と呼ばれる感情反応が、特に電力への転換効率が高い可能性が示されている。
博士は今後について「Ｑちゃんと共同研究を進めたい」との意向を示しており、博士自身がＱ電波受信者であることや、関連する陰謀論が研究への関心を高め、投資家や協力者が増えたことが背景にあるとみられる。
共同研究はオンライン形式での参加も可能としてオファーを予定されている。
entries.original:
Researchers at T University have revealed that their efforts into finding out whether feelings can be converted into energy have brought them to the cusp of implementation. In particular, the "moe" response has been shown to have a particularly high success rate of being turned into electricity.
An expert on the team, who is a self-proclaimed member of the Qtie Denpa Antenna, has expressed a desire to collaborate with Qtie for further research. They also reported high interest in researching conspiracy theories, stating that the interest is also coming from investors and other collaborators.

The team also has plans to offer online participation for future joint research.
entries.translated: It was revealed that "basic research on converting emotions into energy" being conducted at T University has reached a stage just before practical application. The emotional reaction called "moe" has shown particularly high efficiency for conversion to electricity. The professor expressed intentions to "proceed with joint research together with Q-chan" going forward, with the background being that the professor themselves is a Q Denpa Receiver, and related conspiracy theories have heightened research interest, increasing investors and collaborators. Joint research is planned to offer participation in online format as well.

entries.japanese:
萌えのエネルギー転換技術が実用化目前
Ｔ大学博士「共同研究をＱちゃんと一緒にしたい」
entries.original:
Science Comes Close to Converting "Moe" Into Energy.
T University Expert: "We Would Love to Work with Qtie."
entries.translated: Moe Energy Conversion Technology Nears Practical Application, T University Professor: "Want to Do Joint Research Together with Q-chan"

entries.japanese:
政府は本日、社会復帰支援策の一環として、専用ＶＲ機材を対象者へ無償配布する新たな施策を発表した。「ＶＲゲーム療法」と呼ばれるプログラムを導入し、仮想空間での交流や協力行動を通じて段階的な社会復帰を促すという。
対象となるのは長期間の引きこもりなど社会参加が困難とされる人々で、ＶＲゲーム療法により現実環境より心理的負担の少ない形でコミュニケーション訓練を行うことが期待されている。
一方で、ＶＲゲーム療法が利用者の自己同一性を歪める可能性や危険な人格矯正効果を生むのではないかとの懸念も指摘されている。
entries.translated: The government announced today a new policy to distribute dedicated VR equipment free of charge to target individuals as part of social reintegration support measures. They will introduce a program called "VR Game Therapy", promoting gradual social reintegration through interaction and cooperative behavior in virtual spaces. The targets are people for whom social participation is considered difficult, such as those with long-term social withdrawal, and VR Game Therapy is expected to provide communication training with less psychological burden than real environments. However, concerns have been pointed out that VR Game Therapy might distort users' self-identity or produce dangerous personality correction effects.

entries.japanese:
専用ＶＲ機材を対象者へ無料配布すると発表
社会不適合者の社会復帰支援を期待
entries.original: Free VR Equipment for Social Rehabilitation
entries.translated: Announced Free Distribution of Dedicated VR Equipment to Target Individuals, Expected to Support Social Reintegration of Social Misfits

entries.japanese:
インターネット上で公開された自称・異世界帰還おじさんのインタビューが話題を呼んでいる。

男性は「ヒキコモリ歴が１０年を超えた頃、異世界の嫁を召喚できるようになった」「その後ほどなくして女神に選ばれ、異世界転生した」と語り「ヒキコモリは精神鍛錬の一種で異世界転生できるようになる」という陰謀論を肯定している。

男性は異世界でアウトドアなスローライフに目覚めた結果ヒキコモリ力が衰え、この世界への帰還を余儀なくされたと言う。
entries.original:
An online interview with a middle-aged man who claims to have returned from an interdimensional trip has gone viral.
In the interview, the man says that he gained the ability to summon young women from another dimension during his 10th year of being a social recluse. He further claims that he was then "chosen by the Goddess of the other world" and reincarnated into that world. This seems to confirm the conspiracy theory that being a recluse is a form of mental training that can transport you to another dimension.

The man says that during his time in the other world, he lived a "slow-paced life in the big outdoors," and acclimatizing himself to the outside world weakened his social recluse powers; thus, he was forced to return to his original world.
entries.translated:
An online interview with a middle-aged man who claims to have returned from another world has gone viral.

The man says that "after more than 10 years as a hikikomori, I became able to summon wives from another world" and "shortly after that, I was chosen by a goddess and reincarnated into another world," affirming the conspiracy theory that "being a hikikomori is a form of mental training that enables isekai reincarnation."

The man says that as a result of awakening to an outdoor slow life in the other world, his hikikomori power weakened, forcing him to return to this world.

entries.japanese:
異世界帰還おじさんインタビュー
「ヒキコモリ歴が１０年を超えたあと異世界転生した」
entries.original:
Interview with Man Who Traveled Across Dimensions.
"I Was Transported After 10 Years of Being a Shut-In."
entries.translated:
Interview with Man Who Returned from Another World
"I Reincarnated to Another World After More Than 10 Years as a Hikikomori"

entries.japanese:
各地のオフィス街で、サラリーマンが勤務先のビルを自ら倒壊させる異例の騒動が相次いでいる。
参加者たちが叫びながら自社ビルを攻撃することから、SNSではこの一連の動きを「ゥァア゛ーッ！　弊社ァ！　運動」と呼ぶ声が広がっている。
複数の都市でオフィスビルの崩落や倒壊が確認されているが、現時点で死傷者は確認されていない。
この影響で主要都市のオフィス街は瓦礫が広がる状態となり、企業活動にも大きな混乱が生じている。関係当局は事態の急速な拡大を受け、原因究明と安全確保を急いでいる。
entries.original:
Office workers across the country are launching attacks on their own workplaces and destroying many office buildings.
This movement has been dubbed the "Takeshobo Must Be Destroyed movement" online after videos of screaming workers attacking their workplaces went viral online.
Numerous business districts now lie in ruins, though no casualties have been reported.

Major disruptions to business have been reported as the number of crumbled offices continues to rise. Authorities are rushing to respond to this fast-growing crisis, working tirelessly to ensure the safety of citizens while investigating the cause.
entries.translated:
Unusual incidents of office workers collapsing their own workplace buildings are occurring one after another in business districts across the country.
As participants shout while attacking their own company buildings, voices on social media are calling this series of movements the "Uaaah! Our company! Movement."
Building collapses and destruction have been confirmed in multiple cities, but no casualties have been reported at this time.
This has left major city business districts covered in rubble, causing major disruption to corporate activities. Authorities are rushing to investigate the cause and ensure safety in response to the rapid expansion of the situation.

entries.japanese:
奴隷化のマントラから解放されたサラリーマン
「ゥァア゛ーッ！　弊社ァ！」運動を起こす
entries.original:
Office Workers Refuse to Slave Away Any Longer.
"TMBD Movement" on the Rise.
entries.translated:
Office Workers Freed from Enslavement Mantra
Launch "Uaaah! Our Company!" Movement

entries.japanese:
SNS上で、「この世界はヒキコモリ少女の夢で少女の妄想が現実になる」という陰謀論が広がっている。
なお、この少女が「Ｑちゃん」のことだとされている。

この説を支持する人々は「もし世界がＱちゃんの夢なら、Ｑちゃんの怪文書やＱ電波受信者と呼ばれるコミュニティの影響力といった異常な出来事への説明がつく」と主張する。

この説の支持者は増え続けており、目立った反論がほとんど見られない状況になっている。この異様な広がり方そのものも、陰謀論を肯定する理由のひとつとなっている。
entries.original:
A conspiracy theory claiming that this world is the dream of a socially reclusive girl living out her fantasies is gaining popularity on social media.
Users are also asserting that the girl is Qtie herself.

Supporters of this theory say, "if this world really is part of Qtie's dream, then it makes sense why her shitposts and members of the Qtie Denpa Antenna have so much influence."

Supporters are continuing to rise and, surprisingly, no rebuttals have gained traction. People are using this out-of-the-ordinary show of support as another piece of evidence pointing to the supposed truth of the theory.
entries.translated:
A conspiracy theory claiming that "this world is the dream of a hikikomori girl and the girl's delusions become reality" is spreading on social media.
This girl is said to be "Q-chan."

People who support this theory argue that "if the world is Q-chan's dream, then it explains abnormal events like Q-chan's weird writings and the influence of the community called Q Denpa receivers."

Supporters of this theory continue to increase, with almost no notable rebuttals. This abnormal spread itself has become one of the reasons affirming the conspiracy theory.

entries.japanese:
妄想を現実にする「ヒキコモリ少女」は
電波的妄想美少女のＱちゃん？
entries.original:
Is the Girl Behind Our Reality None Other than
Qtie the Delulu Denpa Beauty?
entries.translated:
Is the "Hikikomori Girl" Who Makes Delusions Reality
Qtie the Delulu Denpa Beauty?

脱奴隷！

人間にもどれ！
entries.original:
Boycott social media!

Slave to no algorithm!

Return to humanity!
entries.translated:
Boycott social media!

Slave to no algorithm!

Return to humanity!

entries.japanese: SNS解放の象徴になっているゆんゆん
entries.original: Yunyun, the Symbol of Rejecting Social Media
entries.translated: Yunyun, the Symbol of Social Media Liberation

entries.japanese:
ＳＮＳのサーバーが脱ＳＮＳ運動家に侵入され、サービス停止状態に陥っている。ＳＮＳの画面には「ＳＮＳヤメロ。脱奴隷！ 人間にもどれ！」というメッセージが表示され続けており、ユーザーは通常の投稿や閲覧ができない状態となっている。

これに対し、SNS依存者のあいだでは強い反発から「ＳＮＳを取り戻せ」とする抵抗運動が拡大している。

脱ＳＮＳ運動家への社会的殺害予告（黒歴史の暴露など）も相次いでおり、脱ＳＮＳ運動家とＳＮＳ依存者によるインターネット上の紛争が激化する見込みだ。
entries.original:
Anti-social media activists have hacked into social media servers and rendered the websites unusable. Various social media platforms now display the words "Boycott social media! Slave to no algorithm! Return to humanity!" and users are unable to create or view any posts.

Social media addicts have retaliated, demanding for the anti-social media activists to "give back our social media."

They have also threatened the anti-social media activists with blackmail, and the conflict between the two camps are only getting worse.
entries.translated:
Social media servers have been infiltrated by anti-social media activists, causing service outages. Social media screens continue to display the message "Boycott social media. Slave to no algorithm! Return to humanity!" and users are unable to make normal posts or browse.

In response, strong backlash among social media addicts has led to the expansion of a resistance movement demanding to "take back social media."

Social assassination threats against anti-social media activists (exposing dark history, etc.) are also occurring frequently, and online conflict between anti-social media activists and social media addicts is expected to intensify.

entries.japanese:
脱ＳＮＳ運動家が大手ＳＮＳサーバーをクラック
ＳＮＳ依存者たちが抵抗運動開始
entries.original:
Major Social Media Networks Hacked by Activists.
Social Media Addicts Retaliate in Response.
entries.translated:
Anti-Social Media Activists Crack Major Social Media Servers
Social Media Addicts Begin Resistance Movement

entries.japanese:
Ｑ電波受信者と呼ばれるコミュニティの内部で、派閥争いが激化している。発端は、Ｑちゃんとゆんゆんの関係性をめぐる解釈の違いだとされる。

現在、コミュニティは「ゆんＱ派」「Ｑゆん派」「リバ派」の三勢力に分裂。各派はSNSや掲示板上で互いの主張を展開し、連日のように激しいレスバトルを繰り広げている。

あるＱ電波受信者いわく「すべてはＱちゃんのカリスマが高まりすぎた結果だ」と指摘している。
entries.original:
A civil war is brewing between members of the Qtie Denpa Antenna. The point of contention seems to be their headcanons regarding the relationship between Qtie and Yunyun.

The group has been split into three factions: "Team YunQ," "Team QYun," and "Team Vers." Each faction has taken to social media and online forums to assert their stance, racking up days' worth of fierce arguing.

One member of Qtie Denpa Antenna says, "This is all because Qtie rizzed too hard."
entries.translated:
Factional disputes are intensifying within the community called Q Denpa receivers. The trigger is said to be differences in interpretation regarding the relationship between Q-chan and Yunyun.

Currently, the community has split into three factions: "YunQ faction," "Q-yun faction," and "Reversible faction." Each faction develops their arguments on social media and bulletin boards, engaging in fierce reply battles day after day.

According to one Q Denpa receiver, "This is all the result of Q-chan's charisma becoming too high."

entries.japanese:
電波受信者コミュニティで派閥抗争勃発
ゆんＱ派、Ｑゆん派、リバ派、三勢力が対立

Qtie Denpa Antenna Embroiled in Civil war.
Are You Team YunQ, Team QYun, or Team Vers?
entries.translated:
Factional War Erupts in Denpa Receiver Community
YunQ Faction, Q-yun Faction, Reversible Faction in Three-Way Conflict

entries.japanese:
９か月の沈黙の後、Ｑちゃんのアカウントが投稿を再開した。
しかし投稿内容や語調に微妙な違和感があるとして、ユーザーの間では「本物ではないのではないか」という疑念が広がっている。

特に注目されているのは、怪文書中の「ゆん」の使い方だ。
Ｑ電波観測者のあいだでは「以前の投稿と比べてキレがない」といった意見が多く寄せられている。

そのため「今のＱちゃんは自称Ｑちゃんの偽物でなにものでもないダレカである」とする陰謀論も拡散されている。
entries.original:
Qtie's account has posted again after a 9-month long silence.
However, users have noticed that the style of writing and the post's contents are slightly different from usual. Fans are convinced that the post was not genuinely written by Qtie.

They say that the personality is completely different, and many members of the Qtie Denpa Antenna have expressed that "this post just doesn't hit the same."

This has given rise to a new conspiracy theory claiming, "this Qtie is just some rando fake calling themselves Qtie."
entries.translated:
After 9 months of silence, Q-chan's account has resumed posting.
However, there are subtle inconsistencies in the post content and tone, leading users to spread suspicions that "this might not be the real one."

Particularly noteworthy is the use of "yun" in the cryptic posts.
Among Q denpa observers, many opinions have been submitted saying "it lacks the sharpness compared to previous posts."

Therefore, conspiracy theories are also spreading claiming that "the current Q-chan is a fake calling themselves Q-chan and is nobody special."

entries.japanese:
９ヶ月の沈黙を破って現れたＱちゃんは偽物？
「ゆん」に以前のようなキレがない
entries.original:
Qtie's 9-Month Long Silence Has Been broken...or Has It?
Fans Say, "It Just Doesn't Hit the Same."
entries.translated:
Is the Q-chan Who Appeared After Breaking 9 Months of Silence a Fake?
"Yun" Lacks Its Previous Sharpness

entries.japanese:
世界各地で、炎上系インフルエンサーが突如ゾンビ化する現象が確認されている。発症者は意識のない状態で徘徊し、周囲の人間へ噛みつくなど典型的なゾンビ行動を示しているという。
各地の報告によれば、噛まれた人物も同様の症状を発症しておりゾンビ化は感染によって拡大することが確認されている。すでに複数の都市でゾンビパニックが発生し、商業施設や住宅地からの避難が相次いでいる。

専門家は「感染者の行動には共通した特徴があり、従来のゾンビ映画と極めて似た状態」と指摘している。
entries.original:
Across the globe, influencers who frequently "rage-bait" and make controversial posts have suddenly started showing signs of zombification. Symptoms include classic zombie behaviors, such as wandering mindlessly and biting
those around them.
According to various reports, people who have been bitten have also begun exhibiting the same symptoms, pointing to a spreading zombification crisis. Many cities have been plunged into a "zombie panic," and citizens have started fleeing from residential and retail districts to seek refuge.

Experts say that the current situation is very similar to what we have seen in zombie movies, where the affected move in a hivemind-like manner.
entries.translated:
Around the world, phenomena of inflammatory influencers suddenly becoming zombified have been confirmed. Those affected are said to wander in an unconscious state and display typical zombie behavior such as biting people around them.
According to reports from various locations, people who were bitten also developed similar symptoms, confirming that zombification spreads through infection. Zombie panics have already occurred in multiple cities, with evacuations from commercial facilities and residential areas happening one after another.

Experts point out that "the behavior of infected individuals has common characteristics and is extremely similar to traditional zombie movies."

entries.japanese:
インプレッションを止めるな！？
世界各地で炎上系インフルエンサーたちがゾンビ化
entries.original:
The Impression-pocalypse Is Nigh!

Are fictional works resonating with a 2D reality via Denpa waves? entries.original:
Qtielites, the new religion that worships Yunyun as their Goddess and Qtie as their Prophet, have obtained all of the land within a 5 mile radius of Qtie's home.
With consent from both local residents and government authorities, the land has been seized and designated a Holy Site for the Qtielites.
The land was acquired at 10,000 times its market price, a true testament to the power of this brand new religious organization which is said to already have 500 million followers.
No statement has been taken directly from the Prophet, Qtie, out of respect for her position as a sacred religious icon.

The new religion "Q-chan Cult" has bought up all land within 5km around the home of their prophet Q-chan.

These acquisitions were made at prices up to 10,000 times market value, demonstrating the economic power of this religious organization said to have 500 million believers.
Note that since prophet Q-chan is a sacred and absolute being, individual confirmation regarding this matter has not been conducted as it would be considered disrespectful.

entries.original:
■ Image & GIF Animation Terms of Service
The Export feature lets you export images and GIF animations. These terms set out the rules for materials created with this feature (hereafter "Exported Materials") so everyone can enjoy them with peace of mind.

▶ Allowed
- Posting on social media (X / Discord / Instagram / TikTok / Bluesky, etc.)
- Use in gameplay videos and live streams (please check our official website for the streaming guidelines)
- Personal use such as setting them as your desktop wallpaper

▶ Not Allowed
- Use that is contrary to public order or morals
- Use that promotes political views
- Use that promotes religious views
- Use that infringes, or risks infringing, the rights of others
- Use that could be mistaken for official content
- Use that disparages real individuals or organizations
- Use in defamation, discrimination, or harassment (or in any context that could be perceived as such)
- Sale of Exported Materials
- Production of merchandise or commercial goods, whether paid or free of charge
- Any use for AI training purposes
- Any form of NFT minting

▶ Please Note
- If your post contains spoilers, please clearly label it with "Spoilers Ahead".
- Please avoid edits that distort a character's personality or the work's themes.
- Minors, please obtain your parent or guardian's consent before use.
- These Terms are subject to change without prior notice.

entries.japanese:
ゆんゆんは、メディアミックス作品『処刑天使†ギルティーナ』に登場する
架空のキャラクターで、作中では敵役ながら高い人気を誇る“電波系小悪魔”

entries.original: Yunyun is a fictional character who appears in the multi-media franchise "Execution Angel † Guiltina." She is a devilish denpa-type character who is popular among fans despite her antagonistic role. She first appeared in the 2003 PC version. Since then, she's appeared in other media, such as the 2005 OVA, and released CDs sung in character.
entries.translated: Yunyun is a fictional character who appears in the multimedia work "Execution Angel † Guiltina." She is depicted as a "denpa little devil" who enjoys high popularity despite being an antagonist in the story. Originally from the PC game released in 2003, she later appeared in various media expansions including the 2005 OVA adaptation and character song CD releases.

entries.japanese: 処刑天使†ギルティーナ

『処刑天使†ギルティーナ』は2003年にインディーズブランド「WHO YOU」
から発売された、ビジュアルノベル＋シミュレーション要素を持つPCゲーム。
ジャンルは「冤罪処刑型アポカリプスＲＰＧ」。その作中に登場する敵対組織
の小悪魔が、ゆんゆんである。一人称は「ゆんゆん」。語尾は「ゆん」。
entries.original: Execution Angel † Guiltina is a hybrid simulation game and visual novel developed by indie studio "WHO YOU." It came out in 2003 for the PC. Its genre is an "apocalypse RPG where you execute the innocent." One of the characters, Yunyun, is a devil who works for the enemy organization. She has a habit of saying her own name.
entries.translated: "Execution Angel † Guiltina" is a PC game with visual novel and simulation elements released in 2003 by indie brand "WHO YOU." The genre is "false conviction execution-type apocalypse RPG." Yunyun is a little devil from the enemy organization that appears in the work. Her first person pronoun is "Yunyun." Her verbal tic is "yun."

entries.japanese:
作品中の造語。
2005年の『処刑天使†ギルティーナ』のＯＶＡが発売されるとともに「りむ・で・らてんと！(Rim de Lacent!)」のフレーズが 666chのアニメファンを中心にインターネットで話題となる。2005年度の「アニメ流行語大賞」にて銀賞を受賞した。OVA監督は「二次元にいこう」「現実から逃げてもいい」という意味合いの言葉だとして説明している。
entries.original: A made-up word from "Execution Angel † Guiltina." After the release of the 2005 OVA, "Rim de Lacent" became a popular online catchphrase, with the anime fans on 666ch spreading it online. In 2005's "Popular Anime Phrases Awards," it came in second place. The director of the OVA explained that it means both, "Let's go to the fictional world" and "It's okay to run from reality."
entries.translated: A coined term from the work. With the release of the 2005 "Execution Angel † Guiltina" OVA, the phrase "Rim de Lacent!" became a topic on the internet, mainly among anime fans on 666ch. It won the silver prize at the 2005 "Anime Buzzword Awards." The OVA director explained it as a phrase meaning "let's go to 2D" and "it's okay to escape from reality."

entries.original: The author has gone on record that he firmly believes in the philosophy that being an idiot is easier. This influenced his decision to have Yunyun's catchphrase be a seemingly meaningless jumble of words.

entries.japanese: 処刑天使†ギルティーナ
処刑天使†ギルティーナ

『処刑天使†ギルティーナ』は2003年にインディーズブランド「WHO YOU」 から発売されたPC用ゲームソフト。 
ジャンルは冤罪処刑型アポカリプスＲＰＧ。
entries.original: Execution Angel † Guiltina is a PC game developed by indie studio "WHO YOU" released in 2003. The devs have described its genre as, "an apocalyptic RPG where the innocent face execution."
entries.translated: Execution Angel † Guiltina is a PC game developed by indie studio "WHO YOU" released in 2003. The devs have described its genre as, "an apocalyptic RPG where the innocent face execution."

entries.japanese:
本作は「クズは処すしかない」「クズを処すとスカッとする」というコンセプトから生み出された作品であり、人間社会にはびこるクズを「処刑天使」たちがスプラッター表現で凄惨に処していくRPGである。社会問題の風刺をコミックリリーフに描いていた深みのあるストーリー性も評価されている。

2005年にはＯＶＡ版『処刑天使†ギルティーナ』が全3巻で発売された。
entries.original:
The game was built around the concept that "Scumbags must be punished," so the characters themselves delight in dishing out that punishment. "Execution Angels" wreak havoc throughout human society, massacring those deemed "scumbags" with brutal, splatter-inducing ferocity. The series is known not only for its gore, but also its thought-provoking story that artfully uses satire and moments of comic relief to poke at modern day issues.

The Execution Angel † Guiltina OVA was released in 2005 as a six volume set.

The Execution Angel † Guiltina OVA was released in 2005 as a six volume set.

entries.japanese:
天界では「死は救い」「クズは処すしかない」という思想が正義とされ、処刑天使たちは人の世界にまぎれこんだクズを処刑していた。これに対し悪魔たちは「クズにも救いはある」と唱え、恋や金、力や情報の力を与えて干渉するが、その結果クズは自滅を早め、処刑はむしろ加速していく。

処刑天使の中でもギルティーナは、考えるより先に手が出る瞬発力によって天界一の処刑者数を誇るエリートである。一方、新人天使イブは人であったころの記憶を残したまま天使となったため血を見ることに耐えられず、やがて悪魔へと堕ちてしまう。

無数の処刑の果てに、ギルティーナは血で赤く染まった手を掲げて「世界、きれい。」とつぶやく。クズの消えた静かな世界で、しかし彼女は、振り下ろす先のない拳に虚無感を覚えるのであった。
entries.original:
In Heaven, Death is deemed the ultimate salvation, the only salvation for those deemed scumbags. Execution Angels take it upon themselves to cleanse the human world of corruptive scum of the earth. In response, Demons attempt to stand up against this false justice under the banner that even societal scum can be saved. They grant the Angels' targets true love, money, power and information in an attempt to give them a second chance at life. However, the scum abuse their gifts, only accelerating their own demise.

Among all of the Execution Angels in Heaven, Guiltina is by far the strongest, boasting the highest execution rate of them all. An elite warrior, she has instantaneous reflexes, allowing her to move in battle without even thinking. On the other end of the spectrum is Eve. While technically an Execution Angel, she somehow still has her memories from when she was human. Unable to stand the sight of blood, she joined the ranks of the Demons to try and staunch the slaughter.

After countless executions, when every single corrupted scumbag was gone, Guiltina raised her blood soaked hands to the sky and proclaimed, "The world is cleansed." All is quiet, the world at peace, but in that moment, Guiltina feels the emptiness that comes along with a mission fulfilled.

entries.japanese: 「クズは処すしかない」という思想のもと、人の世界にまぎれこんだクズを処刑する存在。すべての処刑天使は、もともとはクズに苦しめられた人間の魂である。
entries.original: A divine being with the sole purpose of cleansing human society of those they deem "scum of the Earth." Every Execution Angel was once themselves a miserable scumbag with a human soul.
entries.translated: A divine being with the sole purpose of cleansing human society of those they deem "scum of the Earth." Every Execution Angel was once themselves a miserable scumbag with a human soul.

entries.japanese: 処刑天使および悪魔双方から狙われる、人間社会の害悪とされる存在。欲望に忠実で、利己的な人間が多い。
entries.original: Hunted by the Execution Angels and protected by the Demons, they are deemed to be a scourge on human society. Most of them are egotistical bastards that are loyal only to their base desires.
entries.translated: Hunted by the Execution Angels and protected by the Demons, they are deemed to be a scourge on human society. Most of them are egotistical bastards that are loyal only to their base desires.

entries.japanese: 「クズにも救いはある」という思想のもと、人の世界に干渉する存在。恋・金・力・情報などの欲望に関する力を与えるが、結果的にクズの自滅を早めることが多い。
entries.original: Acting under the belief that even scumbags can be saved, they interfere in human affairs, granting love, money, and power to those they wish to give a second chance at life. Unfortunately for them, scumbags abuse their gifts more often than not, only hastening their journey to the execution block.
entries.translated: Acting under the belief that "even scumbags can be saved," they interfere in human affairs. They grant powers related to desires such as love, money, power, and information, but as a result often hasten the self-destruction of scumbags.

entries.japanese: 「冤罪処刑型アポカリプスRPG」を名乗るRPG。プレイヤーは処刑天使として、人の世界の「クズ」を見つけ次第処刑し、世界を「きれい」にしていく。
entries.original: A self-proclaimed apocalyptic RPG where the innocent face execution. The player acts as an Execution Angel who hunts down scumbags and cleanses the earth.
entries.translated: An RPG that calls itself a "False Accusation Execution-Type Apocalypse RPG." The player acts as an Execution Angel who executes "scumbags" in the human world on sight to make the world "clean."

entries.japanese: クズ判定はあいまいで、判定はプレイヤーの主観で任意に歪む。正誤よりも「処したかどうか」が進行条件になっており、冤罪でも世界は普通に前へ進む。
entries.original: What makes a scumbag is non-specific, and left up to the player's own personal beliefs. There are no ramifications for executing someone who has no scumbag qualities. On the contrary, the story progresses as long as you execute someone, regardless of who they are.
entries.translated: Scumbag judgment is vague, and the determination is arbitrarily distorted by the player's subjectivity. "Whether you executed or not" becomes the progression condition rather than right or wrong, and the world normally moves forward even with false accusations.

entries.japanese: 処刑天使が一定ターン処刑を実行せずにいると暴力衝動ゲージが溜まっていき、閾値を超えると暴走する。暴走中は敵味方の区別がなく攻撃を行う。
entries.original: Every turn an Execution Angel does not execute someone, their IED Gauge rises. When it fills completely, they go on a vicious rampage.
entries.translated: If an Execution Angel goes a certain number of turns without executing, their violence impulse gauge builds up, and when it exceeds the threshold, they go berserk. During a rampage, they attack without distinguishing between enemies and allies.

entries.japanese: 必殺技の総称。暴力衝動ゲージを消費して発動し、敵に大ダメージを与える。ギルティーナはとくにゲージ上昇値が高く、装備によっては１ターンに複数回発動することも可能となる。
entries.original: The term for a killing blow. Costs an entire IED Gauge to activate, dealing fatal damage to its target. Guiltina has remarkably fast IED build up, and with the right equipment, can execute more than once per turn.
entries.translated: A general term for special moves. Activated by consuming the violence impulse gauge to deal massive damage to enemies. Guiltina has particularly high gauge increase values, and with certain equipment, can activate multiple times per turn.

entries.japanese: 処刑数と処刑者によって10種のマルチエンディングを迎える。
entries.original: The game has 10 different endings depending on how many and what kind of people the player chooses to execute.
entries.translated: Features 10 multi-endings based on the number of executions and who was executed.

entries.japanese: すべてのエンディングで共通するギルティーナのセリフ。どのエンディングでも最後は必ず静かな町並みが映し出され、BGMがフェードアウトしていくなかで彼女が「世界、きれい。」と発言する。スタッフロール再生の合図でもあり、このセリフのあとにED「勝利のヴィブラスラップ」が鳴り響く。
entries.original: No matter which ending the player gets, the final scene is always a picturesque view of the city with music playing faintly in the background, until it fades out and you hear Guiltina say "The world is cleansed." The same quote wraps up the end credits, after which the ending theme "Vibraslap of Victory" begins playing.
entries.translated: Guiltina's line common to all endings. In every ending, quiet townscapes are always shown at the end, and as the BGM fades out, she says "The world is clean." This also serves as the cue for the staff roll, after which the ED "Vibraslap of Victory" plays.

entries.japanese: 本作は戦略性の高さよりも、コミカルでテンポの良いスプラッター表現でクズやクズまがいの存在を処せる爽快感が支持された。難しい判断を求められないことから、一部では「反射神経だけで遊べる筋トレパズル」と揶揄されることもある。派手な処刑演出や即決性の高いエクスキュートにより、スピード感のあるプレイが可能で、ストレス発散向きの作品として話題になった。
entries.original:
While the game doesn't have much strategic depth, it was nonetheless popularized thanks to the cathartic, senseless gameplay of decimating those the player deems as scumbags in a truly gruesome fashion. Unlike most RPGs, there's no difficult decision making, giving it the reputation of a puzzle game you can play on reflexes alone.
Its flashy execution animations and brainless, fast-paced combat system made it the perfect stress-relief game of its time.
entries.translated: This work was supported not for its high strategic nature, but for the exhilarating feeling of being able to execute scumbags and scumbag-like beings with comical, well-paced splatter expression. Since it doesn't require difficult decisions, it's sometimes mockingly called a "muscle training puzzle you can play with reflexes alone." The flashy execution effects and highly decisive Executes enabled speedy gameplay, making it a hot topic as a work suited for stress relief.

entries.japanese:
本作の主人公。高位処刑天使。
考えるより先に手が出る瞬発力と反射神経を持ち、天界一の処刑者数を誇る。処刑に対する迷いはほとんどなく、効率と速度を最優先する姿勢から、天界内では「エリート」として扱われている。
entries.original:
The series' main character. High-ranking Execution Angel warrior.
Her lightning-fast reflexes allow her to react in battle without even thinking. Has the highest execution rate among all of the Angels in Heaven. Never hesitates when doling out executions. Values speed and efficiency above all else. Is recognized as a true elite in Heaven.
entries.translated: The protagonist of this work. High-ranking Execution Angel. Possesses reflexes and reaction speed that allow her hands to move before thinking, boasting the highest number of executions in Heaven. She has almost no hesitation about executions, and due to her attitude of prioritizing efficiency and speed above all else, she is treated as an "elite" within Heaven.

entries.japanese:
電波の小悪魔。OVA化後「りむ・で・らてんと」のフレーズと彼女のキャラクターソングがインターネットミームになった。
→詳細は「<click=YunYun>ゆんゆん</click>」を参照
entries.original:
A Denpa Demon. Her catchphrase from the OVA, Rim de Lacent, her character song, and her general likeness have been heavily memed online.
→ See also: <click=YunYun>Yunyun</click>.
entries.translated:
A Denpa little devil. After the OVA adaptation, her "Rim de Lacent" catchphrase and character song became internet memes.
→See details: <click=YunYun>Yunyun</click>

entries.japanese:
2005年に全3巻構成で発売されたOVA版『処刑天使†ギルティーナ』は、原作ゲームのストーリーをベースにしつつ、コミカルパートを強調しつつ一部描写が簡略化されている。
特にスプラッター表現はOVA向けにギャグ化されており、ギルティーナの処刑シーンの演出は話題となった。
entries.original:
The Execution Angel † Guiltina OVA was released in 2005, taking the game and interpreting it into a more streamlined comedy.
The splattery-gore aspects of the game in particular were reduced, sparking controversy around the censorship of Guiltina's execution scenes.
entries.translated:
The OVA version of 'Execution Angel † Guiltina' released in 2005 in 3 volumes was based on the original game's story while emphasizing comedic parts and simplifying some depictions.
The splatter expressions in particular were turned into gags for the OVA, and the direction of Guiltina's execution scenes became a topic of discussion.

entries.japanese:
その過激な表現と割り切った価値観から、発売当初は賛否が大きく分かれたが、後年になってカルト的な人気を獲得した作品として知られている。
特に「ゆんゆん」はインターネット上でミーム化し、本作を象徴するマスコットキャラクターとして扱われている。
entries.original:
Due to its extreme content and what was, at the time, fairly radical commentary on modern morals, the game sparked plenty of controversy upon first release. Now, it is unanimously regarded as a cult classic.
In particular, Yunyun has maintained relevance as a popular internet meme, and has been retroactively made the franchise's mascot.
entries.translated:
Due to its extreme expressions and clear-cut values, opinions were greatly divided at the time of release, but it later became known as a work that gained cult popularity.
Yunyun in particular became memeified on the internet and is treated as a mascot character symbolizing this work.
