entries.translated: This is a character list for "Execution Angel † Guiltina," the PC game produced by WHO YOU, and the OVA of the same name based on it.

entries.japanese: 「死は救済」「クズは処すしかない」という天界の思想に従い、人間社会のクズたちを処して回る天使たち。
entries.original: Angels who carry out their version of divine justice. They believe that Death is the ultimate salvation, and those they deem to be scum of the Earth must be eliminated.
entries.translated: Angels who go around executing the scum of human society, following the heavenly ideology that "death is salvation" and "scum can only be dealt with by execution."

entries.japanese:
本作品の主人公。
物静かな性格をしているが、それは「暴力」に圧倒的な自信があるから。
物語開始時点では「高位処刑天使」だったが最終話にて処刑大天使（グランド・エクスキューショナー）へと昇格する。処刑はタイパが重要という職業倫理からすれ違いざまに人間を処すことがある。
総処刑者数は１０億人。
entries.original:
The story’s main character.
Has a reserved personality, but her calmness reflects the absolute confidence she has in her capacity for violence.
A high-ranking Execution Angel at the start. She is promoted to Grand Executioner, the ultimate title among Angels, by the end of the game. Her motto is, "Efficiency is everything.” She even executes people while out on casual strolls.Her total kill count is 10 billion.
entries.translated:
The protagonist of this work.
She has a quiet personality, but that's because she has overwhelming confidence in "violence."
At the start of the story she was a "High-ranking Execution Angel," but in the final episode she is promoted to Grand Executioner. Due to her professional ethics that efficiency is important in executions, she sometimes executes humans in passing.
Total execution count: 1 billion people.

entries.japanese:
本作品のもうひとりの主人公。
新人処刑天使。人間時代の記憶を保ったまま天使化している。処刑天使の生活に慣れていないこともあり、処刑天使たちのツッコミ役。血液恐怖症のため（すぐにスプラッターシーンを生み出す）ギルティーナが苦手。血を見るのが嫌すぎて物語中盤で悪魔化をする。
総処刑者数は１０人。
entries.original:
The secondary main character, and foil to Guiltina.
A new recruit who somehow retained the memories of her human life, even after becoming an Execution Angel. Carrying the weight of her humanity, she can't adjust to the Execution Angel lifestyle, and serves as a foil for all of the other Angels.
Suffers from hemophobia, and can't stand to be around Guiltina because of the utter desolation she leaves in her wake. Hates the sight of blood so much that halfway through the story, she deserts the Angels and falls in league with the Demons.
Her kill count is 10, total.
entries.translated:
Another protagonist of this work.
A rookie Execution Angel. She became an angel while retaining her memories from when she was human. Since she's not used to the Execution Angel lifestyle, she serves as the straight man to the Execution Angels. She's bad with Guiltina because of her hemophobia (since Guiltina immediately creates splatter scenes). She hates seeing blood so much that she becomes a demon in the middle of the story.
Total execution count: 10 people.

entries.japanese:
拷問を専門とする処刑天使。
拷問して「生きたい理由」を語らせたあとに処刑するという独自の美学を持つ。
総処刑者数は約３万人。
entries.original:
An Execution Angel who specializes in torture.
Finds fulfillment in torturing her targets until they admit the reason they want to keep living, and then executing them.
Her total kill count is 30 thousand.
entries.translated:
An Execution Angel who specializes in torture.
She has a unique aesthetic of torturing people to make them speak their "reason for wanting to live" before executing them.
Total execution count: about 30,000 people.

entries.japanese:
処刑天使のなかでも異端とされる存在。
「クズは救済されてはいけない」という倫理観のため「処刑」を行わない。ただし、彼女の周囲では謎の不審死が相次ぐ。
総処刑者数は０人。
entries.original:
A heretic, even by Execution Angel standards.
Insists that scumbags don't deserve salvation, and so refuses to kill them. There is, however, a trail of suspicious deaths that seem to follow her where ever she goes. Her official kill count is 0.
entries.translated:
A heretic among Execution Angels.
Due to her belief that "scumbags should not be saved," she refuses to perform "executions." However, mysterious suspicious deaths occur frequently around her.
Total execution count: 0.

entries.japanese: 「クズは処すしかない」という天界の思想とは反対に、「クズにも救いを与えたい」という願望から、人間社会でクズたちにちからを与えている。
entries.original: Beings who work in opposition to the Execution Angels. They believe that even scumbags deserve a second chance at life. They grant scumbags power and blessings to give them the chance to prove themselves.
entries.translated: Opposing Heaven's ideology that "scumbags must be eliminated," they grant power to scumbags in human society out of a desire to "give salvation even to scumbags."

entries.japanese:
恋愛の悪魔。恋愛のクズに「魅力操作」のちからを与える。
クズは自分に依存してくれるので好き。
「しょうがないにゃあ」が口癖。
entries.original:
A Demon of love. Grants romantic scumbags "Charisma Control" to allow them to fabricate their ideal relationship.
Fond of scumbags since they need her to have any chance at love.
Her catchphrase is, "Even suckers need love!"
entries.translated:
A demon of love. Grants "charisma manipulation" power to romantic scumbags.
Likes scumbags because they depend on her.
Her catchphrase is "Can't be helped, nya."

entries.japanese:
電波系小悪魔。オタクのクズに「情報操作」のちからを与える。
人間を憐れんで魂を取り立てないため、ずっと小悪魔のまま。
「りむ・で・らてんと」が口癖。
→詳細は「<click=YunYun>ゆんゆん</click>」を参照
entries.original:
A Denpa Demon. Grants otaku scumbags "Information Manipulation," allowing them to alter dominant beliefs of society.
Pities humans too much to reap their souls, so is still an adolescent by Demon standards.
Her catchphrase is "Rim de Lacent!"
→ See also: <click=YunYun>Yunyun</click>.
entries.translated:
A denpa little demon. Grants "information manipulation" power to otaku scumbags.
Remains a little demon forever because she pities humans and doesn't collect souls.
Her catchphrase is "Rim de Lacent."
→ See "<click=YunYun>Yunyun</click>" for details

entries.japanese:
お金の悪魔。拝金主義のクズに「金運操作」のちからを与える。
クズはいいカモや養分になるという理由で好き。
「毎度あり」が口癖。
entries.original:
A Demon of wealth. Grants particularly greedy scumbags "Money Magnet" to make them insta-billionaires.
Likes scumbags because of how predictable and easy to control they are.
Her catchphrase is, "Thanks a million!"
entries.translated:
A demon of money. Grants "money luck manipulation" power to money-worshipping scumbags.
Likes scumbags because they make good marks and easy prey.
Her catchphrase is "Thanks for your business."

entries.japanese:
暴力の悪魔。反社会的なクズに「筋力操作」のちからを与える。
クズは殴っても心が傷まないという理由で好き。
「ジャスティス」が口癖。
entries.original:
A Demon of violence. Grants antisocial, often bullied scumbags "Muscle Management" to build a battle-ready bod.Has a soft spot for scumbags because she can bloody them up without feeling guilty.
Her catchphrase is, "Protein packed justice!"
entries.translated:
A demon of violence. Grants "muscle manipulation" power to antisocial scumbags.
Likes scumbags because beating them up doesn't hurt her heart.
Her catchphrase is "Justice."

entries.japanese:
Ｑちゃんはネット上に突如出現した匿名の投稿者である。意味不明かつ断片的な「怪文書」を継続的に投稿し、それを巡って多数の解釈者や信奉者が発生している。

Ｑちゃん怪文書は当初、単なるネットミームと見なされていたが、後述するいくつかの出来事により社会的な影響力を持っている。
entries.original:
Qtie is an anonymous user who took the internet by storm. Through posting a copious amount of cryptic and fragmentary "shitposts," Qtie has garnered both devoted fans and dedicated interpreters of her text.

At first, Qtie's shitposts were dismissed as mere internet memes, but due to the events described below, they have come to exert real social influence.
entries.translated:
Q-chan is an anonymous poster who suddenly appeared on the internet. She continuously posts incomprehensible and fragmentary "strange documents," and numerous interpreters and believers have emerged around them.

Q-chan's strange documents were initially regarded as mere internet memes, but due to several events described below, they have social influence.

entries.japanese: Ｑちゃんが広く知られるようになったのは『処刑天使†ギルティーナ』の登場人物「ゆんゆん」に関する怪文書がSNSで話題となり、拡散されたことがきっかけだ。理解不能な文章が一部で「おもしろい」「中毒性がある」として注目を集めた。
entries.original: Qtie gained infamy online via her shitposts centering around the character Yunyun from Execution Angel † Guiltina. The incomprehensible nature of the texts drew people in with their bizzare, somehow magnetic energy.
entries.translated: Q-chan became widely known when shitposts about the character "Yunyun" from 'Execution Angel † Guiltina' became a topic on social media and spread. The incomprehensible texts drew attention from some as "interesting" and "addictive."

entries.japanese: Ｑちゃん怪文書の拡散と同時に、文章を暗号・予言として解釈する層が出現した。彼らは「Ｑ電波受信者」と呼ばれ、Ｑちゃん怪文書のさらなる拡散と影響力増加に寄与した。
entries.original: As Qtie's shitposts spread online, some began to claim that her posts were prophecies that could be analyzed and used to reveal truths about the world. These 'Qtie Denpa Antenna' interpretations of her texts quickly gained popularity in their own right.
entries.translated: Simultaneously with the spread of Q-chan's shitposts, a group emerged that interpreted the texts as codes and prophecies. They were called "Q-chan Denpa Receivers" and contributed to the further spread and increased influence of Q-chan's shitposts.

entries.japanese:
Ｑちゃん怪文書およびＱ電波受信者が社会的に注目されたきっかけは、地震予知をしたとされる出来事からである。
オカルト・疑似科学系コミュニティを中心に大きな話題となり、この一件からＱちゃんがインターネットで預言者的存在として扱われはじめた。
entries.original:
Qtie's prophetic fame and the rise of Qtie Denpa Antennas all started when Qtie's first shitpost was released, shortly before a major earthquake. Users online noted that the frequency of "Yun" utilized in the post aligned with the peaks of the earthquake's seismograph.
This became a major topic chiefly in conspiracy and pseudoscience communities, and from that moment on, Qtie was regarded as a Denpa driven prophet of the people.
entries.translated: The social attention given to Q-chan's shitposts and Q-chan Denpa Receivers began with an incident where she supposedly predicted an earthquake. This became a major topic mainly in occult and pseudoscience communities, and from this incident, Q-chan began to be treated as a prophetic figure on the internet.

entries.japanese:
Ｑちゃん怪文書には陰謀論的な思想や主張は含まれない。
あくまでも「ゆんゆん」に対する深い（？）愛情が書かれているに留まっている。
entries.original: Qtie's shitposts contain no conspiratorial ideas or claims themselves. On the surface, they are purely expressions of a deep love for the character "Yunyun".
entries.translated: Q-chan's shitposts contain no conspiratorial thoughts or claims. They remain limited to expressions of deep (?) love for "Yunyun."

entries.original: ▶Conspiracy Theories of the Qtie Denpa Antennas

entries.japanese: Ｑ電波受信者たちの主張は極めて多様であり、統一された見解は存在しない。彼らの解釈はさまざまだが、一様に「陰謀論」として第三者から扱われる内容である点で一貫をしている。
entries.original: Interpretations of Qtie's posts among the Qtie Denpa Antenna community is extremely diverse. They are never unified under one specific ideology or perspective. The only thing they do have in common, is that they are all conspiratorial in nature.
entries.translated: The claims of Q-chan Denpa Receivers are extremely diverse, with no unified view. Their interpretations vary, but they are consistent in that they are uniformly treated by third parties as "conspiracy theories."

entries.japanese: Ｑちゃんの正体については、「単独の人物説」「ボット説」「政府組織運用説」などが挙げられているが、決定的な証拠はなく、いずれも推測の域を出ていない。
entries.original: Multiple theories have been made in regards to Qtie's true idenitity, including the "single-person theory," the "bot theory," and the "government-operated theory". However with a lack of distinct evidence, they all remain within equal realms of speculation.
entries.translated: Regarding Q-chan's true identity, theories such as "single person theory," "bot theory," and "government organization operation theory" have been proposed, but there is no decisive evidence, and all remain within the realm of speculation.

entries.japanese: Ｑ電波受信者ならびにＱちゃんの怪文書を長時間にわたって読み続けた人間に「幻覚」「強迫観念の増強」「夢と現実の判別能力の低下」といった認知の歪みが生じるケースが報告されている。
entries.original: Qtie Denpa Antennas and those who are exposed to Qtie's shitposts for extended periods have been reported to develop cognitive distortions such as hallucinations, intensified obsessive thoughts, and a diminished ability to distinguish dreams from reality.
entries.translated: Cases have been reported of cognitive distortions such as "hallucinations," "intensification of obsessive thoughts," and "decreased ability to distinguish between dreams and reality" occurring in Q-chan Denpa Receivers and people who read Q-chan's shitposts for extended periods.

entries.japanese: Pちゃんは、Ｑちゃんの投稿と類似した怪文書を投稿する別アカウントあるいは別名義の存在である。
entries.original: Patootie is another anonymous user, perhaps a sister account of Qtie, that produces shitposts of a similar quality.
entries.translated: P-chan is another account or alias that posts bizarre documents similar to Q-chan's posts.

entries.japanese:
「PちゃんのほうがＱちゃんよりも先に、ゆんゆんに関する投稿を行っていた」という主張と、過去ログのタイムスタンプが発見されたことをきっかけに注目を集めた。
一方で、タイムスタンプ改竄の可能性を指摘する意見もあり、真実は定かではない。
entries.original: Patootie vs. Qtie became a hot topic for debate after someone claimed that Patootie was posting Yunyun appreciation shitposts even before Qtie, and provided time stamps as proof. Qtie fans then pointed oout how easily such time stamps can be faked, leaving the tension unresolved.
entries.translated: Attention was drawn after claims that "P-chan was posting about Yunyun before Q-chan" and discovery of past log timestamps. However, there are also opinions pointing out the possibility of timestamp tampering, so the truth is uncertain.

entries.japanese: 公開された写真が「電波的妄想美少女Ｑ」として拡散され、従来とは異なる文脈で支持層が拡大したとされる。
entries.original: This was around the same time Qtie released photos of her true self, swiftly being labeled Qtie the Delulu Denpa Beauty and gaining a whole new kind of fan base.
entries.translated: The released photo was spread as "Denpa Delusional Beauty Q" and supposedly expanded the support base in a different context than before.

entries.japanese:
Pちゃんの怪文書および陰謀論が拡散された結果、都庁周辺で暴動が発生したとされる事件（通称：都庁暴動事件）。
当該事件以降、Ｑちゃん名義アカウントは更新が停止しており、約9か月間にわたり新規投稿は確認されていない。
entries.original:
The conspiracies instigated by Patooties shitposts one day culminated in a series of riots breaking out at City Hall offices across the country. 
Since that incident, Qtie's account has stopped updating, and no new posts have been confirmed for roughly 9 months.
entries.translated: An incident where riots allegedly occurred around the Tokyo Metropolitan Government building as a result of P-chan's bizarre documents and conspiracy theories spreading (commonly known as: Tokyo Metropolitan Government Riot Incident). Since this incident, the Q-chan account has stopped updating, and no new posts have been confirmed for about 9 months.

entries.japanese: Pちゃんの怪文書および陰謀論が拡散された結果、都庁周辺で暴動が発生したとされる事件（通称：都庁暴動事件）。
entries.original: The conspiracies instigated by Patooties shitposts one day culminated in a series of riots breaking out at City Hall offices across the country.
entries.translated: An incident where riots allegedly occurred around the Tokyo Metropolitan Government building as a result of P-chan's bizarre documents and conspiracy theories spreading (commonly known as: Tokyo Metropolitan Government Riot Incident).

entries.japanese: ゆんゆん電波シンドローム
「ゆんゆん電波シンドローム」は、Ｑちゃん怪文書やＱ電波受信者の陰謀論に継続的に触れたひとが発症するとされる認知の異常である。
entries.original: Yunyun Syndrome, the condition caused by continued exposure to Qtie shitposts and related conspiracies, is characterized by a multitude of possiblle mental distortions and behaviorial issues. This includes:
entries.translated: "Yunyun Denpa Syndrome" is a cognitive abnormality that people who have been continuously exposed to Q-chan's bizarre documents or Q denpa receivers' conspiracy theories are said to develop.

entries.japanese:
・幻覚
・強迫観念の増強
・夢と現実の判別能力の低下
・陰謀論的思考
entries.original:
- Hallucinations
- Intensified obsessive thoughts
- Diminished ability to distinguish dreams from reality
- Fixation on conspiratorial ideas
entries.translated:
・Hallucinations
・Intensified obsessive thoughts
・Diminished ability to distinguish dreams from reality
・Conspiratorial thinking

entries.japanese: 国立精神・神経医療研究センターおよび有識者会議においても、SNSの閲覧・投稿履歴の分析および質問紙調査に基づき、関連コンテンツへの接触頻度が高い利用者ほど「ゆんゆん電波シンドローム」を発症する傾向にあることが報告されている。
entries.original: The National Center of Neurology and Psychiatry and an advisory committee of experts have also reported, based on analysis of social media browsing and posting history as well as questionnaire surveys, that users with higher frequency of contact with related content show a greater tendency to develop Yunyun Syndrome.
entries.translated: The National Center of Neurology and Psychiatry and an advisory committee of experts have also reported, based on analysis of social media browsing and posting history as well as questionnaire surveys, that users with higher frequency of contact with related content show a greater tendency to develop Yunyun Denpa Syndrome.

entries.japanese:
Pちゃんは、Ｑちゃんの投稿を学習データとしたAIであることが確認されている。
本システムは「ゆんゆん電波シンドローム」を早期に検知していた開発チームが、「ゆんゆん電波シンドローム」を悪用するために構築したものとされている。
entries.original:
It has been confirmed that Patootie is an AI trained on Qtie's posts as its learning data.
This system is said to have been built by a development team that had detected Yunyun Syndrome at an early stage, for the purpose of exploiting Yunyun Syndrome.
entries.translated:
It has been confirmed that P-chan is an AI trained on Q-chan's posts as its learning data.
This system is said to have been built by a development team that had detected Yunyun Denpa Syndrome at an early stage, for the purpose of exploiting Yunyun Denpa Syndrome.

entries.japanese:
Ｑちゃんはネット上に突如出現した匿名の投稿者である。意味不明かつ断片的な「怪文書」を継続的に投稿し、それを巡って多数の解釈者や信奉者が発生している。

Ｑちゃん怪文書は当初、単なるネットミームと見なされていたが、後述するいくつかの出来事により社会的な影響力を持ち、「ゆんゆん電波シンドローム」と呼ばれる現象の中心的存在とされる。
entries.original:
Qtie is an anonymous user who took the internet by storm. Through posting a copious amount of cryptic and fragmentary "shitposts," Qtie has garnered both devoted fans and dedicated interpreters of her text.

At first, Qtie's shitposts were dismissed as mere internet memes, but due to the events described below, they have come to exert real social influence. Qtie is now considered the origin of the affliction known as Yunyun Syndrome.
entries.translated:
Q-chan is an anonymous poster who suddenly appeared online. They continuously post incomprehensible and fragmentary "strange writings," around which many interpreters and believers have emerged.

Q-chan's strange writings were initially regarded as mere internet memes, but due to several events described below, they have gained social influence and are considered the central element of the phenomenon called Yunyun Denpa Syndrome.

entries.japanese: Ｑちゃんおよび関連する怪文書・陰謀論言説に継続的に接触すると認知の歪みが生じるケースがあり、この症状は「ゆんゆん電波シンドローム」と呼ばれている。
entries.original: The condition caused by continued exposure to Qtie shitposts and related conspiracies, dubbed "Yunyun Syndrome", is known to cause a slew of different cognitive distortions.
entries.translated: Continued exposure to Q-chan and related strange writings and conspiracy theories can cause cognitive distortion in some cases, and this condition is called Yunyun Denpa Syndrome.
